Updated Iroha sheet dimensions: 2400 x 1440, eight columns/six rows of 300 x 240 pixels. Crops retain full attack-effect cells. Measured foot anchors keep tank ground placement consistent between rows. `transitionDuration: 100` controls the brief action/facing blend. Held movement resumes after attacks with the previous walking phase.

Current Iroha source: `Iroha Tank Battle Sprite Sheet.png` (1705 x 923), eight columns/six rows with refreshed source crops and foot anchors. Existing movement, cannon, artillery, large display size, and 100 ms pose transitions remain enabled.

Current Iroha asset: `Iroha Tank Sprite Animation Sheet.png` (1448 x 1086, 8 x 6 grid of 181-pixel cells), with refreshed foot anchors and display reference size 165. Existing movement, both attacks, and pose blending remain enabled.

## Aiming preview

Arrow visibility defaults to on and has its own toolbar toggle. Left-click the canvas to switch between character-facing aiming and cursor aiming. Cursor mode draws crosshair.png at the pointer and points arrow.png toward it, accounting for CSS scaling and camera scrolling. Click again to restore facing mode. Reset Scene restores facing mode but preserves arrow visibility. Arrow and crosshair sizes are commented in aiming.js. The supplied crosshair image currently appears as a gradient square; it is used as provided.

## NPC / enemy testing

Open the admin NPC panel below the screen. Select a sprite, AI on/off and chase/wander/idle behavior, then spawn a random batch or choose Cursor Spawn and left-click inside the screen. NPC tool clicks override aim-mode clicks; choose Random Spawn to restore normal aim clicks. Inspect mode selects an NPC under the cursor; Delete mode removes one.

Use the population list or inspect tool to select an NPC. Tools include AI settings for selected/all NPCs, bring to player, 25-HP damage, heal, delete selected/visible/all, AI pause, and single-frame stepping. Debug bounds and health bars are optional. Spawning is capped at 200 with batches of up to 50. NPC speed is 144 px/s, 60% of player speed.

Records live in world-state.js independently of background tiles and survive scrolling, but not reloads. Off-screen rendering is culled while simple AI still updates. This is movement AI and test health only: no automatic attacks, contact damage, collision resolution, or production spawning yet. Reset Scene resets the controlled avatar; use Delete All NPCs to clear the population.

## Two-map transition testing

The Switch Map toolbar button alternates Playarea (infinite horizontal scrolling, fixed camera Y) and Playarea 2 (infinite vertical scrolling, fixed camera X). Characters retain eight-direction movement; only the non-scrolling axis has screen boundaries. Each map remembers avatar positions and keeps its own NPC population, AI state, and health during the session.

The transition flips a 12 x 7 checkerboard in a center-out ripple, alternating horizontal/vertical tile flips. Simulation and canvas clicks pause during the transition. Two temporary screen snapshots are released on completion. Reduced-motion preferences switch maps without the flip. Tune density/timing in map-transition.js. Aim pointers, cursor spawning, inspector selection, debug bounds, and render culling account for both camera coordinates. Map 2 is scaled to screen width and tiled only vertically; Map 1 is scaled to screen height and tiled only horizontally.

## NPC damage feedback

NPC health bars and selection outlines are removed from the game screen. HP remains in world state and the admin inspector. The toolbar Sprite Bounds toggle controls crop outlines for both the player and NPCs. Damage Selected uses `damageEnemy` in world-state.js, which also triggers a 240 ms white sprite pulse (45 ms smooth rise, then fade). Future damage sources should call this same helper. The pulse uses a cached white silhouette preserving image transparency, and advances even when AI is paused. Tune timing/intensity in damage-feedback.js. Defeated test NPCs are still removed immediately.

Map-switch behavior revised: both backgrounds share the same player/NPC world and population. Switching preserves every entity position and the camera origin; only the scrolling axis/background changes. Locked-axis boundaries are relative to the retained camera origin. Off-screen NPCs are not clamped into view. Checkerboard snapshots contain only backgrounds; NPCs, player, damage feedback, bounds, and aiming render afterward and never flip.

Map transition now shrinks old-map tiles uniformly toward their centers in a staggered checkerboard ripple, revealing the new background underneath. It retains only one temporary background snapshot. Characters, NPCs, arrows, and crosshair are drawn afterward and are unaffected.

Map 2 player wall bounds are `leftWallRatio: 0.12` and `rightWallRatio: 0.88`, plus sprite clearance, editable in movement.js. Existing out-of-corridor positions are preserved on switching; movement back inside is allowed while further outward movement is blocked. Player movement, held inputs, AI, damage feedback, attacks, aiming and cursor tools continue throughout checkerboard transitions. Only another map-switch request is temporarily blocked.

Camera recentering: after switching axes, the retained player screen anchor smoothly approaches the center of the scrolling axis. `cameraRecenterSpeed = 7` controls catch-up; the exponential blend is frame-rate independent. The other camera axis stays fixed and no entity world position is changed.

Chase AI now pursues the exact player world-space center using continuous steering. Eight-way quantization affects sprite facing only. Movement clamps to the remaining distance to avoid overshoot/jitter; no 65-pixel stop radius remains. Chase NPCs ignore viewport containment so large bosses can reach a player near an edge. No physical collision separation is implemented, so NPCs can overlap the player center during testing.

## Playarea 3: seeded two-axis world

Switch Map now cycles Playarea -> Playarea 2 -> Playarea 3 -> Playarea. The third map scrolls infinitely in both axes using the six images in `sprites/playarea 3`. Fixed seed `20261101` and coordinate hashing select the same tile at the same grid coordinate on every reload, regardless of exploration order. Weights for tiles 1-6 are 40, 25, 16, 10, 6, 3 (percent chances). Tune `worldSeed` and `tileWeights` in `tile-world.js`.

Each image is scaled to 960 x 720 world pixels. Only visible tiles are drawn; collision queries generate rectangles for nearby tiles without retaining an infinite cache. `obstacleBoxes` lists editable rectangles in original 1448 x 1086 image pixels. They cover stalls, gates, lantern stands, and decorations. Sprite Bounds displays them in yellow. Characters use a smaller foot-level rectangular footprint, with substep collision and axis sliding to prevent crossing obstacles diagonally or at high speed. NPCs use the same collision system, including chase AI. Chase does not yet pathfind around blocked objects.

Random spawning retries clear locations; cursor spawning rejects obstacles. Map switching preserves positions even if a new obstacle surrounds an actor: outward escape movement is permitted without relocating the actor. The original two maps retain their respective axis limits and walls. All features remain in Development.

Playarea 3 tile spacing now overlaps by 2 world pixels on both axes (958 x 718 origin spacing for 960 x 720 artwork). Rendering snaps edges to pixels; collisions use the same adjusted tile origins. Updated tile 1-6 probabilities: 35%, 23%, 16%, 11%, 10%, 5%. The fixed seed remains unchanged, though updated weights intentionally change tile selections.

## Playarea 4: finite angled island

Switch Map cycles through four areas. The fourth uses the entire `play area 4.png` once at `islandScale = 1.5` (2172 x 1629 world pixels), with a camera clamped to its image boundaries. On first entry the map origin positions the open plaza under the current player without changing actor world coordinates.

`island-world.js` defines an angled shoreline polygon, multiple building/tree/bench/pond polygons, and thin fence segments, all in source-image pixels. Movement uses a foot-level actor rectangle and substeps with axis sliding. NPC placement rejects water and obstacles. Sprite Bounds exposes collision outlines in yellow for tuning. The tall center tower blocks only its foundation: its back projection stays walkable, and a clipped tower layer occludes actors behind it. All other buildings block their footprints.

These shapes were authored from the illustration and should be checked visually in the preview. The map does not tile or scroll beyond the image. Existing NPC world positions remain unchanged on map switches, including actors outside the island; delete/re-spawn such test actors on valid island ground if needed. Chase movement collides with obstacles but does not pathfind around them.

Island update: zoom is now 2x (2896 x 2172 world pixels). Only the six building footprints remain obstacles; trees, bushes, benches, fences, and pond are walkable. Shoreline points now follow the inner paving/seawall with a 10-source-pixel safety clearance, including the concave southern inlet. Tune `islandBoundary` and `shoreClearance` in island-world.js. Center-tower behind-building behavior remains intact.

Northern island boundary now follows the recessed seawall around/behind the tower instead of a straight line through the sea. Island collision sweeps to contact and projects remaining motion onto nearby polygon tangents, allowing natural gliding along angled buildings and coastline without penetrating them.

## Map soundtracks

Each map uses its stage-numbered MP3 from `Audio/`. Music begins after a user interaction because browsers restrict autoplay. Admin Tools contains a 0?100% volume slider (default 35%) and Pause/Play music. Map changes crossfade for 900 ms. Outgoing tracks are paused, rewound, and their source unloaded at fade completion; only the active track loops. Audio uses streamed media elements rather than fully decoding long files. Leaving the preview releases all tracks. `map-audio.js` documents paths and fade duration.

The island pond is again solid: an oval collision polygon includes the raised rim at source center (890, 300), radii 54 x 43. Angled sliding stops against it rather than passing through.

Additional solid Stage 4 patches: the large southwest fenced lawn and the triangular planted area southeast of the tower. Their angled curb polygons are documented at the end of islandObstacles and use the same slope-sliding collision response.

## Player/NPC contact testing

Contact uses centered proximity bodies and swept player movement so running through an NPC is detected even if the player passes it between frames. An NPC reaching the player flashes and bounces outward (52 px plus overlap separation), with 600 ms recovery before chasing again. Player-driven contact gives a smaller push (14 px plus separation) and 180 ms recovery. Recoil eases out over 180/90 ms respectively and uses map collision, so solid obstacles cannot be crossed. Short cooldown prevents per-frame retriggering. These values are editable in npc-contact.js.

Contact now deducts HP from both sides, using the editable contact damage settings; each accepted hit gives the player 0.5 seconds of I-frames. Player control is never locked or bounced by this test reaction. AI-off NPCs can still react to contact; admin Pause AI freezes contact physics too. GIF animation and visual damage pulses keep playing. Moving player input is measured from actual world displacement, not just held keys.

## Player HUD

The HUD is a screen-space overlay inside the simulated screen. EXP occupies the full width at the top, using the supplied left/right caps and repeating middle pieces so it adapts to any viewport. An 80-pixel framed active-character portrait sits below at the left, with HP to its right. HP uses the supplied empty/filled sprites. No portrait-box asset was present, so the frame is CSS and the portrait is sampled from the active sprite/GIF.

hud.js reflects existing hp/maxHp/exp/maxExp properties, defaulting to 100/100 HP and 0/100 EXP while gameplay systems are unimplemented. It does not add regeneration, XP rewards, or combat mechanics. HUD artwork stays outside the checkerboard background transition and pointer events pass through to gameplay. Preserve this layout when migrating to the project screen.

## HUD loadout slots

Removed the extra character-name and numeric HP text beside the portrait. Beneath HP are six attack slots and six equipment slots, using six equal flexible columns and 5.2px gaps, aligned with the health bar (portrait remains 80px). The HP bar top edge aligns with the portrait. Empty attack/equipment positions use attack-slot.png/equipment-slot.png. Once populated, the base switches to empty-slot.png and the selected item icon is overlaid, hiding the placeholder sword/clothing artwork.

Set character.attackSlots or character.equipmentSlots to arrays of up to six `{ name, icon }` entries, or call the HUD controller's `setSlot('attack'|'equipment', index, item)` with zero-based indices; null clears the slot. Loadouts are stored per character. No attacks/equipment are auto-assigned and no selection menu or item mechanics are introduced.

HUD level display: bitmap-font.js reads font.png as 20px cells in 15 columns beginning at ASCII space. The upper-right label below EXP shows `LV: 1` by default and reflects character.level when set. It grows leftward for additional digits, uses crisp sprite glyphs, and does not add XP/level-up gameplay.

## Player EXP, health, and invincibility tools

Admin Tools includes Add EXP (editable amount), Next Level, Reduce HP, Gain HP, Full Heal, Reset Player Stats, and Invincibility. Development initializes every controllable character at level 1, 0 EXP, 100/100 HP, invincibility on. State stays per character for this page session and updates the HUD. NPC clones explicitly disable player invincibility.

The EXP curve in player-stats.js is linear: 50 + 15 * (level - 1). Current levels 1/2/3/4/5 require 50/65/80/95/110 EXP to reach the next level. Edit startingLevelExp and expIncreasePerLevel to tune these values. Awards preserve overflow and can grant multiple levels. Invincibility prevents death rather than damage: Reduce HP still works, including down to zero, and damage still flashes. `isPlayerDefeated(character)` returns true only at zero HP with invincibility disabled; use this guard for future defeat handling. Healing caps at max HP and damage caps at zero; health loss triggers existing white feedback. HP 0 does not end the development preview. Reset Player Stats restores level/EXP/HP and enables invincibility again. NPC contact now damages the player and enemies; enemy defeats can drop EXP and bonus loot.


## Ground EXP reports
Defeating an NPC through world-state.damageEnemy drops one report at its feet. Admin deletion/clear does not award EXP. Each report grants its exact reward: 1?10 uses Exp_Report_0, 11?19 Report_1, 20?49 Report_2, and 50+ Report_3 (the supplied highest-tier filename, called Report 4 in the request).

Reports stay at world coordinates with a random fixed rotation until collected, including offscreen and across map switches. Only visible reports render, below characters. Walking within 26px of a report with the player's feet collects it; movement is swept to avoid skipping pickups. Icon width 28px and pickup radius are editable in exp-drops.js. EXP overflow carries across multiple level-ups and updates the HUD immediately. Upgrade choice menus are deferred as requested. Use Damage Selected repeatedly on a spawned NPC to test a defeat; no player attack system is introduced. State lasts for this session only.

Curve reference: https://holocure.wiki.gg/wiki/Level_Up

## Enemy death feedback
Lethal damage removes the living enemy immediately and drops its loot exactly once, while enemy-death.js keeps a visual-only copy. It freezes the current pose, turns nearly white over 35ms, launches 48px away from the damage source, then rapidly fades after a 120ms hold. Total duration is 380ms. Edit deathSettings for distance/timing. Copies cannot chase, deal/take damage, or grant additional loot; offscreen copies expire and fades continue with AI paused. Manual deletion remains immediate. Contact and admin damage pass the player as the hit source; future attacks should pass their source world coordinates as the third damageEnemy argument. Boss/GIF enemies use the same death feedback.

## Plana umbrella attack
The equipped plana-umbrella attack automatically starts a 180-degree sweep every 1 second (start to start). Each swing takes 0.2 seconds and snapshots the arrow angle at its start, including cursor aim; hiding the arrow does not disable attacks. The closed umbrella pose uses handle-centered rotation, eased movement, fading prior poses and a subtle curved trail, with no brightness flashing. Plana can keep moving during attacks. Swapping to an avatar without the umbrella cancels its swing; Reset Scene resets attack timing.

Edit umbrellaSettings in umbrella-attack.js: interval=1s, duration=0.2s, baseRadius=64px, reach=176px, damage=23 HP. Swept sector checks cover the angles between frames and allow only one hit per enemy per swing. Damage uses the regular enemy damage/death/loot path. These are initial test balance values; no upgrade scaling or Arona starting attack is introduced. The arrow and umbrella share aiming.getAngle so crosshair and facing behavior agree.

Umbrella handle now orbits 64px outside the player center, preserving its 112px blade length (176px outer reach). Damage follows this outer annular sweep rather than hitting the center. The 0.2s swing uses thicker, more opaque pink arcs, longer trail history and stronger afterimages. Interval remains 1 second; baseRadius and reach are editable in umbrellaSettings.

Umbrella blur now uses dense angular sampling instead of five time-spaced ghost poses. Each ghost overlaps the next at roughly 0.7-degree spacing with low, tapered opacity. The fast midpoint renders about 124 poses for a continuous blur. Tune trailDuration (0.09s), trailAngleStep (0.012 radians), and maxAfterimages (192) in umbrellaSettings. Swing timing, damage and reach are unchanged.

Umbrella blur refinement: afterimages are composited onto a reusable offscreen canvas and blurred together by 3px, merging individual poses into a softer slash. Trail history is 0.13s and the blurred trail fades for 0.18s after the 0.2s attack ends. The lingering trail is visual-only and cannot damage enemies. Edit trailBlur/trailLinger/trailDuration in umbrellaSettings. The blur is applied once to the composite rather than individually to each afterimage.

Umbrella sweep arc is now 190 degrees, centered on the arrow direction (95 degrees to either side). Edit arcDegrees in umbrellaSettings. The damage sweep and blur use the same arc; duration remains 0.2s and interval remains 1s.

## Variable percentage combat stats
The EXP / HP panel now includes ATK%, SPD%, CRIT%, PICKUP% and Haste% fields. Stats are independent per controlled character and session-only. Finish editing a field to apply; changing avatars refreshes the fields. Reset Player Stats restores all percentages to zero. NPC clones get separate base stats rather than inheriting player upgrades.

ATK/SPD/PICKUP/Haste are bonuses, starting at 0%; multiplier = 1 + bonus/100. ATK scales umbrella damage (base 23), SPD scales movement (base Plana/Arona 240px/s), PICKUP scales attraction radius (Plana base99px, Arona base0, so percentage alone does not grant her a magnet), and Haste scales attack frequency and swing duration inversely. +100% Haste gives a swing every 0.5s lasting 0.1s. Trail timing scales with the attack so visual tails do not block high-speed attacks. Haste snapshots at swing start. CRIT is direct chance, from 0% to 100%, with 2x damage on a successful per-enemy hit roll. Attack damage rounds to whole HP. ATK/SPD/PICKUP/Haste admin values are limited to 0-1000%; CRIT to 0-100%.

Edit defaultCombatStats, statMultiplier and rollAttackDamage in combat-stats.js to tune defaults/critical behavior. Each character stores values under combatStats: atkPercent, spdPercent, critPercent, pickupPercent, hastePercent. Base attack timing/damage remains in umbrellaSettings. No level-up choices or automatic stat growth are added yet.

## Credits and kills HUD
Under the EXP bar, an inset upper-right stack shows credits.png with collected credits, then MP_Gacha.png with confirmed enemy kills. Numbers use the bitmap font at 1.25x. Position is editable in .hud-counters (top36px, right clamp120px/12%/220px), leaving space beside the level display. Totals are shared across character/map switches for this session. Kills increment once on actual defeat, including admin damage defeats; admin deletion/clear does not count. Credits reflect collected inventory, not uncollected drops. Enemy death's rising/popping icon now uses Gacha_Ticket.png instead of MP_Gacha.png; its timing is unchanged.

## Automatic playtesting spawns
A Playtesting sidebar sits outside the simulated screen on its right (below it on narrow displays). Random spawning starts enabled. Stop/Start Random Spawning controls new spawns without deleting current enemies. Each second, up to ten Mob enemies spawn offscreen with chase AI and independent 3% elite rolls. These use default random defeat rewards, independent of manual NPC variant/AI/EXP override settings. The existing 200-enemy population cap applies; sidebar status reports actual batch count and cap.

Stage 1 chooses only left/right entrances within playable height. Stage 2 chooses top/bottom entrances inside the white-wall corridor. Stages 3/4 sample all four sides, validating map obstacles and island containment through the same placement checks as manual spawns. Offscreen margin is 100px to keep full elite sprites out of view. Invalid locations are retried up to 30 times per enemy, then skipped; finite maps with no valid offscreen ground cannot spawn a full batch. Spawn timing uses the game loop, so background tabs do not accumulate a timer backlog. Edit playtestSpawnSettings in playtest-spawner.js for rate/margin/attempts. Stop/start resets the batch timer. Reset Scene does not reset the spawning toggle.

## Critical and supercritical damage text
Critical hits now carry their type from rollAttackDamage through damageEnemy to floating numbers. Crits show yellow bitmap text with one exclamation mark and a slight italic slant (for example 46!). Supercrit visuals show red italic text with three marks (23!!!). Player damage remains plain red. The same 0.55s bounce/fade and overkill values apply. Tinting preserves dark glyph outlines.

Preview Crit Number and Preview Supercrit Number buttons in the EXP / HP panel display both styles without changing health or rewards. Supercrit trigger rules and damage multipliers are intentionally deferred per user clarification. Normal critical rolls still deal 2x damage. Future code can pass 'supercritical' as damageEnemy's fourth argument or showDamageNumber's fourth argument to use the visual style.

Current playtest balance: automatic spawning is 5 enemies per second. All spawned NPCs/enemies (including elites and bosses) use 84px/s base movement, reduced 30% from 120px/s. Player/avatar base speeds and existing SPD bonuses remain unchanged.

Stage 1 is still horizontally infinite but now 1.5 viewport heights tall, allowing vertical camera tracking clamped at the physical top/bottom. Stage 2 is vertically infinite but 1.5 viewport widths wide, with bounded horizontal tracking and correctly scaled white-wall limits. Stage 3 tiles are 1440x1080 (2px seam overlap retained), with obstacle rectangles scaled from their source artwork. Stage 4 scale is 3 instead of 2, with shore/building/pond geometry scaled together. Character, HUD, pickup and attack sizes stay fixed.

Movement, recoil and NPC placement on strip maps use world-space physical bounds rather than the moving camera viewport. Camera movement does not recenter entity coordinates. Offscreen spawning stays on the appropriate strip entrances and respects enlarged map walls. Existing transition input behavior remains live. ## Visible crowd spawn threshold
The spawner now uses a 50-visible-enemy soft threshold. Below 50, the default is 5 enemies/s; at 50 or more, it slows to 1 enemy/s, restoring 5/s when the visible count falls. Counts use sprite/viewport intersection, exclude offscreen enemies and defeated visual remnants, and adapt to camera movement or preview resizing. The sidebar displays visible count and current rate live. Existing enemies remain active; this is a spawning throttle rather than forcibly hiding/deleting enemies, so a crowd can exceed 50 as offscreen enemies arrive. The session population cap remains 200. Tune visibleLimit and crowdedPerSecond in playtestSpawnSettings.

## Escape pause menu
Escape now pauses/resumes gameplay in both regular and centered game previews; it no longer exits the game preview. Use the dedicated Exit Game Preview button (or its pause-menu counterpart) to leave the preview. The sidebar also includes Pause Game. Pause freezes movement, AI/contact, attacks, loot toss/attraction, spawn timers, damage effects and checkerboard transitions while continuing to draw the frozen scene. Frame timestamps advance to prevent a resume jump. Music continues, with a working volume slider in Settings.

The overlay follows the reference: left-side character name and stat rows over a cyan-tinted translucent full character portrait with holographic scanlines, plus a central blue pause panel. Rows use Bond.png (HP), Tournament Water Gun.png (ATK), Crew Whistle.png (SPD), Event 27 - 10 Sided Dice.png (CRT), Event 06 - Buff 14.png (Pickup), Skill Book Node.png (Haste). Crew Whistle.png was not present, so SPD falls back to a small SVG whistle; adding the named asset automatically replaces it after reload. Plana_Portrait.png and Arona_Portrait.png supply holograms. Values reflect live current/max HP and percentage stats. Resume, Settings, Exit Game Preview and Return to Dev Lab are functional; no placeholder upgrade screens are added.

## Crowded-spawn direction priority
At the 50-visible-enemy threshold, 1/s spawns now prioritize the least populated legal direction relative to the player. Count all living session enemies, including offscreen approaching enemies, by direction. Stage 1 compares left/right; Stage 2 compares top/bottom; free maps compare four cardinal sectors by dominant X/Y offset. Exact-center enemies do not bias a direction. Ties are randomized. Placement retries begin on the least-populated side, then fall back to other sides in population order if obstacles/shore block that entrance. Below the threshold, normal 5/s spawning remains random. Visibility threshold, population cap and stage collision checks are unchanged.

The supplied sprites/icons/Crew Whistle.png is now present and used for the pause-menu SPD row. Removed the temporary SVG whistle fallback. Reload the development page to display the new artwork.

Player contact I-frames now last 0.2 seconds. Random Mob elite chance is 1%, with forced admin variants unchanged. EXP starts at 50 at level 1; moving from level L to L+1 increases the next requirement by round(15 + L/2). Costs for current levels 1-5 are 50, 66, 82, 99, 116. experienceForLevel sums these rounded increments with a constant-time formula, preserving overflow and full healing on level-up. These settings supersede the earlier 0.5s/3%/flat15 defaults.

Item level captions now fill 90% of each slot's width with proportional height and 1x bitmap source detail. Occupied level rows reserve 30px below the boxes to prevent overlap with equipment. Caption sizing stays responsive through viewport changes, font loading and multi-digit levels; labels remain tucked against the box edge.

## New-game local-time seed
Procedural maps no longer use the fixed 20261101 seed. run-seed.js generates a 32-bit seed once at each page/game start by hashing browser-local date/time (including milliseconds and timezone offset) with random entropy. Stage 1/2/3 all share this seed, keeping each run's tiles consistent regardless of exploration order. Monument/statue guarantees continue normally.

New Game (New Seed) reloads the development run, clearing session enemies, drops, stats and counters and generating a fresh seed. Reset Scene, map switching, pause and preview sizing preserve the current run/seed. The playtesting sidebar shows the run seed and local start time. Stage 4 remains a fixed island image. This supersedes earlier fixed-seed/reload-consistency notes.

## Population cap and continuous despawning
Enemy/NPC population cap is now 400. Before each active-play spawn update, cleanup removes living NPCs whose sprite bounds are more than 100px from the gameplay viewport, or whose position is invalid in the current playable map (including obstacles/shore/walls). Map changes update the camera and run the same cleanup immediately against the destination map. Distance is measured from sprite edges, preserving the existing 100px-offscreen spawn entrances. Cleanup frees slots before spawn batches and does not grant kills, EXP, credits, notes or death effects. Players and collected/ground loot are not part of the NPC population cleanup. Pause freezes active cleanup with the rest of gameplay. Tune limit/despawnDistance in enemyPopulationSettings in world-state.js. The separate 50-visible crowd threshold and 1/s throttle remain unchanged.

## Population pressure, protected bosses and drop lifetime
At 90% of the 400 population cap (360 living NPCs), cleanup sorts non-boss enemies by distance from the player, removing the farthest until total population reaches 70% (280). Bosses remain counted but cannot be removed; if protected bosses alone exceed the target, they are retained. Cleanup still removes distant/invalid regular enemies and never grants kills, loot or death effects. Both Iroha and Shiroko carry explicit boss flags; elite size does not imply boss identity.

Bosses are now exempt from all automatic population/distance/play-area despawning, including map changes. When a chasing AI boss is more than 150px from the visible viewport (measured from sprite edges), it receives catch-up speed greater than current player movement speed. Boost lasts until the boss re-enters view, avoiding repeated threshold toggling. Speed is max(2x boss base speed, 1.35x current player speed +60px/s), accounting for SPD bonuses. Normal player speed240 yields384px/s catch-up. AI-off, wander/idle and paused movement remain under developer control. Edit bossCatchupSettings in boss-catchup.js.

Ground items/reports are entirely outside population/distance cleanup and persist offscreen during active play. Switching maps clears all uncollected drops (including airborne/attracted ones); collected credits/notes/EXP remain. Explicit admin clear and starting a new run still work. This supersedes previous shared-across-maps drop persistence notes.

## Kill-based boss spawning and pity
boss-spawner.js maintains an internal boss-charge counter separate from HUD total kills. Each real enemy defeat while no boss was alive adds one charge. Starting at charge1000, each eligible kill rolls a 0.01% chance. The chance stays at that value through2500, then rises linearly toward100% at3000. A successful roll queues a randomly selected Iroha or Shiroko chasing boss at a valid offscreen entrance. Placement retries once per second if no location/slot is currently available; pending progress is not lost. Boss spawning is updated before ordinary spawn batches.

Any successful boss spawn, including manual admin spawns, resets the internal charge to0. Charge never accumulates while any boss lives, including the kill that defeats that boss. Cleanup/admin deletion grants no charge. This freeze also applies in endless mode, per user clarification. Before endless, all spawn paths enforce one living boss. In the development cycle, advancing from Stage4 back to Stage1 marks endless mode, where manual multi-boss tests are allowed; automatic progression still waits for all bosses to die. New Game resets the mode/counter. The playtesting sidebar shows charge, chance, pending state and boss-alive freeze. No boss spawn changes the HUD's lifetime kill total.

Tune bossSpawnSettings (1000 unlock,0.0001 base probability,2500 pity start,3000 guarantee) in boss-spawner.js. Boss HP/combat behavior retains its existing development settings. The standard pause freezes this system with all gameplay.

# Synergy recipes for Golden Crafters

Golden Crafters are implemented. The live recipe list in `synergy-recipes.js` includes **Supernova + Luminous Nova ? The Princess and the Key**. Both ingredients must be MAX level. The synergy has no EX skill yet.

A recipe needs:

- `id`: unique recipe identifier.
- `ingredients`: two weapon IDs. Both must be equipped and at their own MAX level.
- `result`: the synergy weapon descriptor, including `id`, `name`, `icon` and `maxLevel`.
- Optional `description` for the fusion preview.
- Optional `createWeapon()` returning a fresh, fully initialized result weapon. Its ID must match `result.id`.

Weapon damage/attacks and any new EX skill still need their normal weapon-controller implementation; a recipe only defines a valid fusion. Do not register a recipe for an unimplemented weapon.

On confirmation the two ingredients become one result weapon in the earlier slot; the second slot becomes empty. No Credits or pending level-up choices are spent. One Golden Crafter is consumed. Cancellation or a stale/invalid pair leaves it intact. One enchantment from each ingredient is preserved, including duplicate enchantments, for a maximum of two inherited enchantments.

Automatic drops roll `(1 + fullRunMinutes / 20) / 100` per enemy defeat, only while an eligible recipe exists and no Golden Crafter is on the ground. The admin **Spawn Golden Crafter** button bypasses recipe eligibility for visual/menu testing, while retaining the one-drop limit. Without a valid recipe its menu cannot fuse or consume weapons.

--- SNAPSHOT FILE: Development/admin-guard.js | sha256=7ba15d5386c054ada83e47cc25fd9a3014422eae7d490d7869e5784dd96e5ebb | encoding=utf-8-sig ---
import { getFirebaseAuth } from '../firebase-client.js';
import { isAdmin } from '../admin-access.js';
import { isGuestSession } from '../guest-session.js';

/** Reveal development content only after Firebase confirms the admin session. */
export async function requireAdmin() {
  const content = document.querySelector('#development-content');
  if (isGuestSession()) {
    content.hidden = true;
    window.location.replace('../project.html');
    return false;
  }

  try {
    const { auth, sdk } = await getFirebaseAuth();

    return await new Promise(resolve => {
      sdk.onAuthStateChanged(auth, user => {
        const allowed = isAdmin(user);
        content.hidden = !allowed;

        if (!allowed) {
          window.location.replace(user ? '../project.html' : '../index.html');
        }

        resolve(allowed);
      }, () => {
        content.hidden = true;
        window.location.replace('../index.html');
        resolve(false);
      });
    });
  } catch {
    content.hidden = true;
    window.location.replace('../index.html');
    return false;
  }
}

const skillIds = { 'plana-umbrella': 'plana-umbrella-launch', 'aris-laser': 'supernova-beam', 'luminous-nova':'luminous-nova-aura','princess-key':'princess-key-ex','decagrammaton':'princess-key-ex' };
const path = coordinates => coordinates.map(([x, y]) => ({ x, y }));
export const adminDigitTemplates = {
  1: [path([[30, 20], [50, 0], [50, 100]])],
  2: [path([[0, 15], [20, 0], [70, 0], [95, 20], [90, 40], [0, 100], [100, 100]])],

/** Match handwritten 1Ã¢â‚¬â€œ6 locally, without downloading or calling either AI model. */
export function recognizeAdminDigit(strokes) {
  const bounds = drawingBounds(strokes);
  if (!bounds) return null;
  const width = bounds.right - bounds.left, height = bounds.bottom - bounds.top;
  if (height > 0 && width / height < .18) return 1;
  const ranked = Object.entries(adminDigitTemplates).map(([digit, template]) =>
    ({ digit: Number(digit), score: drawingAccuracy(strokes, template) })).sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);
  return ranked[0].score >= .45 && ranked[0].score - ranked[1].score >= .025 ? ranked[0].digit : null;
}

/** Resolve a slot only when it contains a weapon with an implemented EX effect. */
export function adminSkillResult(player, slot) {
  const weapon = player.attackSlots?.[slot];
  const skillId = skillIds[weapon?.id];
  return skillId ? { valid: true, adminTest: true, weapon, skillId,
    label: weapon.name || weapon.id, score: 1, accuracy: skillCastSettings.accuracyAverage,
    damageMultiplier: skillCastSettings.damageAverage, components: [] }
    : { valid: false, reason: `Slot ${slot + 1} has no implemented EX skill.` };
}

--- SNAPSHOT FILE: Development/aiming.js | sha256=e21246da84dd7286b5d1cad65db16acea91183a0155b23bcf118b11f585049b1 | encoding=utf-8-sig ---
import { normalSpriteSize } from './scene-metrics.js';
/** Convert browser pointer coordinates to internal canvas pixels after CSS scaling. */
export function pointerToCanvas(clientX, clientY, rectangle, width, height) {
  return {
    x: (clientX - rectangle.left) * width / rectangle.width,
    y: (clientY - rectangle.top) * height / rectangle.height
  };
}

/** Load the supplied aiming artwork without changing project image files. */
function loadAimImage(source) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const image = new Image();
    image.onload = () => resolve(image);
    image.onerror = () => reject(new Error(`Could not load ${source}.`));
    image.src = source;
  });
}

/** Manage independent arrow visibility and click-to-toggle cursor aiming. */
export function createAiming(canvas) {
  const toggle = document.querySelector('#toggle-arrow');
  const modeLabel = document.querySelector('#aim-mode');
  const state = { visible: true, cursorAim: false, directionalOverride: false, inside: false, pointer: { x: 0, y: 0 } };
  let arrow;
  let crosshair;

  // EDIT these values to tune the aiming sprites in internal canvas pixels.
  const arrowWidth = 24.36; // Another 30% smaller than 34.8 pixels.
  const arrowHeight = 13.02; // Preserve proportions at the reduced size.
  const crosshairSize = 75.712; // 30% larger than the previous 58.24 pixels.
  const arrowDistanceMultiplier = 0.9; // Extra clearance below the player sprite.
  const ready = Promise.all([
    loadAimImage('../sprites/arrow.png'),
    loadAimImage('../sprites/crosshair.png')
  ]).then(images => { [arrow, crosshair] = images; });

  /** Keep UI and native cursor in sync with the selected aiming mode. */
  function updateControls() {
    toggle.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(state.visible));
    toggle.textContent = state.visible ? 'Arrow: shown' : 'Arrow: hidden';
    modeLabel.textContent = state.cursorAim && !state.directionalOverride ? 'Aim: crosshair' : 'Aim: character facing';
    canvas.style.cursor = state.cursorAim && !state.directionalOverride && state.inside ? 'none' : 'default';
  }

  /** Track the pointer in screen space, so camera scrolling cannot offset aiming. */
  function trackPointer(event) {
    state.pointer = pointerToCanvas(event.clientX, event.clientY,
      canvas.getBoundingClientRect(), canvas.width, canvas.height);
    state.inside = true;
    updateControls();
  }

  toggle.addEventListener('click', () => {
    state.visible = !state.visible;
    updateControls();
  });
  canvas.addEventListener('pointermove', trackPointer);
  canvas.addEventListener('pointerenter', trackPointer);
  canvas.addEventListener('pointerleave', () => {
    state.inside = false;
    updateControls();
  });
  canvas.addEventListener('click', event => {
    if (event.button !== 0) return;
    trackPointer(event);
    state.cursorAim = !state.cursorAim;
    updateControls();
  });

  /** Share the exact arrow angle with attacks, including cursor aiming. */
  function getAngle(character, cameraX, vector, cameraY = 0) {
    const x = character.x - cameraX;
    const y = character.y - cameraY;
    let dx = vector[0];
    let dy = vector[1];
    if (state.cursorAim && !state.directionalOverride) {
      dx = state.pointer.x - x;
      dy = state.pointer.y - y;
      // Preserve facing if the cursor is precisely on the character anchor.
      if (dx === 0 && dy === 0) [dx, dy] = vector;
    }
    return Math.atan2(dy, dx)+(character.sportsDrinkAimOffset||0);
  }

  /** Draw an upward-native arrow rotated toward facing or the custom cursor. */
  function draw(context, character, cameraX, vector, cameraY = 0) {
    if (!arrow || !crosshair) return;
    const x = character.x - cameraX;
    const y = character.y - cameraY;
    const angle = getAngle(character, cameraX, vector, cameraY);
    if (state.visible) {
      const distance = ((character.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize) / 2 + 25) * arrowDistanceMultiplier;
      context.save();
      context.translate(x + Math.cos(angle) * distance, y + Math.sin(angle) * distance);
      context.rotate(angle + Math.PI / 2);
      context.drawImage(arrow, -arrowWidth / 2, -arrowHeight / 2, arrowWidth, arrowHeight);
      context.restore();
    }
    if (state.cursorAim && !state.directionalOverride && state.inside) {
      context.drawImage(crosshair,
        state.pointer.x - crosshairSize / 2, state.pointer.y - crosshairSize / 2,
        crosshairSize, crosshairSize);
    }
  }

  /** Return to facing-based aiming without overriding the visibility preference. */
  function reset() {
    state.cursorAim = false;
    updateControls();
  }

  updateControls();
  return { ready, draw, reset, state, getAngle, trackPointer,
    setPointerInside(inside) { state.inside = inside; updateControls(); },
    setDirectionalOverride(enabled) { state.directionalOverride = Boolean(enabled); updateControls(); }
  };
}

--- SNAPSHOT FILE: Development/animation-lineup.js | sha256=0f36f4d86ce895342933554aa8ecdbde2b57ef4fd3cb8487221f24508f6b21d4 | encoding=cp1252 (mixed historical files may contain legacy encoding) ---
import { bossBehaviorSettings } from './game-config.js';
import { gifFrameAt } from './gif-animation.js';
import { spriteDisplayPadding, normalSpriteSize } from './scene-metrics.js';
/** Fit the whole sheet once; narrower attack crops must never enlarge individual frames. */
export function lineupSheetScale(template) {
  const layout=template.layout;
  let width=0,height=0;
  for(let frame=0;frame<layout.columnEdges.length-1;frame++) {
    for(let row=0;row<layout.rowEdges[frame].length-1;row++) {
      const crop=layout.frames?.[row]?.[frame];
      width=Math.max(width,crop?.width ?? layout.columnEdges[frame+1]-layout.columnEdges[frame]);
      height=Math.max(height,crop?.height ?? layout.rowEdges[frame][row+1]-layout.rowEdges[frame][row]);
    }
  }
  return Math.min(((template.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize)-spriteDisplayPadding*2)/(template.referenceSize||215),200/width,205/height);
}

  /** Animate sheet frames in place, honoring custom crop rectangles and foot anchors. */
  function draw(now) {
    const elapsed=now-started;
    for(const {canvas,template,direction,index,scale:sheetScale} of previews) {
      const context=canvas.getContext('2d');context.clearRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);
      if(!template.image)continue;
      if(template.animationFrames) {
        const frame=template.animationFrames[gifFrameAt(template.animationFrames,elapsed)];
        const scale=Math.min(((template.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize)-spriteDisplayPadding*2)/(template.referenceSize||200),200/frame.image.naturalWidth,205/frame.image.naturalHeight);
        context.save();context.translate(110,template.previewBehavior==='leap'?430:210);
        if(template.previewBehavior==='leap') {
          const s=bossBehaviorSettings.neru,phase=elapsed/1000%(s.compressSeconds+s.leapSeconds+s.recoverySeconds);
          if(phase<s.compressSeconds)context.scale(1+.3*(phase/s.compressSeconds),1-.45*(phase/s.compressSeconds));
          else if(phase<s.compressSeconds+s.leapSeconds)context.translate(0,-Math.sin(Math.PI*(phase-s.compressSeconds)/s.leapSeconds)*s.leapHeight);
        }
        if(direction!==(template.nativeFacing||'left'))context.scale(-1,1);
        context.drawImage(frame.image,-frame.image.naturalWidth*scale/2,-frame.image.naturalHeight*scale,frame.image.naturalWidth*scale,frame.image.naturalHeight*scale);context.restore();continue;
      }
      const sequence=template.walkFrames?.[direction]||template.frameSequence||[1,2,3,4];
      const frame=sequence[Math.floor(elapsed/(template.frameDuration||110))%sequence.length];
      const row=template.rows[direction];
      if(row===undefined)continue;
      const layout=template.layout,x=layout.columnEdges[frame],y=layout.rowEdges[frame][row];
      const crop=layout.frames?.[row]?.[frame]||{x,y,width:layout.columnEdges[frame+1]-x,
        height:layout.rowEdges[frame][row+1]-y,anchorX:layout.anchorX?.[row]?.[frame],footY:layout.rowEdges[frame][row+1]};
      const scale=sheetScale;
      const mirrored=template.mirroredDirections?.includes(direction);
      const bounce=template.movementBounce;
      const hop=bounce?-bounce.height*Math.sin(Math.PI*(elapsed/1000/bounce.periodSeconds+index*.61803398875))**2:0;
      context.save();context.translate(110,185+hop);if(mirrored)context.scale(-1,1);
      context.drawImage(template.image,crop.x,crop.y,crop.width,crop.height,
        crop.anchorX===undefined?-crop.width*scale/2:-(crop.anchorX-crop.x)*scale,
        -(crop.footY-crop.y)*scale,crop.width*scale,crop.height*scale);
      context.restore();
    }
    request=requestAnimationFrame(draw);
  }
  dialog.addEventListener('close',()=>{cancelAnimationFrame(request);dialog.remove();},{once:true});
  dialog.addEventListener('contextmenu',event=>{event.preventDefault();dialog.close();});
  request=requestAnimationFrame(draw);
}

import { weaponSizeMultiplier, weaponKnockbackMultiplier } from './game-config.js';
import {stationaryWeaponIntervalScale} from './tuning-parts.js';
import {startingWeaponAim} from './tuning-parts.js';

/** Create Supernova with independent automatic and EX attacks. */
export function createArisWeapon() {
  return { id: 'aris-laser', name: 'Supernova', icon: '../sprites/attacks/Weapon_Icon_Arisu.png',
    level: 1, iconRotation: -45, exSkill: true, defaultUnlocked: false, unlockObjective: 'Defeat the boss in Stage 2' };
}

/** Find the equipped laser, independently of every other automatic weapon. */
export function getArisWeapon(player) {
  return player.attackSlots?.find(weapon => weapon?.id === 'aris-laser');
}

/** Size bonuses add to base width; level7 adds a rear beam to each volley. */
export function arisLevelStats(player) {
  const level = Math.max(1, Math.min(7, getArisWeapon(player)?.level || 1));
  return { level, size: 1 + (level >= 2 ? .3 : 0) + (level >= 6 ? .5 : 0),
    damage: level >= 4 ? 1.5 : 1,
    interval: arisWeaponSettings.attackInterval - (level >= 3 ? .5 : 0) - (level >= 5 ? .5 : 0),
    beams: level >= 7 ? 2 : 1 };
}

/** Roll the supplied27-33base damage range, then weapon levels and player ATK/crit. */
export function rollArisDamage(player, random = Math.random, target, damageMod = 1, skillAttack = false) {
  const s = arisWeaponSettings;
  return rollAttackDamage(player, totalWeaponDamage(player, 'aris-laser', s.damageMultiplier,
    [(arisLevelStats(player).damage - 1) * 100],
    { projectileCount: arisLevelStats(player).beams, hitCooldownFrames: s.hitCooldown * 60 }), random, { target, damageMod, skillAttack });
}

/** Invisible piercing capsule starts at the player, bridging the decorative muzzle gap. */
export function arisBeamHits(enemy, origin, angle, width, length = arisWeaponSettings.beamLength) {
  const body = getEnemyHurtbox(enemy);
  return segmentHitsBody({ ...body, rx: body.rx + width / 2, ry: body.ry + width / 2 },
    origin.x, origin.y, origin.x + Math.cos(angle) * length, origin.y + Math.sin(angle) * length);
}

/** Own an independent automatic laser cycle alongside all other equipped autoattacks. */
export function createArisAttack({getWeapon=getArisWeapon,specialHitCooldown=supernovaSkillSettings.hitCooldown,
  rollSpecialDamage=(player,enemy,multiplier)=>rollArisDamage(player,Math.random,enemy,multiplier,true),onSpecialHit=()=>{}}={}) {
  let autoattackEnabled = true;
  let special = null;
  let owner = null, cooldown = 0, clock = 0, volleys = [];
  let stationaryScale=1;
  const hitTimes = new Map();
  function clear() { special = null; owner = null; cooldown = 0; clock = 0; volleys = []; hitTimes.clear(); }
  const s = arisWeaponSettings;
  const image = new Image();
  image.src = new URL('../sprites/attacks/Weapon_Icon_Arisu.png', import.meta.url).href;
  const ready = image.decode();
  return {
    ready,
    reset: clear,
    /** Remove automatic volleys only; an active EX continues updating and dealing damage. */
    setAutoattackEnabled(enabled) { autoattackEnabled=Boolean(enabled); if(!autoattackEnabled) volleys=[]; },
    /** Start a continuous, independently aimable EX; shared per-target cooldown prevents frame damage. */
    cast(player, angle, damageMultiplier = 1.5, getAngle = () => angle) {
      if (owner !== player) { clear(); owner = player; }
      volleys = []; // Cancel the current automatic beam before the EX opening.
      const turn=value=>player.tuningParts?startingWeaponAim(player,getWeapon(player)?.id,value):value;
      special = { player, angle:turn(angle), getAngle:()=>turn(getAngle()), damageMultiplier, elapsed: 0, hits: new Map() };
    },
    update(delta, player, aim) {
      if (!getWeapon(player)) { clear(); return; }
      if (owner !== player) { clear(); owner = player; }
      if(player.tuningParts)aim=startingWeaponAim(player,getWeapon(player)?.id,aim);
      const intervalScale=player.tuningParts?stationaryWeaponIntervalScale(player):1;
      cooldown*=intervalScale/stationaryScale;stationaryScale=intervalScale;
      clock += delta;
      if (special) {
        special.elapsed += delta;
        special.angle = special.getAngle();
        if (supernovaBeamPhase(special.elapsed).finished || special.player !== player) special = null;
      }
      for (const [id, time] of hitTimes) if (clock-time > s.hitCooldown+s.beamSeconds) hitTimes.delete(id);
      if (autoattackEnabled && !special) cooldown = Math.max(0, cooldown - delta);
      if (autoattackEnabled && !special && cooldown <= 0) {

        volleys.push({ elapsed: 0, angles: stats.beams === 2 ? [aim, aim + Math.PI] : [aim],
          width: s.beamWidth * stats.size * weaponSizeMultiplier(player), origin: arisBeamAnchor(player) });
        cooldown = attackTimeFormula(stats.interval*stationaryScale, ensureCombatStats(player).hastePercent);
      }
      const active = [...volleys];
      if (special && supernovaBeamPhase(special.elapsed).damaging) active.push({ elapsed: special.elapsed, angles: [special.angle], width: supernovaSkillSettings.beamWidth,
        origin: arisBeamAnchor(player), special: true });
      for (const volley of active) {
        const start = volley.elapsed;
        volley.elapsed += delta;

        if (volley.special || start < s.beamSeconds) for (const enemy of getAllEnemies()) {
          const times = volley.special ? special.hits : hitTimes;
          const lastHit = times.get(enemy.id);
          if (lastHit !== undefined && clock - lastHit < (volley.special ? specialHitCooldown : s.hitCooldown) - 1e-8) continue;
          const angle = volley.angles.find(value => arisBeamHits(enemy, volley.origin, value, volley.width));
          if (angle === undefined) continue;
          times.set(enemy.id, clock); // A missed attack also cannot reroll every frame.
          const hit = volley.special?rollSpecialDamage(player,enemy,special.damageMultiplier):rollArisDamage(player,Math.random,enemy,1);
          const landed = damageEnemy(enemy.id, hit.damage, player, hit.type, { canMiss: true });
          if(volley.special&&landed!==false)onSpecialHit(enemy,hit,player);

          if (landed !== false && living) {

              applySkillControl(living, control.x, control.y, supernovaSkillSettings.knockbackSeconds,
                supernovaSkillSettings.knockbackSeconds,
                { ignoreKnockbackResistance: supernovaSkillSettings.ignoreKnockbackResistance });
            } else {
              const distance = s.knockbackSpeed * s.knockbackSeconds * weaponKnockbackMultiplier(player);
              applySkillControl(living, Math.cos(angle) * distance, Math.sin(angle) * distance,
                s.knockbackSeconds, s.knockbackSeconds, { ignoreKnockbackResistance: s.ignoreKnockbackResistance });
            }
          }
        }
      }
      volleys = volleys.filter(volley => volley.elapsed < s.beamSeconds * arisBeamVisualSettings.durationMultiplier);
    },

      if (special && image.naturalWidth) {
        // This entire pass is drawn before the player: the gun emerges from behind her.
        const pose = supernovaWeaponPose(special.elapsed, special.player, special.angle);
        context.save();
        const anchor = arisBeamAnchor(special.player);
        context.translate(anchor.x-camera.x, anchor.y-camera.y);
        context.rotate(special.angle);
        context.globalAlpha = pose.opacity;
        const height = pose.length * image.naturalHeight/image.naturalWidth;
        context.shadowColor = '#63eaff'; context.shadowBlur = 12*pose.opacity;
        context.drawImage(image, pose.offset-pose.length/2, -height/2, pose.length, height);
        if(special.elapsed>=arisBeamVisualSettings.openingSeconds&&phase.beamAge<0) {
          const charge=Math.min(1,(special.elapsed-arisBeamVisualSettings.openingSeconds)/arisBeamVisualSettings.prelaunchSeconds);
          const muzzle=arisBeamOffset(anchor,special.angle,true)+supernovaSkillSettings.beamStartAdjustment;
          const radius=4+12*charge;
          context.globalCompositeOperation='lighter';context.shadowBlur=0;
          const light=context.createRadialGradient(muzzle,0,0,muzzle,0,radius*2);
          light.addColorStop(0,'rgba(235,255,255,.85)');light.addColorStop(.4,'rgba(90,215,255,.4)');light.addColorStop(1,'rgba(50,160,255,0)');
          context.fillStyle=light;context.beginPath();context.arc(muzzle,0,radius*2,0,Math.PI*2);context.fill();
          context.strokeStyle='rgba(160,240,255,.6)';context.lineWidth=1;
          context.beginPath();context.arc(muzzle,0,24*(1-charge)+3,0,Math.PI*2);context.stroke();
          for(let i=0;i<5;i++) {
            const angle=i*Math.PI*2/5+special.elapsed*2,distance=8+(1-charge)*24;
            context.beginPath();context.arc(muzzle+Math.cos(angle)*distance,Math.sin(angle)*distance,1.2,0,Math.PI*2);context.fill();
          }
        }
        context.restore();
      }
      if(special&&phase.beamAge>=0) {
        const anchor=arisBeamAnchor(special.player),muzzle=arisBeamOffset(anchor,special.angle,true)+supernovaSkillSettings.beamStartAdjustment;
        drawFiringRings(context,anchor.x-camera.x+Math.cos(special.angle)*muzzle,
          anchor.y-camera.y+Math.sin(special.angle)*muzzle,special.angle,phase.beamAge,supernovaSkillSettings.beamWidth*.55,true);
      }
      if (special && phase.beamAge >= 0 && !phase.beamFinished) visible.push({ elapsed: phase.beamAge, angles: [special.angle], origin: arisBeamAnchor(special.player),
        width: supernovaSkillSettings.beamWidth, special: true });
      for (const volley of visible) {
        const activeDuration = volley.special ? supernovaSkillSettings.duration : s.beamSeconds;
        const visualDuration = activeDuration * arisBeamVisualSettings.durationMultiplier;
        const collapse = Math.max(.06, visualDuration-activeDuration);
        const pulse = 1 + arisBeamVisualSettings.pulseDepth *
          Math.sin(volley.elapsed*Math.PI*2*arisBeamVisualSettings.pulsesPerSecond) ** 8;
        const thickness = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, volley.elapsed/.025,
          (visualDuration-volley.elapsed)/collapse)) * pulse;
        for (const angle of volley.angles) {
          context.save();
          context.translate(volley.origin.x - camera.x, volley.origin.y - camera.y);
          context.rotate(angle);
          // Shift only the EX light cone toward the gun; the weapon emergence stays anchored.
          const offset = arisBeamOffset(volley.origin,angle,volley.special) +
            (volley.special ? supernovaSkillSettings.beamStartAdjustment : 0);
          const cone = arisBeamVisualSettings.coneLength;
          // Additive bloom spreads blue/cyan light around the beam without changing its hit area.
          const visual = arisBeamVisualSettings;
          const layers = [
            [visual.bloomSpread, `rgba(36,151,255,${visual.bloomOpacity})`, visual.bloomBlur, 'lighter'],
            [2.1, `rgba(112,243,255,${visual.bloomOpacity})`, visual.bloomBlur*.5, 'lighter'],
            [2.2, '#219bff88', visual.outerBlur, 'source-over'],
            [1.3, '#51e6ffdd', visual.innerBlur, 'source-over'],
            [.55, '#f1ffff', 1.5, 'source-over']
          ];
          for (const [scale, color, blur, blend] of layers) {
            context.globalCompositeOperation = blend;
            const half = volley.width * scale * thickness / 2;
            context.filter = `blur(${blur}px)`;
            const rainbow=owner?.tuningParts&&rgbTuningActive(owner)&&scale>.6;
            context.fillStyle = rainbow?rainbowTrailGradient(context,offset,-volley.width,offset+600,volley.width):color;
            context.globalAlpha=rainbow?(scale>2?.35:.75):1;
            // Curved shoulders and a rounded nose soften the former triangular opening.
            context.beginPath(); context.moveTo(offset, 0);
            context.bezierCurveTo(offset, -half*.35, offset+cone*.45, -half, offset+cone, -half);
            context.lineTo(s.beamLength, -half); context.lineTo(s.beamLength, half);
            context.lineTo(offset+cone, half);
            context.bezierCurveTo(offset+cone*.45, half, offset, half*.35, offset, 0);
            context.closePath(); context.fill();
          }
          context.restore();
        }
      }
    }
  };
}


/** Sweep toward the closest beam edge, plus a small forward shove.
 * Include projected body radius so even large enemies clear the beam at zero resistance.
 * Shared knockback still respects resistance, collisions and absolute immunity.
 */
export function supernovaKnockback(enemy, origin, angle, width) {
  const body = getCombatHitbox(enemy, true);
  const forwardX = Math.cos(angle), forwardY = Math.sin(angle);
  const sideX = -forwardY, sideY = forwardX;
  const offset = (body.x-origin.x)*sideX + (body.y-origin.y)*sideY;
  const sign = offset < 0 ? -1 : 1;
  const radius = Math.hypot(body.rx*sideX, body.ry*sideY);
  const distance = Math.max(0, width/2 + radius + supernovaSkillSettings.knockbackClearance - Math.abs(offset));
  return {
    x: sideX*sign*distance + forwardX*supernovaSkillSettings.forwardKnockback,
    y: sideY*sign*distance + forwardY*supernovaSkillSettings.forwardKnockback
  };
}


/** Pure presentation timing; only the active3seconds authorize EX damage. */
export function supernovaBeamPhase(elapsed) {
  const openingDuration = arisBeamVisualSettings.openingSeconds + arisBeamVisualSettings.prelaunchSeconds;
  const beamAge = elapsed-openingDuration;
  return { openingDuration, beamAge,
    damaging: beamAge >= 0 && beamAge < supernovaSkillSettings.duration,
    beamFinished: beamAge >= supernovaSkillSettings.duration * arisBeamVisualSettings.durationMultiplier,
    finished: beamAge >= supernovaSkillSettings.duration * arisBeamVisualSettings.durationMultiplier +
      arisBeamVisualSettings.weaponReturnSeconds };
}


/** Fade and slide out from the player's center, hold through firing/tail, then return. */
export function supernovaWeaponPose(elapsed, player = {label:'Plana',x:0,y:0}, angle = 0) {
  const visual = arisBeamVisualSettings;
  const phase = supernovaBeamPhase(elapsed);
  const smooth = value => { const t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, value)); return t*t*(3-2*t); };
  const emerge = smooth(elapsed/visual.openingSeconds);
  const returnStart = phase.openingDuration + supernovaSkillSettings.duration*visual.durationMultiplier;
  const returning = smooth((elapsed-returnStart)/visual.weaponReturnSeconds);
  const progress = emerge*(1-returning);
  return {opacity:progress, offset:(arisBeamOffset(arisBeamAnchor(player),angle,true)-visual.weaponLength/2)*progress,
    length:visual.weaponLength};
}


/** Use the real player collider center, including its vertical sprite offset. */
export function arisBeamAnchor(player) { return getCombatHitbox(player, false); }

/** Automatic beam starts 10px beyond the collider; EX adds its independent muzzle gap. */
export function arisBeamOffset(anchor, angle, special = false) {
  const rx = Math.max(anchor.rx || 0, 0.000001), ry = Math.max(anchor.ry || 0, 0.000001);
  return 1/Math.hypot(Math.cos(angle)/rx,Math.sin(angle)/ry) + supernovaSkillSettings.hitboxGap + (special ? supernovaSkillSettings.extraMuzzleGap : 0);
}

--- SNAPSHOT FILE: Development/bad-cooking.js | sha256=aaf1d108a89e2ac5a80a2ed02b764467fbfdbc8dd52c97e7b5d54288c0f9e1f3 | encoding=utf-8-sig ---
import { weaponSizeMultiplier, weaponKnockbackMultiplier } from './game-config.js';
import { badCookingSettings, badCookingLevelStats } from './game-config.js';
import { totalWeaponDamage, rollAttackDamage } from './combat-stats.js';
import { getAllEnemies, getEnemy, damageEnemy } from './world-state.js';
import { getCombatHitbox, getEnemyHurtbox } from './combat-hitboxes.js';
import { applySkillControl } from './enemy-control.js';

/** Persistent miasma: renewal replaces the old field and never overlaps another copy. */
export function createBadCookingAttack({random=Math.random}={}){
  let owner=null,active=false,enabled=true,elapsed=0,cycle=0,time=0,hits=new Map(),mist=null;
  function reset(){owner=null;active=false;elapsed=0;cycle=0;time=0;hits.clear();}
  function update(delta,player){
    const weapon=player.attackSlots?.find(w=>w?.id==='bad-cooking');
    if(!weapon){reset();return;}if(owner!==player){reset();owner=player;}
    if(delta<=0)return;if(!enabled){active=false;return;}
    active=true;elapsed=(elapsed+delta)%badCookingSettings.interval;cycle+=delta;
    const stats=badCookingLevelStats(weapon.level),radius=stats.radius*weaponSizeMultiplier(player);
    const body=getCombatHitbox(player,false);
    let left=delta;
    while(left>1e-8){const step=Math.min(left,1/60);left-=step;time+=step;
      const enemies=getAllEnemies(),liveIds=new Set(enemies.map(e=>e.id));
      for(const id of hits.keys())if(!liveIds.has(id))hits.delete(id);
      for(const enemy of enemies){
        if(time-(hits.get(enemy.id)??-Infinity)<stats.hitCooldown-1e-8)continue;
        const target=getEnemyHurtbox(enemy),dx=body.x-target.x,dy=body.y-target.y;
        // Closest point on the sprite hurtbox, rather than contact hitbox.
        const distance=Math.hypot(dx,dy),extent=distance?1/Math.hypot(dx/distance/target.rx,dy/distance/target.ry):0;
        if(distance>radius+extent)continue;
        hits.set(enemy.id,time);
        const hit=rollAttackDamage(player,totalWeaponDamage(player,'bad-cooking',badCookingSettings.damage,stats.damageBonuses,
          {projectileCount:1,hitCooldownFrames:stats.hitCooldown*60}),random,{target:enemy,weaponId:'bad-cooking'});
        const landed=damageEnemy(enemy.id,hit.damage,player,hit.type,{canMiss:true}),living=getEnemy(enemy.id);
        if(stats.knockback&&landed!==false&&living){const angle=Math.atan2(-dy,-dx),duration=badCookingSettings.knockbackSeconds;
          applySkillControl(living,Math.cos(angle)*badCookingSettings.knockbackSpeed*duration*weaponKnockbackMultiplier(player),Math.sin(angle)*badCookingSettings.knockbackSpeed*duration*weaponKnockbackMultiplier(player),duration,duration);}
      }
    }
  }
  function draw(context,camera){
    if(!active||!owner)return;
    if(!mist){mist=document.createElement('canvas');mist.width=mist.height=256;const c=mist.getContext('2d'),g=c.createRadialGradient(128,128,0,128,128,128);
      g.addColorStop(0,'rgba(192,143,231,.13)');g.addColorStop(.88,'rgba(192,143,231,.13)');g.addColorStop(.98,'rgba(192,143,231,.1)');g.addColorStop(1,'rgba(192,143,231,0)');c.fillStyle=g;c.fillRect(0,0,256,256);}
    const body=getCombatHitbox(owner,false),weapon=owner.attackSlots.find(w=>w?.id==='bad-cooking');
    const radius=badCookingLevelStats(weapon?.level).radius*weaponSizeMultiplier(owner),x=body.x-camera.x,y=body.y-camera.y;
    context.save();context.globalAlpha=Math.min(1,cycle/.3);
    context.drawImage(mist,x-radius,y-radius,radius*2,radius*2);
    context.beginPath();context.arc(x,y,radius,0,Math.PI*2);
    context.lineWidth=1.25;context.strokeStyle='rgba(187,124,227,.38)';context.stroke();
    // Fixed particle seeds: softly fade in, rise vertically, then fade out and repeat.
    // Only their phase changes; no orbiting, expanding cloud blobs or per-frame allocations.
    for(let i=0;i<32;i++){
      const phase=(cycle/(1.5+(i%5)*.15)+i*.61803398875)%1;
      const angle=i*2.399963,r=radius*Math.sqrt((i+.5)/32)*.76;
      const px=Math.cos(angle)*r,py=Math.sin(angle)*r;
      const rise=Math.min(radius*.36,52),size=4+i%3;
      context.fillStyle=`rgba(192,103,238,${.85*Math.sin(Math.PI*phase)})`;
      context.fillRect(x+px-size/2,y+py-rise*phase-size/2,size,size);
    }
    context.restore();
  }
  return {ready:Promise.resolve(),update,draw,reset,setAutoattackEnabled(value){enabled=Boolean(value);if(!enabled)active=false;},get active(){return active;}};
}

--- SNAPSHOT FILE: Development/bean-bag-bomb.js | sha256=091c64f8d3bd34621fdb440d4e3dca289db808784ac34b8ee710448a22eceb0d | encoding=utf-8-sig ---
import { beanBagBombSettings, beanBagBombLevelStats, attackTimeFormula, weaponSizeMultiplier } from './game-config.js';

/** Arcing throws settle on the ground; the 630-frame fuse counts from launch. */
export function createBeanBagBombAttack({random=Math.random}={}){
 const s=beanBagBombSettings;let owner=null,enabled=true,cooldown=0,bombs=[],explosions=[],shots=0;
 let sprite=null;
 const imageReady=typeof Image==='undefined'?Promise.resolve():new Promise(resolve=>{sprite=new Image();sprite.onload=resolve;sprite.onerror=()=>{sprite=null;resolve();};sprite.src=new URL('../sprites/attacks/Bean Bag.png',import.meta.url).href;});
 function reset(){owner=null;cooldown=0;bombs=[];explosions=[];shots=0;}
 function launch(player,weapon,viewport){
  const body=getCombatHitbox(player,false),stats=beanBagBombLevelStats(weapon.level),view=viewport||{x:body.x-640,y:body.y-360,width:1280,height:720};
  const reach=Math.min(500,Math.max(view.width,view.height)*.45),targets=getAllEnemies().filter(enemy=>{const t=getEnemyHurtbox(enemy);return Math.hypot(t.x-body.x,t.y-body.y)<=reach;});
  const count=startingWeaponProjectileCount(player,'bean-bag-bomb',stats.count);
  for(let i=0;i<count;i++){
   const target=targets.length?getEnemyHurtbox(targets[Math.min(targets.length-1,Math.floor(random()*targets.length))]):null;
   const angle=target?Math.atan2(target.y-body.y,target.x-body.x):random()*Math.PI*2;
   const distance=target?Math.hypot(target.x-body.x,target.y-body.y):reach*(.2+.65*random());
   const spread=count>1?(i-(count-1)/2)*.2:0,a=angle+spread;
   bombs.push({x:body.x,y:body.y,fromX:body.x,fromY:body.y,toX:body.x+Math.cos(a)*distance,toY:body.y+Math.sin(a)*distance,
    age:0,flight:Math.max(.15,distance/s.speed),radius:stats.radius*weaponSizeMultiplier(player),damageBonuses:stats.damageBonuses,count});shots++;
  }
 }
 function explode(bomb,player){
  explosions.push({x:bomb.x,y:bomb.y,radius:bomb.radius,age:0});
  for(const enemy of getAllEnemies()){
   const t=getEnemyHurtbox(enemy),dx=t.x-bomb.x,dy=t.y-bomb.y,distance=Math.hypot(dx,dy),extent=distance?1/Math.hypot(dx/distance/t.rx,dy/distance/t.ry):0;
   if(distance>bomb.radius+extent)continue;
   const hit=rollAttackDamage(player,totalWeaponDamage(player,'bean-bag-bomb',s.damage,bomb.damageBonuses,{projectileCount:bomb.count,hitCooldownFrames:s.hitCooldown*60}),random,{target:enemy,weaponId:'bean-bag-bomb'});
   damageEnemy(enemy.id,hit.damage,player,hit.type,{canMiss:true});
  }
 }
 function update(delta,player,viewport=null){
  const weapon=player.attackSlots?.find(w=>w?.id==='bean-bag-bomb');if(!weapon){reset();return;}
  if(owner!==player){reset();owner=player;}if(!(delta>0))return;
  let left=delta;while(left>1e-8){
   if(enabled&&cooldown<=1e-8){launch(player,weapon,viewport);cooldown=attackTimeFormula(beanBagBombLevelStats(weapon.level).interval*(player.tuningParts?stationaryWeaponIntervalScale(player):1),ensureCombatStats(player).hastePercent);}
   const step=Math.min(left,1/60,enabled&&cooldown>1e-8?cooldown:1/60);left-=step;cooldown=Math.max(0,cooldown-step);
   for(let i=explosions.length-1;i>=0;i--){explosions[i].age+=step;if(explosions[i].age>=artilleryExplosionDuration)explosions.splice(i,1);}
   for(let i=bombs.length-1;i>=0;i--){const b=bombs[i];b.age+=step;const p=Math.min(1,b.age/b.flight);b.x=b.fromX+(b.toX-b.fromX)*p;b.y=b.fromY+(b.toY-b.fromY)*p;
    if(b.age>=s.duration-1e-8){explode(b,player);bombs.splice(i,1);}
   }
  }
 }
 function draw(context,camera){
  for(const b of bombs){const flight=Math.min(1,b.age/b.flight),arc=Math.sin(Math.PI*flight)*48,x=b.x-camera.x,y=b.y-camera.y,urgency=Math.max(0,(b.age-(s.duration-2))/2);
   context.save();context.fillStyle='rgba(15,30,50,.2)';context.beginPath();context.ellipse(x,y+6,10,4,0,0,Math.PI*2);context.fill();
   context.translate(x,y-arc);context.rotate(flight<1?b.age*6:Math.sin(b.age*12)*urgency*.08);
   if(sprite?.complete&&sprite.naturalWidth)context.drawImage(sprite,72,20,171,202,-12,-17,24,28);
   else {context.fillStyle='#b28a56';context.beginPath();context.ellipse(0,0,11,13,0,0,Math.PI*2);context.fill();}
   context.strokeStyle='#ffc569';context.lineWidth=1.5;context.beginPath();context.moveTo(0,-12);context.quadraticCurveTo(8,-20,3,-24);context.stroke();
   context.fillStyle=`rgba(255,${Math.round(200-100*urgency)},65,${.6+.4*Math.sin(b.age*(12+urgency*14))**2})`;context.beginPath();context.arc(3,-24,2+urgency*2,0,Math.PI*2);context.fill();context.restore();
  }
  for(const effect of explosions)drawArtilleryExplosion(context,camera,effect,effect.age);
 }
 return {ready:Promise.all([imageReady,artilleryExplosionReady]),update,draw,reset,setAutoattackEnabled(value){enabled=Boolean(value);},get shotsFired(){return shots;},get bombCount(){return bombs.length;},get explosionCount(){return explosions.length;}};
}

--- SNAPSHOT FILE: Development/bitmap-font.js | sha256=c9360bddc2a2e5337240f89e5f641b92bfb3ab934f802e75c4fb322a1d5796e9 | encoding=utf-8-sig ---
import { font21Metrics } from './font21-metrics.js';
import { font2Metrics } from './font2-metrics.js';
import { thinFontMetrics } from './font-thin-metrics.js';
import { fontMetrics } from './font-metrics.js';
const highlightedGlyphs=new Map();

/** Important EX values/effects use yellow ink, without changing the wording or wrapping. */
export function statHighlightRanges(text) {
  return [...text.matchAll(/\d+(?:\.\d+)?\s*(?:%|×|x\b)?|\b(?:seconds?|critical chance|noncritical|stunning|knocking enemies aside|unlimited piercing|stored[- ]charge|ATK)\b/gi)]
    .map(match=>({start:match.index,end:match.index+match[0].length}));
}

/** Tint bright glyph ink once and preserve the original dark outline and transparency. */
function yellowGlyph(image,glyph,variant,character) {
  const key=`${variant}:${character}`;if(highlightedGlyphs.has(key))return highlightedGlyphs.get(key);
  const tile=document.createElement('canvas');tile.width=glyph.width;tile.height=glyph.height;
  const context=tile.getContext('2d',{willReadFrequently:true});
  context.drawImage(image,glyph.x,glyph.y,glyph.width,glyph.height,0,0,glyph.width,glyph.height);
  const pixels=context.getImageData(0,0,tile.width,tile.height);
  for(let i=0;i<pixels.data.length;i+=4)if(pixels.data[i]>160&&pixels.data[i+1]>160&&pixels.data[i+2]>160) {
    pixels.data[i]=255;pixels.data[i+1]=225;pixels.data[i+2]=90;
  }
  context.putImageData(pixels,0,0);highlightedGlyphs.set(key,tile);return tile;
}

/** Return tight glyph bounds so only the dark outlines meet between letters. */
export function glyphRectangle(character) {
  return fontMetrics[character] || fontMetrics['?'];
}

/** Render crisp HUD text from the supplied font sheet, refreshing only on changes. */
export function createBitmapText(canvas, { scale = 2, outlineOverlap = 1, spaceWidth = 3, fitWidth = null, variant = 'regular', maxWidth = null, wrap = true, highlightStats = false } = {}) {
  canvas.setAttribute('data-bitmap-text','');
  const image = new Image();
  let loaded = false;
  let text = '';
  const sourceScale = variant === 'font21' ? .25 : 1;
  const lineHeight = variant === 'font21' ? 24 : 20;
  const glyphFor = character => variant === 'font21' ? font21Metrics[character] || font21Metrics['?'] : variant === 'font2' ? font2Metrics[character] || font2Metrics['?'] : variant === 'thin' ? thinFontMetrics[character] || thinFontMetrics['?'] : glyphRectangle(character);

  function render() {
    // EDIT scale/outlineOverlap via options: 2x glyphs, one source outline pixel overlap.
    const lines = [''];
    const measure = value => [...value].reduce((sum, c) => sum + (c === ' ' ? spaceWidth : glyphFor(c).width * sourceScale - outlineOverlap), outlineOverlap) * scale;
    for (const word of text.split(' ')) {
      const index = lines.length - 1;
      const next = lines[index] ? `${lines[index]} ${word}` : word;
      if (wrap && maxWidth && lines[index] && measure(next) > maxWidth) lines.push(word);
      else lines[index] = next;
    }
    canvas.width = Math.max(1, ...lines.map(measure));
    canvas.height = lineHeight * scale * lines.length;
    canvas.style.width = fitWidth || `${canvas.width}px`;
    canvas.style.height = fitWidth ? 'auto' : `${canvas.height}px`;
    canvas.setAttribute('aria-label', text);
    if (!loaded) return;
    const context = canvas.getContext('2d');
    context.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;
    lines.forEach((line, row) => {
      let x = 0,index=0;const highlights=highlightStats?statHighlightRanges(line):[];
      for (const character of line) {
        if (character !== ' ') {
          const glyph = glyphFor(character);
          const highlighted=highlights.some(range=>index>=range.start&&index<range.end);
          const source=highlighted?yellowGlyph(image,glyph,variant,character):image;
          context.drawImage(source, highlighted?0:glyph.x, highlighted?0:glyph.y, glyph.width, glyph.height,
            x * scale, (row * lineHeight + glyph.offsetY * sourceScale) * scale, glyph.width * sourceScale * scale, glyph.height * sourceScale * scale);
        }
        x += character === ' ' ? spaceWidth : glyphFor(character).width * sourceScale - outlineOverlap;
        index+=character.length;
      }
    });
  }

  image.onload = () => { loaded = true; render(); };
  image.src = new URL(variant === 'font21' ? '../sprites/font2.1.png' : variant === 'font2' ? '../sprites/font2.png' : variant === 'thin' ? '../sprites/font-thin.png' : '../sprites/font.png', import.meta.url).href;
  return {
    setMaxWidth(value) { maxWidth = value; render(); },
    setScale(value) { scale = Math.max(.1, Number(value)||1); render(); },
    setText(value) {
      if (text === value) return;
      text = value;
      render();
    }
  };
}
