import { weaponKnockbackMultiplier } from './game-config.js';
import {tuningPerk} from './tuning-parts.js';
import {applySkillControl} from './enemy-control.js';
export function knockbackTuningMultiplier(player){
  const main=player.mainWeaponId??(player.label==='Plana'?'plana-umbrella':null);
  return main==='plana-umbrella'&&player.tuningParts?1+tuningPerk(player.tuningParts,'knockbackStrengthPercent')/100:1;
}
export function applyTuningKnockback(player,enemy){
  if(!enemy||enemy.hp<=0||!player.tuningParts||knockbackTuningMultiplier(player)===1)return false;
  const frames=tuningPerk(player.tuningParts,'knockbackFrames'),speed=tuningPerk(player.tuningParts,'knockbackSpeed');
  if(!frames||!speed)return false;
  const dx=enemy.x-player.x,dy=enemy.y-player.y,length=Math.hypot(dx,dy),distance=speed*frames*weaponKnockbackMultiplier(player);
  applySkillControl(enemy,(length?dx/length:1)*distance,(length?dy/length:0)*distance,0,frames/60);
  return true;
}

--- SNAPSHOT FILE: Development/knockback.js | sha256=9c7ac14946f4f7aa77ee52b5e3afe2fec18adf13516acc17b3a31a379ffeef2e | encoding=utf-8-sig ---
import { knockbackSettings } from './game-config.js';
import { getCombatHitbox, segmentHitsBody } from './combat-hitboxes.js';

/** Age resistance in gameplay seconds, retaining any configured base resistance. */
export function updateKnockbackResistance(enemy, delta) {
  if (enemy.knockbackIdleSeconds === undefined) return;
  enemy.knockbackIdleSeconds += Math.max(0, delta);
  if (enemy.knockbackIdleSeconds >= knockbackSettings.resetSeconds - 1e-8) enemy.knockbackResistanceBonus = 0;
  enemy.knockbackResistance = Math.min(knockbackSettings.maxResistance,
    Math.max(0, enemy.baseKnockbackResistance || 0) + (enemy.knockbackResistanceBonus || 0));
}

/** Scale speed by existing resistance, then add a stack for subsequent knockbacks. */
export function beginKnockback(enemy, dx, dy, duration, { ignoreKnockbackResistance = false } = {}) {
  // Absolute immunity also blocks attacks that bypass resistance.
  if (enemy.knockbackImmune || !(duration > 0) || !(Math.hypot(dx, dy) > 0)) return null;
  updateKnockbackResistance(enemy, 0);
  const resistance = Math.min(knockbackSettings.maxResistance,
    Math.max(0, enemy.baseKnockbackResistance || 0) + (enemy.knockbackResistanceBonus || 0));
  const scale = ignoreKnockbackResistance ? 1 : 1 - resistance;
  enemy.knockbackResistanceBonus = Math.min(knockbackSettings.maxResistance,
    Math.round(((enemy.knockbackResistanceBonus || 0) + knockbackSettings.resistancePerHit) * 1e6) / 1e6);
  enemy.knockbackIdleSeconds = 0;
  enemy.knockbackResistance = Math.min(knockbackSettings.maxResistance,
    Math.max(0, enemy.baseKnockbackResistance || 0) + enemy.knockbackResistanceBonus);
  return { dx: dx * scale, dy: dy * scale, duration, elapsed: 0, applied: 0, stopped: false };
}

/** Stop displacement without removing an independent stun or contact recovery timer. */
export function stopEnemyKnockback(enemy) {
  if (enemy.skillKnockback) enemy.skillKnockback.stopped = true;
  if (enemy.contactReaction) enemy.contactReaction.stopped = true;
}

/** Travel at constant effect speed until duration expires or the mover reports collision. */
export function advanceKnockback(enemy, motion, delta, move) {
  motion.elapsed += Math.max(0, delta);
  const progress = Math.min(1, motion.elapsed / motion.duration);
  const step = progress - motion.applied;
  if (!motion.stopped && step > 0 && move(enemy, motion.dx * step, motion.dy * step) === false) motion.stopped = true;
  motion.applied = progress;
  return !motion.stopped && progress < 1;
}

/** Sweep living enemies and sample solid scenery; never slide or pass through a collision. */
export function createKnockbackMover(getEnemies, isClear) {
  return (enemy, dx, dy) => {
    const start = getCombatHitbox(enemy, true);
    const length = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
    if (!length) return true;
    const candidates = getEnemies().filter(other => other !== enemy && (!enemy.id || other.id !== enemy.id))
      .map(other => ({ other, body: getCombatHitbox(other, true) }))
      .filter(({ body }) => Math.abs(body.x - start.x) <= Math.abs(dx) + body.rx + start.rx &&
        Math.abs(body.y - start.y) <= Math.abs(dy) + body.ry + start.ry);
    const stepSize = Math.max(.25, Math.min(knockbackSettings.collisionStep, start.rx / 2, start.ry / 2));
    const steps = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(length / stepSize));
    const stepX = dx / steps, stepY = dy / steps;
    for (let i = 0; i < steps; i++) {
      const x = enemy.x + stepX, y = enemy.y + stepY;
      const body = getCombatHitbox({ ...enemy, x, y }, true);
      const previous = getCombatHitbox(enemy, true);
      const hit = candidates.find(({ body: other }) => segmentHitsBody({ ...other,
        rx: other.rx + body.rx, ry: other.ry + body.ry }, previous.x, previous.y, body.x, body.y));
      if (hit || !isClear(enemy, x, y)) {
        stopEnemyKnockback(enemy);
        if (hit) stopEnemyKnockback(hit.other);
        return false;
      }
      enemy.x = x; enemy.y = y;
    }
    return true;
  };
}

--- SNAPSHOT FILE: Development/level-up-actions.js | sha256=20a58d58145c8ac40c9ff075abdea41e5854f8fa5b70533587bafeb3f13227da | encoding=utf-8-sig ---
import { isContentUnlocked } from './item-catalog.js';
const limits={reroll:10,eliminate:10,hold:5};
export function levelActionUses(player,action){
  const purchased=Math.max(0,Math.min(limits[action],Math.trunc(Number(player.abilityUpgradeRanks?.[action])||0)));
  const granted=isContentUnlocked('developer-level-actions')?limits[action]:purchased;
  return Math.max(0,granted-(player.levelActionSpent?.[action]||0));
}
export function spendLevelAction(player,action){
  if(!levelActionUses(player,action))return false;
  player.levelActionSpent??={};player.levelActionSpent[action]=(player.levelActionSpent[action]||0)+1;return true;
}
export function levelActionChoices(player,pool,random=Math.random){
  const remaining=pool.slice(),choices=[];
  while(remaining.length){
    const weight=choice=>Math.max(0,Number(choice.weapon?.weight??1)||0),total=remaining.reduce((sum,c)=>sum+weight(c),0);
    let roll=random()*total,index=remaining.length-1;
    for(let i=0;i<remaining.length;i++){roll-=weight(remaining[i]);if(roll<0){index=i;break;}}
    choices.push(...remaining.splice(index,1));
  }
  const held=choices.findIndex(choice=>choice.id===player.heldUpgradeId);
  if(held>=0)choices.unshift(...choices.splice(held,1));
  return choices;
}

        const context = icon.getContext('2d');
        const angle = (upgrade.weapon.iconRotation || 0) * Math.PI / 180;
        context.translate(64, 64); if(upgrade.weapon.iconFlipX)context.scale(-1,1); context.rotate(angle);
        const width = Math.abs(crop.width * Math.cos(angle)) + Math.abs(crop.height * Math.sin(angle));
        const height = Math.abs(crop.width * Math.sin(angle)) + Math.abs(crop.height * Math.cos(angle));
        const scale = (upgrade.weapon.iconFit?124:120) / Math.max(width, height);
        context.drawImage(image, crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height,
          -crop.width*scale/2, -crop.height*scale/2, crop.width*scale, crop.height*scale);
      };
      image.src = upgrade.weapon.icon;
      const description = document.createElement('p');description.className='level-up-description';
      body.append(icon, description); button.append(header, body); choicesElement.append(button);
      text(title, upgrade.name, 1.3); text(category, upgrade.category, 1); text(description, upgrade.description, 1.2);
      button.disabled = !choices.length;
      button.addEventListener('click', () => choose(index));
      button.addEventListener('pointerenter', () => select(index, false));
    });
    for (let i = displayed.length; i < levelUpgradeSettings.choices; i++) {
      const empty = document.createElement('div'); empty.className = 'level-up-empty-slot';
      empty.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true'); choicesElement.append(empty);
    }
    updateActions();select(0);
  }

  /** Restore developer controls only after the final queued level has been resolved. */
  function close() {
    player = null; actionMode=null; overlay.hidden = true;
    for (const observer of observers.values()) observer.disconnect();
    observers.clear();
    for (const [element, inert] of previousInert) element.inert = inert;
    previousInert = [];
    releaseControls(); canvas.focus({ preventScroll: true });
  }

  continueButton.addEventListener('click', () => {
    if (!player || choices.length) return;
    player.pendingUpgrades = 0;
    onChoose(player); close();
  });
  overlay.addEventListener('contextmenu', event => event.preventDefault());
  overlay.addEventListener('pointerdown', event => {
    if (event.button === 2) { event.preventDefault(); event.stopPropagation(); }
  });
  window.addEventListener('keydown', event => {
    if (!player || event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey || event.altKey) return;
    if(!overlay.contains?.(event.target))return;
    if(event.target?.closest?.('input, select, textarea, [contenteditable="true"]'))return;
    if (['ArrowUp', 'ArrowDown', 'w', 's', 'Enter', ' ', 'Escape'].includes(event.key)) {
      event.preventDefault(); event.stopImmediatePropagation();
      if (event.repeat) return;
      if(event.key==='Escape'){actionMode=null;updateActions();text(document.querySelector('#level-up-help'),'Choose an upgrade to continue.',.9);return;}
      if(['Enter',' '].includes(event.key)&&event.target?.closest?.('.level-up-actions')){event.target.closest('button')?.click();return;}
      if (['ArrowUp', 'w'].includes(event.key)) select(selected - 1);
      if (['ArrowDown', 's'].includes(event.key)) select(selected + 1);
      if (['Enter', ' '].includes(event.key)) {
        if (choices.length) choose(selected); else continueButton.click();
      }
    }
  }, true);

  return {
    get active() { return player !== null; },
    update() {
      if (player || isPauseMenuOpen() || !(getPlayer().pendingUpgrades > 0)) return;
      player = getPlayer();
      releaseControls(); onOpen(); overlay.hidden = false;
      // Keep admin tools and the rest of the browser usable during upgrade selection.
      previousInert = [[canvas,canvas.inert]];
      canvas.inert = true;
      render();
    }
  };
}

/** Offer only the next upgrade for an equipped, implemented weapon. */
function umbrellaChoices(player) {
  ensurePlayerStats(player);
  const weapon = getUmbrella(player);
  if (!weapon) return [];
  const level = weapon.level || 1;
  if (level < umbrellaUpgradeSettings.maxLevel) return [{ id: 'umbrella-level',
    name: `Plana's Umbrella ${upgradeLevelLabel(weapon,umbrellaUpgradeSettings.maxLevel)}`, weapon, category: 'Weapon', description: descriptions[level + 1] }];
  return [];
}

/** Advance one weapon level; awakening is available only through a Crafter. */
export function applyLevelUpgrade(player, id) {
  ensurePlayerStats(player);
  if (player.pendingUpgrades <= 0 || !rollLevelUpgrades(player,{all:true}).some(choice => choice.id === id)) return false;
  if(id.startsWith('phrenapates-')||id.startsWith('celestia-')||id.startsWith('swipe-')){if(!applyCharacterSkillUpgrade(player,id))return false;player.pendingUpgrades--;return true;}
  if(id==='bayonet-new'||id==='bayonet-level'){
    player.attackSlots??=[];
    if(id==='bayonet-new'){const empty=player.attackSlots.findIndex(w=>!w);if(empty>=0)player.attackSlots[empty]=createWakamoBayonetWeapon();else player.attackSlots.push(createWakamoBayonetWeapon());}
    else {const w=player.attackSlots.find(w=>w?.id==='wakamo-bayonet');w.level++;recordWeaponMax(player,w);}
    player.pendingUpgrades--;return true;
  }
  if(id==='balloons-new'||id==='balloons-level'){

    else {const w=player.attackSlots.find(w=>w?.id==='bad-cooking');w.level++;recordWeaponMax(player,w);}
    player.pendingUpgrades--;return true;
  }
  if(id.startsWith('sports-')||id.startsWith('malkuth-')||id.startsWith('racer-')||id.startsWith('helmet-')||id.startsWith('jacket-')||id.startsWith('chise-')||id.startsWith('overclock-')||id.startsWith('pharmaceuticals-')) {if(!applyItemUpgrade(player,id))return false;player.pendingUpgrades--;return true;}
  const weapon = id.startsWith('luminous-')?getLuminousNova(player):id.startsWith('aris-') ? getArisWeapon(player) : getUmbrella(player);
  if (id === 'aris-new'||id==='luminous-new') {
    player.attackSlots ??= [];
    const empty = player.attackSlots.findIndex(item => !item);
    const acquired=id==='luminous-new'?createLuminousNovaWeapon():createArisWeapon();
    if (empty >= 0) player.attackSlots[empty] = acquired;
    else player.attackSlots.push(acquired);
  } else if (id === 'aris-level') weapon.level = Math.min(arisWeaponSettings.maxLevel, (weapon.level || 1) + 1);
  else if(id==='luminous-level')weapon.level=Math.min(luminousNovaSettings.maxLevel,(weapon.level||1)+1);
  else if (id === 'umbrella-level') weapon.level = Math.min(umbrellaUpgradeSettings.maxLevel, (weapon.level || 1) + 1);
  else return false;
  recordWeaponMax(player,weapon);
  player.pendingUpgrades--;
  return true;
}

/** Banked bonus only: no extra ATK or critical roll can exceed this component's cap. */
export function luminousNovaFinisherDamage(damageDealt,player) {
  const baseAttack=damageRules.baseScale*totalCharacterATK(player)/100;
  return Math.max(0,Math.min(Math.round(damageDealt*skill.damageFraction*itemSkillDamageMultiplier(player)),Math.floor(baseAttack*skill.attackCapMultiplier)));
}

/** Nominal281% ATK before the normal damage roll; the banked extra is calculated separately. */
export function luminousNovaFinisherBaseDamage(player) {
  return Math.max(0,Math.round(damageRules.baseScale*skill.finisherAttackMultiplier*totalCharacterATK(player)/100*itemSkillDamageMultiplier(player)));
}

/** Equip Kei's automatic weapon and its independent aura EX skill. */
export function createLuminousNovaWeapon() {
  return {id:'luminous-nova',name:'Luminous Nova',level:1,maxLevel:luminousNovaSettings.maxLevel,
    icon:'../sprites/attacks/Weapon_Icon_Kei.png',iconRotation:-45,exSkill:true};
}
export function getLuminousNova(player) {return player.attackSlots?.find(weapon=>weapon?.id==='luminous-nova');}

/** Fire-rate bonuses are absolute multiples of the base cycle, never cumulative multipliers. */
export function luminousNovaLevelStats(player) {
  const level=Math.max(1,Math.min(7,getLuminousNova(player)?.level||1));
  const fireRate=1+Number(level>=3)+Number(level>=5)+Number(level>=7);
  return {level,fireRate,interval:luminousNovaSettings.attackInterval/fireRate,
    damageMultiplier:(level>=2?1.2:1)*(level>=4?1.3:1),knockback:level>=6};
}

/** Damage levels multiply base damage; flat enhancements split over the base-cycle projectile count. */
export function rollLuminousNovaDamage(player,random=Math.random,target) {
  const stats=luminousNovaLevelStats(player);
  return rollAttackDamage(player,totalWeaponDamage(player,'luminous-nova',luminousNovaSettings.damageMultiplier,
    [(stats.damageMultiplier-1)*100],{projectileCount:stats.fireRate,hitCooldownFrames:10}),random,{target});
}

/** Sweep the spherical head so fast plasma rounds cannot tunnel past enemies. */
export function luminousNovaHits(enemy,from,to,radius=luminousNovaSettings.bulletDiameter/2*luminousNovaSettings.bloomRadiusScale) {
  const body=getEnemyHurtbox(enemy);
  return segmentHitsBody({...body,rx:body.rx+radius,ry:body.ry+radius},from.x,from.y,to.x,to.y);
}

/** Independent aimed, unlimited-piercing automatic plasma weapon. */
export function createLuminousNovaAttack({random=Math.random}={}) {
  const s=luminousNovaSettings;
  let owner=null,cooldown=0,bullets=[],enabled=true,shots=0,skillFinishing=false;
  let stationaryScale=1;
  function reset(){stationaryScale=1;owner=null;cooldown=0;bullets=[];shots=0;}
  function fire(player,aim) {
    const origin=getCombatHitbox(player,false);
    // Follow the shared arrow/crosshair aim and keep that direction throughout this shot.
    const angle=player.tuningParts?startingWeaponAim(player,'luminous-nova',Number.isFinite(aim)?aim:0):(Number.isFinite(aim)?aim:0);
    const dx=Math.cos(angle),dy=Math.sin(angle);
    const edge=1/Math.hypot(dx/origin.rx,dy/origin.ry);
    const diameter=s.bulletDiameter*weaponSizeMultiplier(player);
    const offset=edge+s.muzzleGap+diameter/2*s.bloomRadiusScale;
    if(bullets.length<s.maxProjectiles){bullets.push({x:origin.x+dx*offset,y:origin.y+dy*offset,angle,diameter,rainbowPhase:shots*.618,rainbow:player.tuningParts?rgbTuningActive(player):false,age:0,travel:0,accelerating:true,hits:new Map()});shots++;}
    return true;
  }
  /** Move and expire each shot independently; pierce all targets with a per-shot hit cooldown. */
  function advance(delta,player) {
    for(let i=bullets.length-1;i>=0;i--) {
      const bullet=bullets[i],step=Math.min(delta,s.duration-bullet.age),from={x:bullet.x,y:bullet.y};
      // Integrate the speed ramp analytically so acceleration is independent of frame rate.
      const distanceAt=age=>s.projectileSpeed*(age<s.accelerationSeconds?age*age/(2*s.accelerationSeconds):age-s.accelerationSeconds/2);
      const distance=distanceAt(bullet.age+step)-distanceAt(bullet.age);
      bullet.age+=step;bullet.travel+=distance;
      bullet.x+=Math.cos(bullet.angle)*distance;bullet.y+=Math.sin(bullet.angle)*distance;
      for(const enemy of getAllEnemies()) {
        if(bullet.age-(bullet.hits.get(enemy.id)??-Infinity)<s.hitCooldown-1e-8||!luminousNovaHits(enemy,from,bullet,(bullet.diameter??s.bulletDiameter)/2*s.bloomRadiusScale))continue;
        bullet.hits.set(enemy.id,bullet.age); // A missed hit cannot retry every frame.
        const hit=rollLuminousNovaDamage(player,random,enemy);
        const landed=damageEnemy(enemy.id,hit.damage,player,hit.type,{canMiss:true});
        const living=getEnemy(enemy.id);
        if(landed!==false&&living&&luminousNovaLevelStats(player).knockback) {
          const distance=s.knockbackSpeed*s.knockbackSeconds*weaponKnockbackMultiplier(player);
          applySkillControl(living,Math.cos(bullet.angle)*distance,Math.sin(bullet.angle)*distance,
            s.knockbackSeconds,s.knockbackSeconds);
        }
      }
      if(bullet.age>=s.duration-1e-8)bullets.splice(i,1);
    }
  }
  /** Stagger shots over the2.5s base cycle; Haste changes cadence, not lifetime or hit cooldown. */
  function update(delta,player,aim=0) {
    if(!getLuminousNova(player)){reset();return;}
    if(owner!==player){reset();owner=player;}
    const intervalScale=player.tuningParts?stationaryWeaponIntervalScale(player):1;cooldown*=intervalScale/stationaryScale;stationaryScale=intervalScale;
    if(!enabled||delta<=0)return;
    if(skillFinishing){advance(delta,player);return;}
    let remaining=delta;
    while(remaining>1e-8) {
      if(cooldown<=1e-8) {
        fire(player,aim);
        cooldown=attackTimeFormula(luminousNovaLevelStats(player).interval*stationaryScale,ensureCombatStats(player).hastePercent);
      }
      const step=Math.min(remaining,cooldown,s.hitCooldown/2);
      advance(step,player);cooldown=Math.max(0,cooldown-step);remaining-=step;
    }
  }
  /** Draw every active pink round using the shared spherical plasma renderer. */
  function draw(context,camera) {const rainbow=Boolean(owner?.tuningParts&&rgbTuningActive(owner));for(const bullet of bullets){bullet.rainbow=rainbow;drawLuminousPlasma(context,camera,bullet,bullet.diameter);}}
  return {ready:Promise.resolve(),reset,update,draw,
    setSkillFinishing(value){skillFinishing=Boolean(value);},
    setAutoattackEnabled(value){enabled=Boolean(value);if(!enabled)bullets=[];},
    get projectileCount(){return bullets.length;},get shotsFired(){return shots;}};
}


/** Keep a bounded path for steering projectiles; straight bullets retain their existing renderer. */
export function rememberPlasmaTrail(bullet,from,maxLength) {
  const trail=bullet.trail??=[{x:from.x,y:from.y,distance:0}];
  const last=trail.at(-1),step=Math.hypot(bullet.x-last.x,bullet.y-last.y);
  if(step<.25)return;
  trail.push({x:bullet.x,y:bullet.y,distance:last.distance+step});
  while(trail.length>2&&(trail.at(-1).distance-trail[1].distance>maxLength||trail.length>48))trail.shift();
}

/** Convert actual traveled positions to the plasma head's local coordinates, newest first. */
export function plasmaTrailPoints(bullet,maxLength) {
  if(!(bullet.trail?.length>1)||!(maxLength>1e-8))return null;
  const points=[{x:0,y:0,distance:0}],cos=Math.cos(bullet.angle),sin=Math.sin(bullet.angle);
  let previous={x:bullet.x,y:bullet.y},distance=0;
  for(let i=bullet.trail.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    const p=bullet.trail[i],length=Math.hypot(p.x-previous.x,p.y-previous.y);if(length<1e-8)continue;
    const fraction=Math.min(1,(maxLength-distance)/length),x=previous.x+(p.x-previous.x)*fraction,y=previous.y+(p.y-previous.y)*fraction;
    distance+=length*fraction;const dx=x-bullet.x,dy=y-bullet.y;
    points.push({x:dx*cos+dy*sin,y:-dx*sin+dy*cos,distance});
    if(fraction<1||distance>=maxLength)break;previous=p;
  }
  return points.length>1?points:null;
}

/** Shared spherical plasma rendering; the EX changes diameter without changing the normal weapon. */
export function drawLuminousPlasma(context,camera,bullet,diameter=luminousNovaSettings.bulletDiameter,duration=luminousNovaSettings.duration) {
  const s=luminousNovaSettings,radius=diameter/2;
  // Preserve gradient opacity and pale hot highlights while tinting the full plasma effect.
  const tint=value=>{
    if(bullet.rainbow)return rainbowPlasmaColor(value,bullet.age*160+(bullet.rainbowPhase||0)*360);
    if(bullet.color==='orange') {
      const orange=(r,g,b)=>[Number(r),Math.round(80+Number(g)*.60),Math.round(Number(g)*.20)];
      if(value.startsWith('#'))return '#'+orange(parseInt(value.slice(1,3),16),parseInt(value.slice(3,5),16),parseInt(value.slice(5,7),16)).map(n=>n.toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join('');
      return value.replace(/(rgba?\()(\d+),(\d+),(\d+)/,(_,prefix,r,g,b)=>prefix+orange(r,g,b).join(','));
    }
    return bullet.color!=='blue'?value:value.startsWith('#')
      ? '#'+value.slice(3,5)+value.slice(5,7)+value.slice(1,3)
      : value.replace(/(rgba?\()(\d+),(\d+),(\d+)/, '$1$3,$4,$2');
  };
  // Skip the whole effect once both its head and longest wake have left the canvas.
  const reach=radius*(1+s.trailLengthRatio+s.bloomRadiusScale);
  const screenX=bullet.x-camera.x,screenY=bullet.y-camera.y;
  if(context.canvas&&(screenX+reach<0||screenY+reach<0||screenX-reach>context.canvas.width||screenY-reach>context.canvas.height))return;
  context.save();context.translate(bullet.x-camera.x,bullet.y-camera.y);context.rotate(bullet.angle);
  const fadeOut=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,(duration-bullet.age)/(bullet.fadeOutSeconds??.06)));
  const endOpacity=bullet.fadeOutSeconds?fadeOut*fadeOut*(3-2*fadeOut):fadeOut;
  const fade=endOpacity*Math.min(1,bullet.age/s.fadeInSeconds);
  // Only leave a wake along positions reached after acceleration, never behind the muzzle.
  const wakeAge=bullet.accelerating?Math.max(0,bullet.age-s.accelerationSeconds):bullet.age;
  context.globalAlpha=fade;
  context.globalCompositeOperation='lighter';
  // A broad soft halo and a tighter luminous rim keep small shots bright without enlarging their core.
  const halo=context.createRadialGradient(0,0,0,0,0,radius*3.6);
  halo.addColorStop(0,tint('rgba(255,225,252,.95)'));halo.addColorStop(.25,tint('rgba(255,125,229,.75)'));
  halo.addColorStop(.55,tint('rgba(244,48,186,.35)'));halo.addColorStop(1,tint('rgba(220,35,180,0)'));
  context.fillStyle=halo;
  context.beginPath();context.arc(0,0,radius*3.6,0,Math.PI*2);context.fill();
  context.filter='none';
  const rim=context.createRadialGradient(0,0,radius*.5,0,0,radius*1.6);
  rim.addColorStop(0,tint('rgba(255,224,252,.7)'));rim.addColorStop(.45,tint('rgba(255,99,216,.4)'));rim.addColorStop(1,tint('rgba(255,55,196,0)'));
  context.fillStyle=rim;context.beginPath();context.arc(0,0,radius*1.6,0,Math.PI*2);context.fill();
  const trailLength=Math.min(radius*(1+s.trailLengthRatio),(bullet.trailSpeed??bullet.speed??s.projectileSpeed)*wakeAge);
  const path=plasmaTrailPoints(bullet,trailLength),end=path?.at(-1)||{x:-trailLength,y:0};
  const tail=bullet.rainbow?rainbowTrailGradient(context,end.x,end.y,0,0):context.createLinearGradient(end.x,end.y,0,0);
  if(!bullet.rainbow){
  tail.addColorStop(0,tint('rgba(239,61,194,0)'));tail.addColorStop(.15,tint('rgba(255,80,210,.35)'));
  tail.addColorStop(.45,tint('rgba(255,130,230,.75)'));tail.addColorStop(.75,tint('rgba(255,200,248,.95)'));tail.addColorStop(1,tint('#fff5ff'));}
  /** Draw a connected tapered wake behind the spherical head, with a narrow luminous spine. */
  function drawTrail(width) {
    if(path){
      const total=path.at(-1).distance,left=[],right=[];
      for(let i=0;i<path.length;i++){
        const p=path[i],before=path[Math.max(0,i-1)],after=path[Math.min(path.length-1,i+1)];
        const dx=after.x-before.x,dy=after.y-before.y,length=Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1;
        const half=radius*width*(1-p.distance/total);
        left.push({x:p.x-dy/length*half,y:p.y+dx/length*half});right.push({x:p.x+dy/length*half,y:p.y-dx/length*half});
      }
      context.beginPath();context.moveTo(left[0].x,left[0].y);
      for(const p of left.slice(1))context.lineTo(p.x,p.y);
      for(let i=right.length-1;i>=0;i--)context.lineTo(right[i].x,right[i].y);
      context.fill();return;
    }
    context.beginPath();context.moveTo(-trailLength,0);
    context.bezierCurveTo(-trailLength*.65,-radius*width*.2,-radius*1.4,-radius*width,0,-radius*width);
    context.lineTo(0,radius*width);
    context.bezierCurveTo(-radius*1.4,radius*width,-trailLength*.65,radius*width*.2,-trailLength,0);context.fill();
  }
  // Wide additive bloom underneath the bright tail makes its fading gradient feel emissive.
  context.fillStyle=tail;context.globalAlpha=fade*.65;
  drawTrail(2.2);
  context.globalAlpha=fade;
  drawTrail(1.15);
  context.filter='none';drawTrail(.7);
  // A second thin pass reads as hot plasma rather than a translucent flat tail.
  drawTrail(.22);
  // Pure additive light fades to transparency: no opaque sphere, colored rim or hard outline.
  const light=context.createRadialGradient(0,0,0,0,0,radius*2);
  light.addColorStop(0,tint('rgba(255,250,255,.95)'));
  light.addColorStop(.2,tint('rgba(255,235,252,.8)'));
  light.addColorStop(.45,tint('rgba(255,185,239,.45)'));
  light.addColorStop(.7,tint('rgba(255,125,220,.15)'));
  light.addColorStop(1,tint('rgba(255,100,210,0)'));
  context.fillStyle=light;
  context.beginPath();context.arc(0,0,radius*2,0,Math.PI*2);context.fill();context.restore();

}

import {tuningPerk} from './tuning-parts.js';
import {spawnTestDrop} from './exp-drops.js';
/** Damage adds whole percentage points and sets the inclusive extra-Credits range. */
export function luxeryTuningValues(damage,baseChancePercent){
  const bonus=Math.floor(Math.min(100,Math.max(0,damage))/10);
  return {chance:(baseChancePercent+bonus)/100,maxExtraCredits:bonus};
}
export function tryLuxeryTuningHit({player,enemy,damage,random=Math.random,weaponId='plana-umbrella'}){
  const main=player.mainWeaponId??(player.label==='Plana'?'plana-umbrella':null);
  if(main!==weaponId||!player.tuningParts||!(damage>0))return false;
  const base=tuningPerk(player.tuningParts,'creditChancePercent');if(!base)return false;
  const {chance,maxExtraCredits}=luxeryTuningValues(damage,base);if(random()>=chance)return false;
  const value=1+Math.min(maxExtraCredits,Math.floor(random()*(maxExtraCredits+1)));
  return spawnTestDrop('credits',value,enemy.x,enemy.y);
}

export function createMaidForceAttack({random=Math.random}={}){
 const s=maidForceSettings;let owner=null,enabled=true,cooldown=0,time=0,scents=[],shots=0,spreads=0;

export { trackVolumeScale } from './game-config.js';
// Stream only the current and fading-out music; never decode whole long tracks.

// Per-track source volume at 100% on the master slider.


/** Manage gesture-started looping music, volume, and map-change crossfades. */
export function createMapAudio(initialMap, { menu = false } = {}) {
  const slider = document.querySelector('#music-volume');
  const soundtrackToggle = document.querySelector('#music-soundtrack-toggle');
  const output = document.querySelector('#music-volume-value');
  const button = document.querySelector('#music-toggle');
  const status = document.querySelector('#music-status');
  const fadeDuration = 900; // EDIT milliseconds to match the checkerboard ripple.
  const tracks = new Map();
  let mapId = initialMap;
  let menuActive = menu;
  let secondary = false;

  /** Resolve the selected stage within its soundtrack bank. */
  function selectedTrack() {
    if(menuActive)return {id:'menu:main',file:'main.mp3'};
    const file = (secondary ? secondaryMapTracks : mapTracks)[mapId];
    return { id: `${secondary ? 'secondary' : 'default'}:${mapId}`, file };
  }
  let volume = Number(slider.value) / 100;
  let enabled = true;
  let unlocked = false;
  let disposed = false;
  let blocked = false;

  /** Stop, rewind, and release the media source once its fade has finished. */
  function stopTrack(id, track) {
    track.audio.pause();
    track.audio.currentTime = 0;
    track.audio.removeAttribute('src');
    track.audio.load();
    tracks.delete(id);
  }

  /** Start only the selected map track, fading every previous one toward silence. */
  function selectTrack() {
    for (const track of tracks.values()) {
      track.from = track.gain;
      track.target = 0;
      track.elapsed = 0;
    }
    if (!unlocked || !enabled || disposed) return;
    const selection = selectedTrack();
    if (!selection.file) return;
    let track = tracks.get(selection.id);
    if (!track) {
      const audio = new Audio();
      audio.preload = 'none';
      audio.loop = true;
      audio.volume = 0;
      audio.src = `../Audio/${selection.file.split('/').map(encodeURIComponent).join('/')}`;
      track = { audio, gain: 0, from: 0, target: 1, elapsed: 0, volumeScale: menuActive ? 1 : trackVolumeScale[mapId] };
      tracks.set(selection.id, track);
      const trackId = selection.id;
      audio.addEventListener('error', () => {
        if (selectedTrack().id === trackId) status.textContent = `Could not load ${selection.file}.`;
      });
    }
    track.from = track.gain;
    track.target = 1;
    track.elapsed = 0;
    const selectedId = selection.id;
    track.audio.play().then(() => {
      if (selectedTrack().id === selectedId && enabled) {
        blocked = false;
        status.textContent = selection.file;
      }
    }).catch(() => {
      if (selectedTrack().id === selectedId) {
        blocked = true;
        button.textContent = 'Play music';
        status.textContent = 'Press Play music to enable audio.';
      }
    });
  }

  /** Crossfade to a new map without keeping inactive long recordings playing. */
  function setMap(id) {
    if (!mapTracks[id] || id === mapId) return;
    mapId = id;
    if(!menuActive)selectTrack();
  }

  /** Advance smooth gains and unload tracks that are no longer in use. */
  function update(delta) {
    for (const [id, track] of tracks) {
      track.elapsed += delta * 1000;
      const t = Math.min(1, track.elapsed / fadeDuration);
      const eased = t * t * (3 - 2 * t);
      track.gain = track.from + (track.target - track.from) * eased;
      track.audio.volume = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, volume * track.volumeScale * track.gain));
      if (t === 1 && track.target === 0) stopTrack(id, track);
    }
  }

  /** Honor browser audio activation by starting on the first user gesture. */
  function unlock(event) {
    if (event.target?.closest?.('#music-toggle')) return;
    if (unlocked || disposed) return;
    unlocked = true;
    selectTrack();
  }
  document.addEventListener('pointerdown', unlock, { once: true });
  window.addEventListener('keydown', unlock, { once: true, capture: true });

  slider.addEventListener('input', () => {
    volume = Number(slider.value) / 100;
    output.textContent = `${slider.value}%`;
    slider.style.setProperty('--volume-fill', `${slider.value}%`);
    for (const track of tracks.values()) track.audio.volume = volume * track.volumeScale * track.gain;
  });
  soundtrackToggle.addEventListener('click', () => {
    secondary = !secondary;
    soundtrackToggle.textContent = secondary ? 'Audio: Secondary' : 'Audio: Default';
    soundtrackToggle.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(secondary));
    // This explicit gesture also unlocks playback, preserving the mute/pause setting.
    unlocked = true;
    if(!menuActive)selectTrack();
  });
  button.addEventListener('click', () => {
    // The first explicit click enables playback; later clicks toggle it.
    if (!unlocked || blocked) { unlocked = true; enabled = true; blocked = false; }
    else enabled = !enabled;
    button.textContent = enabled ? 'Pause music' : 'Play music';
    button.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(enabled));
    selectTrack();
  });

  /** Release every track immediately when leaving the preview. */
  function stopAll() {
    disposed = true;
    for (const [id, track] of tracks) stopTrack(id, track);
  }
  window.addEventListener('pagehide', stopAll);
  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => {
    if (!document.hidden) return;
    // Animation frames may pause in background tabs: don't leave old music playing.
    for (const [id, track] of tracks) {
      if (track.target === 0) stopTrack(id, track);
    }
  });
  output.textContent = `${slider.value}%`;
  function setMenu(active){if(menuActive===Boolean(active))return;menuActive=Boolean(active);selectTrack();}
  return { setMap, setMenu, update, stopAll };
}

--- SNAPSHOT FILE: Development/map-bounds.js | sha256=9a1a08dda8ec90138f327abc3b8694e52f8392832542f2d49b413803c221c50f | encoding=utf-8-sig ---
import { mapSizeMultiplier, officeWindowInsetSource } from './game-config.js';
export { mapSizeMultiplier } from './game-config.js';
// Map zoom is configured independently of actors in game-config.js.


/** Physical playable limits for the enlarged horizontal/vertical strip maps. */
export function stripMapBounds(map, width, height, topPadding = 0, bottomPadding = 0) {
  if (map.axis === 'horizontal') return {
    left: -Infinity, right: Infinity,
    top: map.originY + topPadding + officeWindowInsetSource * height * mapSizeMultiplier / 1086,
    bottom: map.originY + height * mapSizeMultiplier - bottomPadding
  };
  if (map.axis !== 'vertical') return { left: -Infinity, right: Infinity, top: -Infinity, bottom: Infinity };
  return {
    left: map.originX + width * mapSizeMultiplier * (map.leftWallRatio || 0),
    right: map.originX + width * mapSizeMultiplier * (map.rightWallRatio ?? 1),
    top: -Infinity, bottom: Infinity
  };
}

/** Stop the camera at finite edges while leaving the long map axis infinite. */
export function clampStripCamera(map, camera, width, height) {
  if (map.axis === 'horizontal') camera.y = Math.max(map.originY,
    Math.min(map.originY + height * (mapSizeMultiplier - 1), camera.y));
  if (map.axis === 'vertical') camera.x = Math.max(map.originX,
    Math.min(map.originX + width * (mapSizeMultiplier - 1), camera.x));
}

/** Keep enlarged enemy spawns inside physical walls, independent of the camera. */
export function canSpawnInStrip(character, x, y, bounds, defaultSize = 112) {
  const margin = (character.spriteSize || defaultSize) / 2;
  return x >= bounds.left + margin && x <= bounds.right - margin &&
    y >= bounds.top + margin && y <= bounds.bottom - margin;
}

--- SNAPSHOT FILE: Development/map-transition.js | sha256=26f8084065305b7507aa61e67fb5efd8ea3380adcdc576e57d40005ce0959be4 | encoding=utf-8-sig ---
/** Radial stagger plus checkerboard parity gives each tile its own shrink phase. */
export function shrinkProgress(elapsed, column, row, columns, rows) {
  const radius = Math.hypot(column - (columns - 1) / 2, row - (rows - 1) / 2);
  const delay = radius * 45 + ((column + row) % 2) * 55;
  return Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (elapsed - delay) / 420));
}

/** Capture the old background and shrink its tiles away in a checker ripple. */
export function createMapTransition(canvas) {
  let oldScreen;
  let elapsed = 0;
  let renderOldBackground;
  const columns = 12; // EDIT checkerboard density.
  const rows = 7;
  const reducedMotion = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;

  /** Snapshot a rendered frame once, rather than allocating images every tick. */
  function snapshot() {
    const image = document.createElement('canvas');
    image.width = canvas.width;
    image.height = canvas.height;
    image.getContext('2d').drawImage(canvas, 0, 0);
    return image;
  }

  /** Capture the old background after it is drawn without entities or UI. */
  function begin(renderBackground) {
    if (oldScreen) return false;
    oldScreen = snapshot();
    renderOldBackground = renderBackground;
    elapsed = 0;
    return true;
  }

  /** Shrink old-map squares over the new background; entities/UI are drawn afterward. */
  function draw(context, delta) {
    if (!oldScreen) return;
    elapsed += delta * 1000;
    if (reducedMotion || elapsed >= 900) {
      oldScreen = null;
      renderOldBackground = null;
      return;
    }
    // Reuse one surface, but repaint the outgoing map at the LIVE camera origin.
    // A frozen snapshot would make characters slide over stationary scenery.
    if (renderOldBackground) {
      const layer = oldScreen.getContext('2d');
      layer.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
      renderOldBackground(layer);
    }
    context.save();
    // The new background is already drawn beneath us; leave the gaps transparent.
    for (let row = 0; row < rows; row++) {
      for (let column = 0; column < columns; column++) {
        const p = shrinkProgress(elapsed, column, row, columns, rows);
        const x = Math.round(column * canvas.width / columns);
        const y = Math.round(row * canvas.height / rows);
        const width = Math.round((column + 1) * canvas.width / columns) - x;
        const height = Math.round((row + 1) * canvas.height / rows) - y;
        const scale = 1 - p * p * (3 - 2 * p); // Smoothly shrink from full size to zero.
        if (scale <= 0) continue;
        context.save();
        context.translate(x + width / 2, y + height / 2);
        context.scale(scale, scale);
        context.drawImage(oldScreen,
          x, y, width, height, -width / 2, -height / 2, width, height);
        context.restore();
      }
    }
    context.restore();
  }

  /** Discard viewport-sized imagery when the screen is resized. */
  function cancel() {
    oldScreen = null;
    renderOldBackground = null;
  }
  return { begin, draw, cancel, get active() { return Boolean(oldScreen); } };
}

--- SNAPSHOT FILE: Development/midori.js | sha256=e66a593b26238ef4e634a9e286ab571e36836a3a7d88461cd709dd3e6b64920d | encoding=utf-8-sig ---
import { midoriSettings, playerSettings } from './game-config.js';
import { getCombatHitbox } from './combat-hitboxes.js';
import { statMultiplier } from './combat-stats.js';

/** Match the configured fraction of the controlled player's current movement speed, including SPD upgrades. */
export function midoriSpeed(player, baseSpeed = playerSettings.movementBase) {
  return baseSpeed * (player.movementSpeedMultiplier || 1) *
    statMultiplier(player, 'spdPercent') * midoriSettings.speedRatio;
}

/** Roll once per close-range player attack, never for admin damage or distant attacks. */
export function midoriDodges(enemy, source, random = Math.random) {
  return enemy.type === 'midori' && source &&
    Math.hypot(enemy.x - source.x, enemy.y - source.y) <= midoriSettings.closeRange &&
    random() < midoriSettings.missChance;
}

/** Aim the foot hitbox at the player's body center rather than aligning sprite anchors. */
export function midoriChaseTarget(enemy, player) {
  const feet = getCombatHitbox(enemy, true);
  const target = getCombatHitbox(player, false);
  return { x: target.x - (feet.x - enemy.x), y: target.y - (feet.y - enemy.y) };
}

--- SNAPSHOT FILE: Development/mini-bosses.js | sha256=6841e0d71418886c0c0757d6ea6df091b9c1538a7ac3da1ded040c4657dbe688 | encoding=utf-8-sig ---
import { enemyTypeStats, eliteSizeMultiplier } from './game-config.js';
import { combatHitboxes } from './combat-hitboxes.js';
import { normalSpriteSize } from './scene-metrics.js';

/** Mega Mob shares Mob's animation and body geometry, enlarged for mini-boss visibility. */
export function createMegaMob(template) {
  return {...template,label:'Mega Mob',miniBoss:true,boss:false,standard:false,special:true,
    spriteSize:(template.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize)*(template.megaSizeMultiplier ?? eliteSizeMultiplier),
    combatHitbox:combatHitboxes.mob};
}

/** Retry blocked/full-population placements; consume the one-shot only on success. */
export function createMiniBossSchedule() {
  const spawned = new Set();
  return { update(seconds, spawn) {
    for (const [type, profile] of Object.entries(enemyTypeStats)) {
      if (!['megaMob','megaSweeper'].includes(type) || profile.spawnAtSeconds == null || seconds < profile.spawnAtSeconds || spawned.has(type)) continue;
      if (spawn(type)) spawned.add(type);
    }
  }};
}


/** Mega Sweeper uses the existing Sweeper art/animation at the former elite scale. */
export function createMegaSweeper(template) {
  return {...createMegaMob(template),label:'Mega Sweeper'};
}

export function drawMolotovNapalm(context,camera,zone){

--- SNAPSHOT FILE: Development/molotov-cocktail.js | sha256=3dbed9b2101d37930ca116df3208de69543ff9f712510df7869eeb742db69e59 | encoding=utf-8-sig ---
import { weaponSizeMultiplier, weaponKnockbackMultiplier } from './game-config.js';
import { molotovSettings, molotovLevelStats, attackTimeFormula } from './game-config.js';
import { ensureCombatStats, totalWeaponDamage, rollAttackDamage } from './combat-stats.js';
import { stationaryWeaponIntervalScale } from './tuning-parts.js';
import { getAllEnemies, damageEnemy } from './world-state.js';
import { getCombatHitbox, getEnemyHurtbox } from './combat-hitboxes.js';
import { molotovAnimationReady, drawMolotovNapalm } from './molotov-animation.js';

/** Explicit fallback odds: 30% close, 60% middle, 10% far; randomized within each band. */
export function molotovThrowDistance(random=Math.random){
 const u=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,random()));
 if(u<.3)return .05+.25*(u/.3);
 if(u<.9)return .3+.4*((u-.3)/.6);
 return .7+.3*((u-.9)/.1);
}

/** Prefer the nearest enemy in the middle 30-80% of directional screen reach. */
export function molotovLandingPoint(body,view,enemies,random=Math.random){
 const pad=Math.max(view.width,view.height)*.15;
 function reach(angle){const dx=Math.cos(angle),dy=Math.sin(angle);
  const edgeX=Math.abs(dx)>1e-8?((dx>0?view.x+view.width+pad:view.x-pad)-body.x)/dx:Infinity;
  const edgeY=Math.abs(dy)>1e-8?((dy>0?view.y+view.height+pad:view.y-pad)-body.y)/dy:Infinity;
  return Math.max(20,Math.min(edgeX,edgeY));
 }
 let nearest=null,nearestDistance=Infinity;
 for(const enemy of enemies){
  const target=getEnemyHurtbox(enemy),dx=target.x-body.x,dy=target.y-body.y,distance=Math.hypot(dx,dy);
  const fraction=distance/reach(Math.atan2(dy,dx));
  if(fraction>=.3&&fraction<=.8&&distance<nearestDistance){nearest=target;nearestDistance=distance;}
 }
 if(nearest)return {x:nearest.x,y:nearest.y};
 const angle=random()*Math.PI*2,distance=reach(angle)*molotovThrowDistance(random);
 return {x:body.x+Math.cos(angle)*distance,y:body.y+Math.sin(angle)*distance};
}

export function createMolotovAttack({random=Math.random}={}){
 let owner=null,cooldown=0,time=0,enabled=true,throws=[],fires=[],shots=0;
 function reset(){owner=null;cooldown=0;time=0;throws=[];fires=[];shots=0;}
 function launch(player,stats,viewport){
  const body=getCombatHitbox(player,false),view=viewport||{x:body.x-640,y:body.y-360,width:1280,height:720};
  const enemies=getAllEnemies();
  for(let i=0;i<stats.count;i++){
   const {x,y}=molotovLandingPoint(body,view,enemies,random);
   throws.push({x:body.x,y:body.y,fromX:body.x,fromY:body.y,toX:x,toY:y,age:0,
    flight:Math.max(.12,Math.hypot(x-body.x,y-body.y)/molotovSettings.speed),
    radius:stats.radius*weaponSizeMultiplier(player),duration:stats.duration,damageBonuses:stats.damageBonuses,count:stats.count});shots++;
  }
 }
 function update(delta,player,viewport=null){
  const weapon=player.attackSlots?.find(w=>w?.id==='molotov-cocktail');if(!weapon){reset();return;}
  if(owner!==player){reset();owner=player;}if(delta<=0)return;
  let left=delta;
  while(left>1e-8){
   if(enabled&&cooldown<=1e-8){launch(player,molotovLevelStats(weapon.level),viewport);cooldown=attackTimeFormula(molotovSettings.interval*(player.tuningParts?stationaryWeaponIntervalScale(player):1),ensureCombatStats(player).hastePercent);}
   const step=Math.min(left,1/60,enabled&&cooldown>1e-8?cooldown:1/60);left-=step;time+=step;cooldown=Math.max(0,cooldown-step);
   for(let i=throws.length-1;i>=0;i--){const b=throws[i];b.age+=step;const progress=Math.min(1,b.age/b.flight);b.x=b.fromX+(b.toX-b.fromX)*progress;b.y=b.fromY+(b.toY-b.fromY)*progress;
    if(progress>=1){fires.push({...b,x:b.toX,y:b.toY,age:0,hits:new Map()});throws.splice(i,1);}}
   const enemies=getAllEnemies(),living=new Set(enemies.map(e=>e.id));
   for(let i=fires.length-1;i>=0;i--){const zone=fires[i];zone.age+=step;
    if(zone.age>=zone.duration){fires.splice(i,1);continue;}
    for(const id of zone.hits.keys())if(!living.has(id))zone.hits.delete(id);
    for(const enemy of enemies){if(time-(zone.hits.get(enemy.id)??-Infinity)<molotovSettings.hitCooldown-1e-8)continue;
     const t=getEnemyHurtbox(enemy),dx=t.x-zone.x,dy=t.y-zone.y,distance=Math.hypot(dx,dy),extent=distance?1/Math.hypot(dx/distance/t.rx,dy/distance/t.ry):0;
     if(distance>zone.radius+extent)continue;zone.hits.set(enemy.id,time);
     const hit=rollAttackDamage(player,totalWeaponDamage(player,'molotov-cocktail',molotovSettings.damage,zone.damageBonuses,{projectileCount:zone.count,hitCooldownFrames:45}),random,{target:enemy,weaponId:'molotov-cocktail'});
     damageEnemy(enemy.id,hit.damage,player,hit.type,{canMiss:true});
    }
   }
  }
 }
 function drawGround(context,camera){for(const zone of fires)drawMolotovNapalm(context,camera,zone);}
 function drawThrows(context,camera){context.save();for(const b of throws){const arc=Math.sin(Math.PI*b.age/b.flight)*45;
  context.save();context.translate(b.x-camera.x,b.y-camera.y-arc);context.rotate(b.age*7);context.fillStyle='#746533';context.fillRect(-4,-7,8,14);context.fillStyle='#d3cca5';context.fillRect(-2,-11,4,5);context.fillStyle='#ffb64d';context.fillRect(-2,-14,4,4);context.restore();}context.restore();}
 return {ready:molotovAnimationReady,reset,update,drawGround,drawThrows,setAutoattackEnabled(value){enabled=Boolean(value);},get shotsFired(){return shots;},get fireCount(){return fires.length;},get projectileCount(){return throws.length;}};
}

import { moustacheMedalSettings, moustacheMedalLevelStats, flatCharacterWeaponBonus, attackTimeFormula, weaponSizeMultiplier, weaponKnockbackMultiplier } from './game-config.js';
import { ensureCombatStats, totalWeaponDamage, rollAttackDamage } from './combat-stats.js';
import { stationaryWeaponIntervalScale } from './tuning-parts.js';
import { getAllEnemies, getEnemy, damageEnemy } from './world-state.js';
import { getCombatHitbox, getEnemyHurtbox, segmentHitsBody } from './combat-hitboxes.js';
import { createEnemySpatialIndex } from './enemy-spatial-index.js';
import { beginKnockback } from './knockback.js';

/** Movement-facing rear/side directions never aim a wall forward, including diagonal movement. */
export function moustacheMedalAngles(direction=[0,1],level=1){const facing=Math.atan2(direction[1],direction[0]),rear=facing+Math.PI;return level>=7?[rear,rear-Math.PI/2,rear+Math.PI/2]:[rear];}
export function createMoustacheMedalAttack({random=Math.random}={}){
 const s=moustacheMedalSettings;let owner=null,enabled=true,cooldown=0,time=0,walls=[],shots=0;
 const ready=Promise.resolve();
 function reset(){owner=null;cooldown=0;time=0;walls=[];shots=0;}
 function fire(player,weapon,direction){
  const stats=moustacheMedalLevelStats(weapon.level,flatCharacterWeaponBonus(player)>1),center=getCombatHitbox(player,false),area=stats.size*weaponSizeMultiplier(player);
  const angles=moustacheMedalAngles(direction,weapon.level);
  for(const angle of angles){walls.push({x:center.x,y:center.y,fromX:center.x,fromY:center.y,angle,age:0,distance:stats.distance,area,count:angles.length,damageBonuses:stats.damageBonuses,hits:new Map()});shots++;}
 }
 function update(delta,player,direction=[0,1]){
  const weapon=player.attackSlots?.find(w=>w?.id==='moustache-medal');if(!weapon){reset();return;}
  if(owner!==player){reset();owner=player;}if(!(delta>0))return;
  let left=delta,index=null;
  while(left>1e-8){
   if(enabled&&cooldown<=1e-8){fire(player,weapon,direction);const stats=moustacheMedalLevelStats(weapon.level);cooldown=attackTimeFormula(stats.interval*(player.tuningParts?stationaryWeaponIntervalScale(player):1),ensureCombatStats(player).hastePercent);}
   const dt=Math.min(left,1/120,enabled&&cooldown>1e-8?cooldown:1/120);left-=dt;time+=dt;cooldown=Math.max(0,cooldown-dt);
   if(!walls.length)continue;if(!index)index=createEnemySpatialIndex(getAllEnemies(),getEnemyHurtbox);
   for(let i=walls.length-1;i>=0;i--){const b=walls[i],from={x:b.x,y:b.y};b.age+=dt;if(b.age>s.duration+1e-8){walls.splice(i,1);continue;}
    const travel=Math.min(b.distance,b.age*s.speed);b.x=b.fromX+Math.cos(b.angle)*travel;b.y=b.fromY+Math.sin(b.angle)*travel;
    const radius=s.hitRadius*b.area;
    const candidates=index.querySegment(from,b,radius).filter(enemy=>{if(!getEnemy(enemy.id)||time-(b.hits.get(enemy.id)??-Infinity)<s.hitCooldown-1e-8)return false;const body=getEnemyHurtbox(enemy);return segmentHitsBody({...body,rx:body.rx+radius,ry:body.ry+radius},from.x,from.y,b.x,b.y);});
    for(const enemy of candidates){
     if(!getEnemy(enemy.id))continue;b.hits.set(enemy.id,time);
     const hit=rollAttackDamage(player,totalWeaponDamage(player,'moustache-medal',s.damage,b.damageBonuses,{projectileCount:b.count,hitCooldownFrames:s.hitCooldown*60}),random,{target:enemy,weaponId:'moustache-medal'});
     if(damageEnemy(enemy.id,hit.damage,player,hit.type,{canMiss:true,weaponId:'moustache-medal'})===false)continue;
     const target=getEnemy(enemy.id);if(target){const distance=s.knockbackSpeed*s.knockbackSeconds*weaponKnockbackMultiplier(player),motion=beginKnockback(target,Math.cos(b.angle)*distance,Math.sin(b.angle)*distance,s.knockbackSeconds);
      if(motion){target.skillKnockback=motion;target.knockbackMovementRemaining=Math.max(target.knockbackMovementRemaining||0,s.knockbackSeconds);}
     }
    }
    if(b.age>=s.duration-1e-8)walls.splice(i,1);
   }
  }
 }
 function draw(context,camera){
  for(const b of walls){
   context.save();context.globalAlpha=Math.min(1,b.age/.12,(s.duration-b.age)/.2);
   context.translate(b.x-camera.x,b.y-camera.y);context.rotate(b.angle+Math.PI/2);context.scale(b.area,b.area);
   const w=s.width,h=s.height;
   // Broad armored shield seen from above; its long edge blocks the travel direction.
   context.fillStyle='rgba(6,15,29,.25)';context.fillRect(-w/2+2,-h/2+5,w,h);
   const rim=context.createLinearGradient(0,-h/2,0,h/2);rim.addColorStop(0,'#fff0a8');rim.addColorStop(.35,'#e2bf54');rim.addColorStop(1,'#806327');
   context.fillStyle=rim;context.fillRect(-w/2,-h/2,w,h);
   const armor=context.createLinearGradient(0,-h/2,0,h/2);armor.addColorStop(0,'#c6d4e0');armor.addColorStop(.45,'#72869a');armor.addColorStop(1,'#34465b');
   context.fillStyle=armor;context.fillRect(-w/2+4,-h/2+3,w-8,h-6);
   context.strokeStyle='#f2f6f8';context.lineWidth=1;context.strokeRect(-w/2+4,-h/2+3,w-8,h-6);
   context.fillStyle='#243b53';context.fillRect(-w*.28,-h*.2,w*.56,h*.4);
   context.fillStyle='#f6dc79';context.fillRect(-3,-h/2+2,6,h-4);
   context.fillStyle='#d8e4eb';for(const x of [-w*.36,w*.36]){context.fillRect(x-2,-h/2+3,4,h-6);}
   context.restore();
  }
 }
 return {ready,update,draw,reset,setAutoattackEnabled(value){enabled=Boolean(value);},get shotsFired(){return shots;},get projectileCount(){return walls.length;}};
}

/** Switch only the background/scrolling axis; entities keep their world positions. */
function switchMap(targetMap = null) {
  const carryStageFiles=Boolean(pendingStageTransition&&targetMap===pendingStageTransition);
  if (!mapTransition || mapTransition.active || !maps.first.image) return;
  planaSkill?.reset();
  arisAttack?.reset();
  luminousAttack?.reset();
  badCookingAttack?.reset();
  waterDousingAttack?.reset();
  swipeSkill?.reset();
  beanBagBombAttack?.reset();
  throwingCardsAttack?.reset();
  studentHandbookAttack?.reset();
  moustacheMedalAttack?.reset();
  wakamoBayonetAttack?.reset();
  cheeringBalloonsAttack?.reset();
  maidForceAttack?.reset();
  timeToSurfAttack?.reset();
  serveAttack?.reset();
  orbitalCompassAttack?.reset();
  molotovAttack?.reset();
  saintPredatorAttack?.reset();
  safetyHelmetEffects?.reset();
  princessAttack?.reset();
  decagrammatonAttack?.reset();decagrammatonUltimate?.reset();
  princessSkill?.reset();
  // Snapshot BACKGROUND ONLY. Characters, NPCs, and aim graphics are drawn later.
  context.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
  drawPlayarea();
  molotovAttack?.drawGround(context,camera);
  const outgoingMap = currentMap;
  mapTransition.begin(layer => drawPlayarea(layer, outgoingMap));
  const player = characters[selected];
  // Retain the current camera origin and player screen position on the new axis.
  cameraAnchor.x = player.x - camera.x;
  cameraAnchor.y = player.y - camera.y;
  const mapOrder = ['first', 'second', 'third', 'fourth'].filter(id => !maps[id].disabled);
  const requested = typeof targetMap === 'string' && maps[targetMap] && !maps[targetMap].disabled
    ? targetMap : mapOrder[(mapOrder.indexOf(currentMap) + 1) % mapOrder.length];
  if (currentMap !== requested) stageEnteredAt = survivalClock.seconds;
  currentMap = requested;
  if (campaignSettings.enabled && !endlessMode) campaignSchedule.setStage(currentMap);
  if (currentMap === 'fourth' && !maps.fourth.placed) {
    // Anchor the island's open central plaza under the player on first entry.
    // This positions the MAP, preserving existing player/NPC world coordinates.
    maps.fourth.originX = player.x - 740 * islandScale;
    maps.fourth.originY = player.y + (player.spriteSize || spriteSize) / 2 - spritePadding - 620 * islandScale;
    maps.fourth.placed = true;
  }
  // Align the new map on its locked axis at the retained camera origin.
  if (maps[currentMap].axis === 'vertical') maps[currentMap].originX = camera.x;
  else if (maps[currentMap].axis === 'horizontal') maps[currentMap].originY = camera.y;
  updateCamera();
  npcTools?.cleanup();
  expPickups?.clear();
  crafters?.clear();
  tuningParts?.clear();
  superSynergy?.relocate();
  clearTuningExplosions();
  goldenCrafters?.clear();
  awaitingFileStageAdvance=false;
  if(carryStageFiles)gachaFiles?.relocate(player.x,player.y);
  else gachaFiles?.clear();
  mapAudio?.setMap(currentMap);
  // Keep held inputs, attack timers, AI and aiming live throughout the transition.
  document.querySelector('#switch-map').textContent = `Switch map (current: ${maps[currentMap].label})`;
  return true;
}

document.querySelector('#switch-map').addEventListener('click', switchMap);

/** Reset character positions and horizontal camera without changing sprite settings. */
function resetScene() {
  pendingStageTransition=null;stageTransitionDelay=0;
  planaSkill?.reset();
  arisAttack?.reset();
  luminousAttack?.reset();
  badCookingAttack?.reset();
  waterDousingAttack?.reset();
  swipeSkill?.reset();
  beanBagBombAttack?.reset();
  throwingCardsAttack?.reset();
  studentHandbookAttack?.reset();
  moustacheMedalAttack?.reset();
  wakamoBayonetAttack?.reset();
  cheeringBalloonsAttack?.reset();
  maidForceAttack?.reset();
  timeToSurfAttack?.reset();
  serveAttack?.reset();
  orbitalCompassAttack?.reset();
  molotovAttack?.reset();
  saintPredatorAttack?.reset();
  safetyHelmetEffects?.reset();
  princessAttack?.reset();
  decagrammatonAttack?.reset();decagrammatonUltimate?.reset();
  princessSkill?.reset();
  umbrellaAttack?.reset();
  aiming?.reset();
  releaseControls();
  for (const character of Object.values(characters)) {
    character.x = canvas.width * 0.4;
    character.y = canvas.height * 0.6;
    if (currentMap === 'first') character.y += maps.first.originY;
    if (currentMap === 'second') character.x += maps.second.originX;
    if (currentMap === 'fourth') {
      character.x = maps.fourth.originX + 740 * islandScale;
      character.y = maps.fourth.originY + 620 * islandScale - (character.spriteSize || spriteSize) / 2 + spritePadding;
    }
    character.direction = character.defaultDirection || 'down';
    if (character.horizontalFacingOnly) character.facing = character.direction;
    character.elapsed = 0;
    character.moving = false;
    character.attack = null;
    character.transition = null;
  }
  camera.x = 0;
  camera.y = 0;
  cameraAnchor.x = canvas.width / 2;
  cameraAnchor.y = canvas.height / 2;
  updateCamera();
  updateAttackControls();
}

/** Follow the active character through positive and negative world coordinates. */
function updateCamera(delta = 0) {
  // Ease the retained screen anchor toward center after changing map axes.
  // World coordinates never change; the entire scene follows the same camera.
  const blend = 1 - Math.exp(-cameraRecenterSpeed * delta);
  cameraAnchor.x += (canvas.width / 2 - cameraAnchor.x) * blend;
  cameraAnchor.y += (canvas.height / 2 - cameraAnchor.y) * blend;
  camera.x = characters[selected].x - cameraAnchor.x;
  camera.y = characters[selected].y - cameraAnchor.y;
  clampStripCamera(maps[currentMap], camera, canvas.width, canvas.height);
  if (currentMap === 'fourth') {
    const map = maps.fourth;
    camera.x = Math.max(map.originX, Math.min(map.originX + islandWidth - canvas.width, camera.x));
    camera.y = Math.max(map.originY, Math.min(map.originY + islandHeight - canvas.height, camera.y));
  }
}

/** Compute only visible tile indices, including negative indices left of origin. */
function getVisibleTileRange(cameraX, viewportWidth, tileWidth) {
  return {
    first: Math.floor(cameraX / tileWidth),
    last: Math.ceil((cameraX + viewportWidth) / tileWidth) - 1
  };
}

/** Render a bounded number of tiles from one shared image, however far we travel. */
function drawPlayarea(target = context, mapId = currentMap) {
  const map = maps[mapId];
  if (mapId === 'first') {
    drawOfficeWorld(target, map, camera, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    return;
  }
  if (mapId === 'second') {
    drawPalaceWorld(target, map, camera, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    return;
  }
  if (map.axis === 'island') {
    target.fillStyle = '#087fb9';
    target.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    drawIsland(target, map, camera);
    return;
  }
  if (map.axis === 'both') {
    drawTileWorld(target, map.tiles, camera, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    return;
  }
  const scale = map.axis === 'horizontal'
    ? canvas.height * mapSizeMultiplier / map.image.naturalHeight
    : canvas.width * mapSizeMultiplier / map.image.naturalWidth;
  const tileWidth = map.image.naturalWidth * scale;
  const tileHeight = map.image.naturalHeight * scale;
  const offsetX = camera.x - map.originX;
  const offsetY = camera.y - map.originY;
  const columns = getVisibleTileRange(offsetX, canvas.width, tileWidth);
  const rows = getVisibleTileRange(offsetY, canvas.height, tileHeight);
  // Only the long axis repeats. Outgoing transition layers may repeat for coverage.
  if (mapId === currentMap && map.axis === 'horizontal') rows.first = rows.last = 0;
  if (mapId === currentMap && map.axis === 'vertical') columns.first = columns.last = 0;
  // Normally only the map's scrolling axis changes. During a transition the
  // outgoing map also follows the new camera axis; visible repeats avoid gaps.
  for (let row = rows.first; row <= rows.last; row++) {
    for (let column = columns.first; column <= columns.last; column++) {
      const left = Math.round(column * tileWidth - offsetX);
      const top = Math.round(row * tileHeight - offsetY);
      const right = Math.round((column + 1) * tileWidth - offsetX);
      const bottom = Math.round((row + 1) * tileHeight - offsetY);
      target.drawImage(map.image, left, top, right - left, bottom - top);
    }
  }
}
