import { createCampaignEvents, eventEnemyProfile } from './seeded-events.js';
import { runSeed } from './run-seed.js';
import { campaignEnemyOverrides } from './campaign-schedule.js';
import { offscreenEventPoint, createTimedEnemyEvents, clusterSpawnPoints, hordeMotion, wallSpawnPoints, timedEventStatOverrides, ringSpawnPoints, stampedeSpawnPoints } from './timed-enemy-events.js';
import { createMiniBossSchedule } from './mini-bosses.js';
import { createKnockbackMover, updateKnockbackResistance } from './knockback.js';
import { updateEnemyControl } from './enemy-control.js';
import { midoriSpeed, midoriChaseTarget } from './midori.js';
import { playerSettings, eliteSizeMultiplier, eventTriggerSettings, harmlessEnemySettings, harmlessHitsToDefeatFormula } from './game-config.js';
import { yuukaSettings, yuukaHealth, yuukaMotion, createYuukaSpawnCharge, updateYuukaPresence, canSpawnYuuka, createHarmlessSpawnSchedule } from './yuuka.js';
import { updateNpcContact, contactSettings } from './npc-contact.js';
import { enemyVariant, chooseStandardEnemy } from './enemy-variants.js';
import { getEnemyDeaths, updateEnemyDeaths, drawGachaDeaths } from './enemy-death.js';
import { normalSpriteSize } from './scene-metrics.js';
import { advanceDamageFlash } from './damage-feedback.js';
import { endEventEnemies, enemyRenderLayer, onEnemyDefeat, onEnemySpawn, enemyTestConfig, rememberEnemy, getAllEnemies, getEnemy, damageEnemy, removeEnemy, enemyPopulationSettings, despawnDistantEnemies, trimEnemyPopulation, isBossEnemy } from './world-state.js';
import { updateBossCatchup } from './boss-catchup.js';
import { pointerToCanvas } from './aiming.js';

/** Install session-only NPC spawning, inspection, deletion, and basic test AI. */
export function createNpcTools({ canvas, characters, camera, getPlayer, getPlayerDamage = () => 23, getSurvivalSeconds = () => 0, getEndlessSeconds = () => null, getEliteChance, campaignActive = () => false, getCampaignSpawn = () => null, getCampaignProfile = () => null, getStageId = () => null, getInternalSeconds = getSurvivalSeconds, getEventStage = getStageId, getStageSeconds = getSurvivalSeconds, timedSpawnsEnabled = () => true, isVertical = () => false,
  isFreeScroll = () => false, isPlacementClear: placementAllowed = () => true, canKnockbackStand = () => true,
  updateCharacter, drawCharacter, baseMovementSpeed = 180, allowMultipleBosses = () => false, getBossLimit }) {
  const panel = document.querySelector('#npc-tools');
  panel.querySelector('#spawn-animation-lineup').addEventListener('click',()=>openAnimationLineup(characters));
  const yuukaCharge = createYuukaSpawnCharge();
  const harmlessSchedule = createHarmlessSpawnSchedule();
  const miniBossSchedule = createMiniBossSchedule();
  const formationWarnings = [];
  const bossBehaviors=createBossBehaviors();
  const isPlacementClear = (character,x,y) => isBossEnemy(character) || placementAllowed(character,x,y);
  const formationPoints = event => {
    const template=characters[Array.isArray(event.enemy)?event.enemy[0]:event.enemy];
    if(!template)return null;
    const size=template.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize;
    const spacing=Math.min(size*.65,Math.min(canvas.width,canvas.height)*.55/Math.max(1,Math.ceil(Math.sqrt(event.count))-1));
    const extent=Math.ceil(Math.sqrt(event.count))*spacing/2+size/2+24;
    const player=getPlayer();
    if (event.pattern==='ring') {
      // Surround the entire viewport; map edges restrict entries to legal offscreen arcs.
      const viewport={x:camera.x,y:camera.y,width:canvas.width,height:canvas.height};
      const center={x:camera.x+canvas.width/2,y:camera.y+canvas.height/2};
      const legal=ringSpawnPoints(center,Math.max(400,event.count*8),1)
        .map(p=>offscreenEventPoint(p,viewport,size*(template.megaSizeMultiplier??eliteSizeMultiplier)))
        .filter(p=>isPlacementClear(template,p.x,p.y));
      if(legal.length) return Array.from({length:event.count},(_,i)=>legal[Math.floor(i*legal.length/event.count)]);
      return null;
    }
    if (event.pattern==='wall') {
      const margin=size/2+24;
      const bounds={left:camera.x-margin,right:camera.x+canvas.width+margin,
        top:camera.y+size/2,bottom:camera.y+canvas.height-size/2};
      // Prefer vertical walls, falling back to horizontal ones where the map has no side entry.
      for (const vertical of [true,false]) {
        const wallBounds=vertical?{...bounds}:{left:camera.x+size/2,right:camera.x+canvas.width-size/2,
          top:camera.y-margin,bottom:camera.y+canvas.height+margin};
        const samples=wallSpawnPoints(wallBounds,66,vertical);
        const first=samples.slice(0,33),second=samples.slice(33);
        const valid=first.map((p,i)=>isPlacementClear(template,p.x,p.y)&&isPlacementClear(template,second[i].x,second[i].y)?i:-1).filter(i=>i>=0);
        if(!valid.length) continue;
        const start=first[valid[0]],end=first[valid.at(-1)];
        if(vertical) {wallBounds.top=start.y;wallBounds.bottom=end.y;}
        else {wallBounds.left=start.x;wallBounds.right=end.x;}
        const points=wallSpawnPoints(wallBounds,event.count,vertical);
        if(points.every(p=>isPlacementClear(template,p.x,p.y))) return points;
      }
      return null;
    }
    const anchors=[{x:camera.x-extent,y:player.y},{x:camera.x+canvas.width+extent,y:player.y},
      {x:player.x,y:camera.y-extent},{x:player.x,y:camera.y+canvas.height+extent},
      {x:camera.x-extent,y:camera.y+canvas.height/2},{x:camera.x+canvas.width+extent,y:camera.y+canvas.height/2}];
    const firstAnchor=event.entrySide??0;
    for(const anchor of [...anchors.slice(firstAnchor),...anchors.slice(0,firstAnchor)]) {
      const points=['stampede','wave','fastball','ambush'].includes(event.pattern)?stampedeSpawnPoints(anchor,player,event.count,Math.min(spacing,Math.min(canvas.width,canvas.height)*.65/Math.max(1,event.count-1))):clusterSpawnPoints(anchor,event.count,spacing);
      if(points.every(p=>isPlacementClear(template,p.x,p.y))) {
        const chargeAngle=Math.atan2(player.y-anchor.y,player.x-anchor.x);
        return points.map(point=>({...point,chargeAngle}));
      }
    }
    return null;
  };
  const timedEvents = createTimedEnemyEvents(formationPoints,
    (event,point)=>spawn(point.x,point.y,{type:event.enemy,variant:'normal',ai:true,
      behavior:['horde','hordeRush','stampede','wave','fastball','ambush'].includes(event.pattern)?'horde':'chase',chargeAngle:point.chargeAngle,
      timedArrival:true,timedEvent:event,eventKey:event.id,automatic:true}), undefined,
    (event,points)=>{const center=points[Math.floor(points.length/2)];
      formationWarnings.push({x:center.x,y:center.y,angle:center.chargeAngle,expiresAt:event.timeSeconds});});
  const campaignEvents=createCampaignEvents({seed:runSeed,getPoints:formationPoints,
    spawn:(event,point)=>{
      const type=point.enemyType;
      const row=eventEnemyProfile(event,type,event.internalSeconds,event.stage);
      return spawn(point.x,point.y,{type,variant:'normal',ai:true,
        behavior:['horde','hordeRush','stampede','wave','fastball','ambush'].includes(event.pattern)?'horde':'chase',chargeAngle:point.chargeAngle,
        timedArrival:true,timedEvent:event,eventKey:event.groupId,automatic:true,
        campaignEntry:{row,mega:false,scheduled:false}});
    },onEnd:key=>endEventEnemies(key,getPlayer()),
    warn:(event,points,expiresAt)=>{const center=points[Math.floor(points.length/2)];
      formationWarnings.push({x:center.x,y:center.y,angle:center.chargeAngle||0,pattern:event.pattern,expiresAt,eventClock:true});}
  });
  const yuukaStatus = document.querySelector('#yuuka-spawn-status');
  /** Keep cooldown and pity visible in the collapsed admin details. */
  function updateYuukaStatus() {
    if (yuukaStatus) yuukaStatus.textContent = 'Yuuka: 30% at 3:00, 9:00 and 17:00. Sensei: admin spawn until timestamps are defined. Harmless enemies run away after 25s.';
  }
  onEnemyDefeat(() => { yuukaCharge.recordKill(); updateYuukaStatus(); });
  onEnemySpawn(enemy => {
    if (enemy.type === 'yuuka') yuukaCharge.recordSpawn();
    updateYuukaStatus();
  });
  updateYuukaStatus();
  const oneHpToggle = panel.querySelector('#enemy-one-hp');
  oneHpToggle.checked = enemyTestConfig.oneHp;
  oneHpToggle.disabled = true; // Read-only: this configuration follows admin seed 0.
  for (const [id, key] of [['contact-player-damage', 'playerDamage'], ['contact-mob-damage', 'mobDamage']]) {
    document.getElementById(id).addEventListener('change', event => {
      const value = Number(event.target.value);
      if (Number.isFinite(value) && value >= 1 && value <= 1000000) contactSettings[key] = Math.floor(value);
      event.target.value = contactSettings[key];
    });
  }
  const field = name => panel.querySelector(`[name="${name}"]`);
  const list = field('npc-selection');
  const feedback = document.querySelector('#npc-feedback');
  let counter = 0;
  let selectedId = '';
  let paused = false;
  let step = false;
  // Both backgrounds share one population: switching maps never replaces NPCs.
  const records = () => getAllEnemies();
  const moveKnockback = createKnockbackMover(records, canKnockbackStand);
  const visible = (margin = 160) => records().filter(npc =>
    npc.x >= camera.x - margin && npc.x <= camera.x + canvas.width + margin &&
    npc.y >= camera.y - margin && npc.y <= camera.y + canvas.height + margin);
  const cap = enemyPopulationSettings.limit;
  const eliteButton = panel.querySelector('#spawn-elite-npc');
  /** Mega variants currently exist for basic Mob enemies only. */
  function updateEliteButton() {
    eliteButton.disabled = !(field('npc-type').value === 'mob' || characters[field('npc-type').value]?.standard);
    eliteButton.title = eliteButton.disabled ? 'Mega variants are available for standard enemies.' : 'Spawn an Mega standard enemy';
  }
  field('npc-type').addEventListener('change', () => {
    field('npc-exp').value = ['iroha', 'shiroko'].includes(field('npc-type').value) ? 50 : 5;
    updateEliteButton();
  });
  field('npc-exp').value = ['iroha', 'shiroko'].includes(field('npc-type').value) ? 50 : 5;
  updateEliteButton();

  /** Refresh selection only when population changes, retaining the current ID. */
  function refresh() {
    list.replaceChildren();
    for (const npc of records()) {
      const option = document.createElement('option');
      option.value = npc.id;
      option.textContent = `${npc.id} / ${npc.label}`;
      list.append(option);
    }
    if (!records().some(npc => npc.id === selectedId)) selectedId = records()[0]?.id || '';
    list.value = selectedId;
    feedback.textContent = `${records().length} NPCs / limit ${cap}. Shared across backgrounds; session-only state.`;
  }

  /** Clone an animation configuration into independent world-space NPC state. */
  function spawn(x, y, options = {}) {
    if (getAllEnemies().length >= cap) {
      feedback.textContent = `Population limit (${cap}) reached. Delete NPCs before spawning more.`;
      return;
    }
    const type = options.type ?? field('npc-type').value;
    const template = characters[type];
    if(!template) return false;
    const campaignEntry=options.campaignEntry || (!options.automatic && getCampaignProfile(type)?{row:getCampaignProfile(type),mega:false,scheduled:false}:null);
    if (type === 'yuuka' && options.automatic && !canSpawnYuuka(records())) {
      feedback.textContent = 'Only one Yuuka can be alive at a time. Remove or defeat her before spawning another.';
      return false;
    }
    if (isBossEnemy({ ...template, type }) && (!campaignEntry || campaignEntry.row.kind === 'boss')) {
      const bosses = records().filter(isBossEnemy);
      const limit = getBossLimit ? getBossLimit() : allowMultipleBosses() ? Infinity : 1;
      if (bosses.some(enemy => enemy.type === type) || bosses.length >= limit) {
        feedback.textContent = 'Boss limit reached: one of each type, within the current wave size.';
        return false;
      }
    }
    const variant = enemyVariant(type, template, options.variant ?? field('npc-variant').value, Math.random, getSurvivalSeconds(), getEndlessSeconds(), getEliteChance?.());
    if (['yuuka','sensei'].includes(type)) {
      variant.hp = variant.maxHp = yuukaHealth(getPlayerDamage());
      variant.hitsToDefeat = harmlessEnemySettings[`${type}HitsToDefeat`] ??
        harmlessHitsToDefeatFormula(getPlayer().level ?? 1);
      variant.receivedHits = 0;
    }
    Object.assign(variant,timedEventStatOverrides(options.timedEvent,variant));
    if(campaignEntry) Object.assign(variant,campaignEnemyOverrides(campaignEntry,template,baseMovementSpeed));
    const size = variant.spriteSize;
    const unboundedBoss = isBossEnemy({ ...template, ...variant, type });
    // Recheck at insertion time: the camera may have moved during warnings or capacity retries.
    if (options.timedEvent) {
      const point=offscreenEventPoint({x,y},{x:camera.x,y:camera.y,width:canvas.width,height:canvas.height},size);
      x=point.x; y=point.y;
    }
    x = !unboundedBoss && !options.automatic && isVertical() ? Math.max(camera.x + size / 2, Math.min(camera.x + canvas.width - size / 2, x)) : x;
    y = unboundedBoss || options.automatic || isVertical() || isFreeScroll() ? y : Math.max(camera.y + size / 2, Math.min(camera.y + canvas.height - size / 2, y));
    if (!isPlacementClear({ ...template, ...variant }, x, y)) return false;
    const npc = rememberEnemy(`npc-${++counter}`, {
      ...template, type, eventKey: options.eventKey,
      x: !unboundedBoss && !options.automatic && isVertical() ? Math.max(camera.x + size / 2, Math.min(camera.x + canvas.width - size / 2, x)) : x,
      y: unboundedBoss || options.automatic || isVertical() || isFreeScroll() ? y : Math.max(camera.y + size / 2, Math.min(camera.y + canvas.height - size / 2, y)),
      direction: template.defaultDirection || 'down', facing: template.defaultDirection || 'left',
      moving: false, elapsed: 0, attack: null, transition: null, lastPose: null,
      movementSpeedMultiplier: type === 'midori' ? midoriSpeed(getPlayer(), baseMovementSpeed) / baseMovementSpeed
        : ['yuuka','sensei'].includes(type) ? yuukaSettings.speed / baseMovementSpeed : playerSettings.npcSpeed / baseMovementSpeed,
      ai: options.ai ?? field('npc-ai').checked, behavior: ['yuuka','sensei'].includes(type) ? 'erratic' : options.behavior ?? field('npc-behavior').value,
      eventExpiresAt: !options.timedEvent?.runtimeManaged && options.timedEvent?.lifetimeSeconds != null ? options.timedEvent.timeSeconds+options.timedEvent.lifetimeSeconds : null,
      // Irrational per-spawn phases and slightly varied cadence keep group skipping staggered.
      bouncePhase:(counter*0.618033988749895)%1,
      bouncePeriodScale:.9+((counter*0.754877666246693)%1)*.2,
      eventPattern:options.timedEvent?.pattern, eventMotionAge:0, chargeWait:['fastball','ambush'].includes(options.timedEvent?.pattern)?.65:0,
      chargeAngle: options.chargeAngle, spawnArrivalPending: options.timedArrival === true, spawnArrivalGrace: 10,
      wanderTimer: 0, wanderDirection: undefined, invincible: false,
      combatStats: {}, // NPCs do not inherit the controlled avatar's test upgrades.
      ...variant,
      // Default rewards roll on defeat; explicit admin overrides remain available.
      expReward: !options.automatic && field('npc-exp-override').checked
        ? Math.max(0, Math.min(1000000, Math.floor(Number(field('npc-exp').value) || 0))) : variant.expReward
    });
    if (!options.automatic) selectedId = npc.id;
    return true;
  }

  /** Spawn a bounded batch in the current visible world area. */
  function spawnBatch(position) {
    const count = Math.max(1, Math.min(50, Number(field('npc-count').value) || 1));
    let missed = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      let placed = false;
      for (let attempt = 0; attempt < (position ? 1 : 30); attempt++) {
        placed = spawn(position ? position.x : camera.x + 140 + Math.random() * Math.max(0, canvas.width - 280),
          position ? position.y : camera.y + 140 + Math.random() * Math.max(0, canvas.height - 280));
        if (placed || getAllEnemies().length >= cap) break;
      }
      if (!placed) missed++;
    }
    refresh();
    if (missed) feedback.textContent += ` ${missed} spawn(s) blocked by obstacles or population limit.`;
  }

  /** Force the button's variant for random placement, or arm cursor placement. */
  function spawnFromButton(variant) {
    if (variant === 'elite' && !(field('npc-type').value === 'mob' || characters[field('npc-type').value]?.standard)) return;
    field('npc-variant').value = variant;
    if (field('npc-mode').value === 'random') spawnBatch();
    else {
      field('npc-mode').value = 'cursor';
      feedback.textContent = `${variant === 'elite' ? 'Mega' : 'Normal'} cursor spawn armed: left-click inside the game screen. Choose Inspect to stop spawning.`;
    }
  }
  panel.querySelector('#spawn-npc').addEventListener('click', () => spawnFromButton('normal'));
  eliteButton.addEventListener('click', () => spawnFromButton('elite'));
  list.addEventListener('change', () => { selectedId = list.value; });

  // Capture before aiming's click handler. NPC tool clicks never toggle aiming.
  canvas.addEventListener('click', event => {
    if (event.button !== 0) return;
    const mode = field('npc-mode').value;
    if (mode === 'random') return;
    event.stopImmediatePropagation();
    const point = pointerToCanvas(event.clientX, event.clientY,
      canvas.getBoundingClientRect(), canvas.width, canvas.height);
    point.x += camera.x;
    point.y += camera.y;
    if (mode === 'cursor') spawnBatch(point);
    else {
      const closest = records().filter(npc =>
        Math.hypot(npc.x - point.x, npc.y - point.y) < (npc.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize) / 2
      ).sort((a, b) => Math.hypot(a.x - point.x, a.y - point.y) - Math.hypot(b.x - point.x, b.y - point.y))[0];
      if (closest) {
        selectedId = closest.id;
        if (mode === 'delete') removeEnemy(selectedId);
        refresh();
      }
    }
  }, true);

  /** Dispatch selected-NPC and population actions from the admin panel. */
  panel.querySelectorAll('[data-npc-action]').forEach(button => {
    button.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const npc = getEnemy(selectedId);
      switch (button.dataset.npcAction) {
        case 'delete': if (npc) removeEnemy(npc.id); break;
        case 'clear': for (const entry of records()) removeEnemy(entry.id); break;
        case 'delete-visible':
          for (const entry of visible(0)) removeEnemy(entry.id);
          break;
        case 'apply-ai':
          if (npc) { npc.ai = field('npc-ai').checked; npc.behavior = field('npc-behavior').value; }
          break;
        case 'all-ai-on': for (const entry of records()) entry.ai = true; break;
        case 'all-ai-off': for (const entry of records()) entry.ai = false; break;
        case 'damage': if (npc) damageEnemy(npc.id, 25, getPlayer()); break;
        case 'heal': if (npc) npc.hp = npc.maxHp; break;
        case 'bring': if (npc) { npc.x = getPlayer().x + 160; npc.y = getPlayer().y; } break;
        case 'pause': paused = !paused; button.textContent = paused ? 'Resume AI' : 'Pause AI'; break;
        case 'step': step = true; paused = true; panel.querySelector('[data-npc-action="pause"]').textContent = 'Resume AI'; break;
      }
      refresh();
    });
  });

  /** Advance simple chase/wander AI; records stay alive even when off-screen. */
  function update(delta, playerMotion = { x: 0, y: 0 }) {
    updateEnemyDeaths(delta); // Finish visual fades even while AI is paused.
    const time = step ? 1 / 60 : paused ? 0 : delta;
    step = false;
    const player = getPlayer();
    for(const enemy of records())enemy.secondsSincePlayerHit=(enemy.secondsSincePlayerHit||0)+time;
    bossBehaviors.updateEffects(time,player,records(),playerMotion);
    campaignEvents.update(getInternalSeconds(),delta,{stage:getEventStage(),enabled:time>0&&timedSpawnsEnabled()});
    const eventStatus=document.querySelector('#campaign-event-status');
    if(eventStatus) eventStatus.textContent=`Events: ${campaignEvents.activeGroups} active groups. Seeded events: ${campaignEvents.generatedSlots}.`;
    if (eventTriggerSettings.enabled && time && timedSpawnsEnabled()) timedEvents.update(getSurvivalSeconds());
    if (eventTriggerSettings.enabled && time && timedSpawnsEnabled()) miniBossSchedule.update(getSurvivalSeconds(), type => {
      const size = characters[type].spriteSize || normalSpriteSize;
      const outside = size/2 + 24;
      const spots = [
        [camera.x-outside, player.y], [camera.x+canvas.width+outside,player.y],
        [player.x,camera.y-outside], [player.x,camera.y+canvas.height+outside]
      ];
      return spots.some(([x,y])=>spawn(x,y,{type,variant:'normal',ai:true,behavior:'chase',automatic:true}));
    });
    if (eventTriggerSettings.enabled && time && timedSpawnsEnabled()) harmlessSchedule.update(getSurvivalSeconds(), type => {
      if (type === 'yuuka' && !canSpawnYuuka(records())) return;
      // Retry placement around the player so map walls cannot silently cancel a successful roll.
      for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 16; attempt++) {
        const angle = attempt * Math.PI / 8;
        const radius = Math.min(200, canvas.width / 4) * (1 - Math.floor(attempt / 8) * .5);
        if (spawn(player.x + Math.cos(angle)*radius, player.y + Math.sin(angle)*radius,
          {type, variant:'normal',ai:true,automatic:true})) break;
      }
    });
    // Tick once per simulation update, never once per enemy or contact check.
    player.contactIFrames = Math.max(0, (player.contactIFrames || 0) - time);
    const names = ['up', 'upRight', 'right', 'downRight', 'down', 'downLeft', 'left', 'upLeft'];
    for (const npc of records()) {
      if (npc.eventExpiresAt != null && getSurvivalSeconds()>=npc.eventExpiresAt) {
        endEventEnemies(npc.eventKey,player);continue;
      }
      npc.eventMotionAge=(npc.eventMotionAge||0)+time;
      updateKnockbackResistance(npc, time);
      updateSlowdown(npc,time);
      updateWeakTuning(npc,time);
      updateRateUpWindow(npc,time);
      if (npc.spawnArrivalPending) npc.spawnArrivalGrace = Math.max(0,(npc.spawnArrivalGrace ?? 10)-time);
      if (npc.type === 'midori' && !npc.campaignOverride) npc.movementSpeedMultiplier = midoriSpeed(player, baseMovementSpeed) / baseMovementSpeed;
      updateBossCatchup(npc, player, camera, canvas.width, canvas.height, baseMovementSpeed);
      advanceDamageFlash(npc, delta);
      if (npc.animationFrames) npc.gifElapsed = (npc.gifElapsed || 0) + delta * 1000 * (npc.animationSpeed || 1);
      const wasFrozen=npc.frozenRemaining>0;
      if(!wasFrozen)delete npc.frozenPoseElapsed;
      if (time && updateEnemyControl(npc, time, npc.flattenedRemaining>0?()=>true:moveKnockback)) {
        if(wasFrozen)animateFrozenEnemy(npc,player,time);
        if (updateYuukaPresence(npc, camera, canvas.width, canvas.height, time)) { removeEnemy(npc.id); refresh(); }
        continue; // Stun suppresses movement AI, attacks and both contact checks.
      }
      if(npc.flattenedRemaining>0){
        // Flattened suppresses movement/AI, but retains normal player contact damage.
        if(time)updateNpcContact(npc,player,playerMotion,time,()=>true,getSurvivalSeconds());
        npc.moving=false;continue;
      }
      if(time && bossBehaviors.updateNpc(npc,player,time,{x:camera.x,y:camera.y,width:canvas.width,height:canvas.height},playerMotion,attacker=>{
        const target={x:player.x+(attacker.chaseOffsetX||0),y:player.y+(attacker.chaseOffsetY||0)};
        const dx=target.x-attacker.x,dy=target.y-attacker.y;
        const direction=dx||dy?names[(Math.round(Math.atan2(dx,-dy)/(Math.PI/4))+8)%8]:undefined;
        // Move through the normal chase path without advancing/resetting the attack animation.
        const pose=attacker.attack;attacker.attack=null;
        updateCharacter(attacker,time,direction,target);
        attacker.attack=pose;
        if(pose)attacker.facing=pose.facing; // Keep the barrel and warning on the chosen side.
      })) {
        if(npc.bossAction?.name!=='leap'&&!(npc.type==='arisu'&&npc.bossAction?.name==='charge')) {
          const attack=npc.attack;
          updateNpcContact(npc,player,playerMotion,time,moveKnockback,getSurvivalSeconds());
          if(npc.type==='iroha')npc.attack=attack; // Contact must not erase an active tank action pose.
        }
        continue;
      }
      if (time && updateNpcContact(npc, player, playerMotion, time, moveKnockback, getSurvivalSeconds())) continue;
      let direction;
      let chaseTarget;
      if (time && npc.ai) {
        if (npc.behavior === 'horde') {
          if(npc.chargeWait>0){npc.chargeWait=Math.max(0,npc.chargeWait-time);continue;}
          const motion=hordeMotion(npc);direction=motion.direction;chaseTarget=motion.target;
          if(npc.eventPattern==='wave') {
            // Oscillate the crossing direction; speed still uses the enemy's configured SPD.
            const angle=(npc.chargeAngle||0)+Math.sin(npc.eventMotionAge*4)*.65;
            chaseTarget={x:npc.x+Math.cos(angle)*10000,y:npc.y+Math.sin(angle)*10000};
          }
        } else if (npc.behavior === 'erratic') {
          const motion = yuukaMotion(npc, player, time);
          direction = motion.direction;
          chaseTarget = motion.target;
        } else if (npc.behavior === 'chase') {
          const target = npc.type === 'midori' ? midoriChaseTarget(npc, player)
            : { x: player.x + (npc.chaseOffsetX || 0), y: player.y + (npc.chaseOffsetY || 0) - (npc.type==='arisu'?arisuBodyCenterOffsetY(npc):npc.type==='neru'?neruBodyCenterOffsetY(npc):0) };
          const targetX = target.x, targetY = target.y;
          const dx = targetX - npc.x, dy = targetY - npc.y;
          // Chase the center exactly; quantize only the animation facing.
          // Physical movement uses the full target vector, including small gaps.
          if (dx !== 0 || dy !== 0) {
            const angle = Math.atan2(dx, -dy);
            direction = names[(Math.round(angle / (Math.PI / 4)) + 8) % 8];
            chaseTarget = { x: targetX, y: targetY };
          }
        } else if (npc.behavior === 'wander') {
          npc.wanderTimer -= time;
          if (npc.wanderTimer <= 0) {
            npc.wanderTimer = 0.8 + Math.random() * 1.5;
            npc.wanderDirection = names[Math.floor(Math.random() * names.length)];
          }
          direction = npc.wanderDirection;
        }
      }
      if (time) {
        if (npc.transition) npc.transition.elapsed += time * 1000;
        updateCharacter(npc, time, direction, chaseTarget);
        // A chasing NPC can reach contact during this step, even with a stationary player.
        updateNpcContact(npc, player, playerMotion, 0, moveKnockback, getSurvivalSeconds());
        if (updateYuukaPresence(npc, camera, canvas.width, canvas.height, time)) {
          removeEnemy(npc.id); // Escaping grants no kills, EXP or credits.
          refresh();
        }
      }
    }
    const selected = getEnemy(selectedId);
    document.querySelector('#npc-inspector').textContent = selected
      ? `${selected.id} | X ${selected.x.toFixed(1)} Y ${selected.y.toFixed(1)} | HP ${selected.hp}/${selected.maxHp}${selected.hitsToDefeat ? ` | Hits ${selected.receivedHits || 0}/${selected.hitsToDefeat}` : ''} | AI ${selected.ai ? selected.behavior : 'off'}`
      : 'No NPC selected.';
  }

  /** Cull rendering only; sprite outlines use the shared Sprite Bounds toggle. */
  function draw(layer = 'normal') {
    const context = canvas.getContext('2d');
    if(layer==='boss')bossBehaviors.draw(context,camera);

      npc.y >= camera.y - 300 && npc.y <= camera.y + canvas.height + 300);

  /** Clean up before spawning, or immediately after entering another map. */

    slotsRemaining: () => Math.max(0, cap - records().length),

        [player.x,camera.y-margin],[player.x,camera.y+canvas.height+margin]];
      return spots.some(([x,y])=>spawn(x,y,{type,variant:'normal',ai:true,behavior:'chase',automatic:true,
        campaignEntry:{row,mega:false,scheduled:true}}));
    },
    spawnBoss: (type, x, y) => spawn(x, y, { type, variant: 'normal', ai: true, behavior: 'chase', automatic: true }),

/** Stable coordinate-based random values independent of exploration order. */
function officeRandom(column, salt, seed) {
  let hash = Math.imul(column | 0, 0x1f123bb5) ^ Math.imul(salt, 0x5f356495) ^ seed;
  hash = Math.imul(hash ^ (hash >>> 16), 0x7feb352d);
  hash = Math.imul(hash ^ (hash >>> 15), 0x846ca68b);
  return ((hash ^ (hash >>> 16)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
}

/** Build deterministic left/right pity streams, caching only monument indices. */
export function createOfficeTileSelector(seed = worldSeed) {
  if (seed === 0) return column => Math.abs(column) % officeTileFiles.length;
  const streams = { left: [0], right: [0] }; // Zero is a virtual anchor, not a monument.
  return function tileAt(column) {
    if (column === 0) return 0; // Keep the starting office clear.
    const sign = column < 0 ? -1 : 1;
    const distance = Math.abs(column);
    const monuments = sign < 0 ? streams.left : streams.right;
    while (monuments[monuments.length - 1] < distance) {
      const previous = monuments[monuments.length - 1];
      let step = 1;
      for (; step < officeMonument.pityDistance; step++) {
        if (officeRandom(sign * (previous + step), 1, seed) < officeMonument.chance) break;
      }
      monuments.push(previous + step);
    }
    let low = 1, high = monuments.length - 1;
    while (low <= high) {
      const mid = (low + high) >> 1;
      if (monuments[mid] === distance) return officeMonument.index;
      if (monuments[mid] < distance) low = mid + 1;
      else high = mid - 1;
    }
    let weight = officeRandom(column, 2, seed) * officeTileWeights.reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0);
    for (let index = 0; index < officeTileWeights.length; index++) {
      weight -= officeTileWeights[index];
      if (weight < 0) return index;
    }
    return 0;
  };
}

export const officeTileIndex = createOfficeTileSelector();

/** Match Stage 1's enlarged height while overlapping horizontal seams by 2px. */
export function officeMetrics(viewportHeight) {
  const scale = viewportHeight * mapSizeMultiplier / 1086;
  const width = 1448 * scale;
  return { scale, width, height: 1086 * scale, stride: width - overlap };
}

/** Query only obstacle boxes near a world region; tiles own no enemy records. */
export function officeObstaclesIn(map, viewportHeight, left, top, right, bottom) {
  const metrics = officeMetrics(viewportHeight);
  const boxes = [];
  const first = Math.floor((left - map.originX - overlap) / metrics.stride);
  const last = Math.floor((right - map.originX) / metrics.stride);
  for (let column = first; column <= last; column++) {
    for (const [x1, y1, x2, y2] of officeObstacleBoxes[officeTileIndex(column)]) {
      const box = { left: map.originX + column * metrics.stride + x1 * metrics.scale,
        right: map.originX + column * metrics.stride + x2 * metrics.scale,
        top: map.originY + y1 * metrics.scale, bottom: map.originY + y2 * metrics.scale };
      if (box.bottom >= top && box.top <= bottom) boxes.push(box);
    }
  }
  return boxes;
}

/** Validate spawns against the office obstacle artwork. */
export function canStandInOffice(character, x, y, map, height) {
  return canStand(character, x, y, (...region) => officeObstaclesIn(map, height, ...region));
}

/** Reuse Stage 3 substepped collision and wall sliding for the office. */
export function resolveOfficeMotion(character, fromX, fromY, toX, toY, map, height) {
  return resolveObstacleMotion(character, fromX, fromY, toX, toY,
    (...region) => officeObstaclesIn(map, height, ...region));
}

/** Render only visible columns; horizontal position alone determines their layout. */
export function drawOfficeWorld(context, map, camera, width, height) {
  const metrics = officeMetrics(height);
  const first = Math.floor((camera.x - map.originX - overlap) / metrics.stride);
  const last = Math.floor((camera.x + width - map.originX) / metrics.stride);
  for (let column = first; column <= last; column++) {
    const x = Math.round(map.originX + column * metrics.stride - camera.x);
    const right = Math.round(map.originX + column * metrics.stride + metrics.width - camera.x);
    const y = Math.round(map.originY - camera.y);
    context.drawImage(map.tiles[officeTileIndex(column)].image, x, y, right - x, Math.round(metrics.height));
  }
}

/** Draw letters and halo over actors behind the monument, without blocking movement. */
export function drawOfficeMonumentOcclusion(context, character, map, camera, height, opacity = 1) {
  const metrics = officeMetrics(height), size = character.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize;
  const footY = character.y + size / 2 - spriteDisplayPadding;
  if (footY >= map.originY + officeObstacleBoxes[8][0][3] * metrics.scale) return;
  const first = Math.floor((character.x - size - map.originX) / metrics.stride);
  const last = Math.floor((character.x + size - map.originX) / metrics.stride);
  for (let column = first; column <= last; column++) {
    if (officeTileIndex(column) !== officeMonument.index) continue;
    context.save();
    context.globalAlpha *= opacity;
    context.beginPath();
    context.rect(character.x - camera.x - size / 2, character.y - camera.y - size / 2, size, size);
    context.clip();
    context.translate(map.originX + column * metrics.stride - camera.x, map.originY - camera.y);
    context.scale(metrics.scale, metrics.scale);
    const polygon = points => {
      points.forEach(([x,y], i) => { if (i === 0) context.moveTo(x,y); else context.lineTo(x,y); });
      context.closePath();
    };
    const drawRegion = buildPath => {
      context.save();
      context.beginPath();
      buildPath();
      context.clip('evenodd');
      context.drawImage(map.tiles[officeMonument.index].image, 0, 0);
      context.restore();
    };
    drawRegion(() => {
      polygon(officeMonumentSilhouette.letters);
      officeMonumentSilhouette.holes.forEach(polygon);
    });
    drawRegion(() => {
      for (const [rx, ry] of [[231,62],[214,44]]) {
        context.moveTo(712 + rx * Math.cos(0.3), 378 + rx * Math.sin(0.3));
        context.ellipse(712,378,rx,ry,0.3,0,Math.PI*2);
        context.closePath();
      }
    });
    drawRegion(() => polygon(officeMonumentSilhouette.star));
    context.restore();
  }
}

/** Nearby-target launch, timed return, or one explosion when its accepted hit budget ends. */
export function createOrbitalCompassAttack({random=Math.random}={}){
 const s=orbitalCompassSettings;let owner=null,enabled=true,cooldown=0,time=0,needles=[],explosions=[],shots=0,bursts=0;
 function reset(){owner=null;cooldown=0;time=0;needles=[];explosions=[];shots=0;bursts=0;}

  }

  }

  const weapon=player.attackSlots?.find(w=>w?.id==='orbital-compass');if(!weapon){reset();return;}
  if(owner!==player){reset();owner=player;}if(!(delta>0))return;

     // Ease to a complete turnaround before accelerating back.
     speed=s.speed*Math.cos(Math.min(1,b.age/s.returnAfter)*Math.PI/2);
    }else{

--- SNAPSHOT FILE: Development/overheated-overclocking.js | sha256=424e2cbbb719d44779f224787a1d2dd85e9c6b84711a95a7a88aabca8c47aab0 | encoding=utf-8-sig ---
import { overclockingStats, itemHpDrainNegated, syncLifeJacketShield } from './item-catalog.js';
/** HP loss, never a hit: bypasses shields except the explicitly enabled Luminous/Life Jacket pair. */
export function updateOverclocking(player,delta){
 const stats=overclockingStats(player);
 if(!stats.drainPercent||itemHpDrainNegated(player)){player.overclockDrainElapsed=0;return;}
 if(!(delta>0)||!Number.isFinite(delta))return;
 player.overclockDrainElapsed=(player.overclockDrainElapsed||0)+delta;
 while(player.overclockDrainElapsed>=1-1e-8){
  player.overclockDrainElapsed-=1;
  let loss=player.maxHp*stats.drainPercent/100;
  if(player.attackSlots?.some(w=>w?.id==='luminous-nova')&&player.equipmentSlots?.some(i=>i?.id==='life-jacket')){
   syncLifeJacketShield(player);const state=player.lifeJacketState;
   const absorbed=Math.min(state?.remaining||0,loss);if(state){state.remaining-=absorbed;if(state.remaining<state.capacity)state.healElapsed=0;}loss-=absorbed;
   const shield=Math.min(Math.max(0,player.shield||0),loss);player.shield=(player.shield||0)-shield;loss-=shield;
  }
  if(player.hp>1)player.hp=Math.max(1,player.hp-loss);
 }
}

import { palaceStatuePityDistance } from './game-config.js';
import { palaceRareChance, palaceRareWeights, palaceCommonWeights } from './game-config.js';
export { palaceRareChance, palaceRareWeights, palaceCommonWeights } from './game-config.js';

import { mapSizeMultiplier } from './map-bounds.js';
import { normalSpriteSize, spriteDisplayPadding } from './scene-metrics.js';

export const palaceTileFiles = [
  'palace-hall-single-angel.png', 'palace-hall-single-column.png',
  'palace-hall-single-knight.png', 'palace-hall-single-pit.png',
  'palace-hall-mixed-four.png', 'palace-hall-variation-a.png',
  'palace-hall-variation-b.png',
  'exec-0f3168a5-cfa4-4915-9533-1ddd11cfce6f.png',

  'mansion-vending-b-pit-stone.png'

// Single-layout group totals 100; multi-layout group totals 130 (30% more likely).

export const palaceRareStart = palaceCommonWeights.length;
// Same directional guarantee as Stage 1: <=20 outward, <=40 across the origin.
export const palaceStatueGuarantee = {
  indices: [palaceTileFiles.indexOf('mansion-decagrammaton-statue-stone.png'),
    palaceTileFiles.indexOf('palace-hall-duo-statue-walkways.png')], pityDistance: palaceStatuePityDistance
};

// EDIT source-pixel boxes [left, top, right, bottom]. For rare statues, only
// the PEDESTAL base is solid; other objects on the same tile keep full boxes.
const angel = [260, 425, 410, 650];

const variationB = [[530, 260, 630, 415], [275, 615, 425, 755], [520, 890, 660, 1035], [305, 1190, 410, 1340]];
export const palaceObstacleBoxes = [
  [angel], [column], [knight], [pit],
  [[550, 265, 685, 455], [250, 630, 430, 810], [545, 945, 705, 1105], [220, 1220, 420, 1375]],

// Approximate source-space statue silhouettes for drawing actors behind them.
// Collision still uses the pedestal box, never this taller silhouette.
export const palaceStatues = {
  [palaceRareStart]: { baseBottom: 1015, polygon: [[560,470],[615,515],[680,485],[720,545],[795,580],[740,630],[810,690],[785,800],[710,875],[675,925],[675,1015],[490,1015],[490,925],[430,860],[400,760],[420,655],[470,585],[435,535],[510,550]] },

/** Coordinate hash shared in spirit and seed with the other procedural stages. */
function palaceRandom(row, salt, seed) {
  let hash = Math.imul(row | 0, 0x1f123bb5) ^ Math.imul(salt, 0x5f356495) ^ seed;
  hash = Math.imul(hash ^ (hash >>> 16), 0x7feb352d);
  hash = Math.imul(hash ^ (hash >>> 15), 0x846ca68b);
  return ((hash ^ (hash >>> 16)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
}

/** Choose within a weighted pool without altering the pool's overall chance. */
function weightedIndex(value, weights) {
  let remaining = value * weights.reduce((sum, weight) => sum + weight, 0);
  for (let i = 0; i < weights.length; i++) {
    remaining -= weights[i];
    if (remaining < 0) return i;
  }
  return weights.length - 1;
}

/** Resolve the exact 5% rare pool followed by its conditional 10/5/5/10/35/35 split. */
export function palaceTileFromRolls(poolRoll, variantRoll) {
  return poolRoll < palaceRareChance ? palaceRareStart + weightedIndex(variantRoll, palaceRareWeights)
    : weightedIndex(variantRoll, palaceCommonWeights);
}

/** Preserve the original natural 5% rare-pool rolls before guarantee overrides. */
export function palaceBaseTileIndex(row, seed = worldSeed) {
  return palaceTileFromRolls(palaceRandom(row, 11, seed), palaceRandom(row, 12, seed));
}

/** Share one pity stream between the duo and decagrammaton statues in each direction. */
export function createPalaceTileSelector(seed = worldSeed) {
  if (seed === 0) return row => Math.abs(row) % palaceTileFiles.length;
  const streams = { up: [{ distance: 0 }], down: [{ distance: 0 }] };
  const eligible = index => palaceStatueGuarantee.indices.includes(index);
  return function tileAt(row) {
    if (row === 0) return palaceBaseTileIndex(0, seed);
    const sign = row < 0 ? -1 : 1, distance = Math.abs(row);
    const statues = sign < 0 ? streams.up : streams.down;
    while (statues[statues.length - 1].distance < distance) {
      const previous = statues[statues.length - 1].distance;
      let next;
      for (let step = 1; step <= palaceStatueGuarantee.pityDistance; step++) {
        const column = sign * (previous + step);
        const index = palaceBaseTileIndex(column, seed);
        if (eligible(index) || step === palaceStatueGuarantee.pityDistance) {
          // Both variants have equal natural weights (5% of the rare pool each).
          next = { distance: previous + step, index: eligible(index) ? index
            : palaceStatueGuarantee.indices[Math.floor(palaceRandom(column, 13, seed) * palaceStatueGuarantee.indices.length)] };
          break;
        }
      }
      statues.push(next);
    }
    let low = 1, high = statues.length - 1;
    while (low <= high) {
      const mid = (low + high) >> 1;
      if (statues[mid].distance === distance) return statues[mid].index;
      if (statues[mid].distance < distance) low = mid + 1;
      else high = mid - 1;
    }
    return palaceBaseTileIndex(row, seed);
  };
}

const palaceSelectors = new Map();
/** Stable seeded choice with shared statue guarantees and no dependence on visit order. */
export function palaceTileIndex(row, seed = worldSeed) {
  if (!palaceSelectors.has(seed)) palaceSelectors.set(seed, createPalaceTileSelector(seed));
  return palaceSelectors.get(seed)(row);
}

/** Keep the enlarged width and a 2px seam overlap while scrolling vertically. */
export function palaceMetrics(viewportWidth) {
  const scale = viewportWidth * mapSizeMultiplier / 941;
  const height = 1672 * scale;
  return { scale, width: 941 * scale, height, stride: height - 2 };
}

/** Return obstacle rectangles only for nearby vertical tiles. */
export function palaceObstaclesIn(map, width, left, top, right, bottom) {
  const metrics = palaceMetrics(width), boxes = [];
  const first = Math.floor((top - map.originY - 2) / metrics.stride);
  const last = Math.floor((bottom - map.originY) / metrics.stride);
  for (let row = first; row <= last; row++) {
    for (const [x1, y1, x2, y2] of palaceObstacleBoxes[palaceTileIndex(row)]) {
      const box = { left: map.originX + x1 * metrics.scale, right: map.originX + x2 * metrics.scale,
        top: map.originY + row * metrics.stride + y1 * metrics.scale,
        bottom: map.originY + row * metrics.stride + y2 * metrics.scale };
      if (box.right >= left && box.left <= right) boxes.push(box);
    }
  }
  return boxes;
}

/** Reject NPC spawns inside the same obstacle boxes used by movement. */
export function canStandInPalace(character, x, y, map, width) {
  return canStand(character, x, y, (...region) => palaceObstaclesIn(map, width, ...region));
}

/** Reuse substepped collision and axis sliding from Stage 3. */
export function resolvePalaceMotion(character, fromX, fromY, toX, toY, map, width) {
  return resolveObstacleMotion(character, fromX, fromY, toX, toY,
    (...region) => palaceObstaclesIn(map, width, ...region));
}

/** Render only rows that intersect the camera, without allocating tile objects. */
export function drawPalaceWorld(context, map, camera, width, height) {
  const metrics = palaceMetrics(width);
  const first = Math.floor((camera.y - map.originY - 2) / metrics.stride);
  const last = Math.floor((camera.y + height - map.originY) / metrics.stride);
  for (let row = first; row <= last; row++) {
    const x = Math.round(map.originX - camera.x);
    const y = Math.round(map.originY + row * metrics.stride - camera.y);
    const bottom = Math.round(map.originY + row * metrics.stride + metrics.height - camera.y);
    context.drawImage(map.tiles[palaceTileIndex(row)].image, x, y, Math.round(metrics.width), bottom - y);
  }
}

/** Redraw only a statue silhouette over an actor standing behind its pedestal. */
export function drawPalaceOcclusion(context, character, map, camera, width, opacity = 1) {
  const metrics = palaceMetrics(width), size = character.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize;
  const footY = character.y + size / 2 - spriteDisplayPadding;
  const first = Math.floor((character.y - size - map.originY) / metrics.stride);
  const last = Math.floor((character.y + size - map.originY) / metrics.stride);
  for (let row = first; row <= last; row++) {
    const index = palaceTileIndex(row), statue = palaceStatues[index];
    const originY = map.originY + row * metrics.stride;
    if (!statue || footY >= originY + statue.baseBottom * metrics.scale) continue;
    context.save();
    context.globalAlpha *= opacity;
    context.beginPath();
    context.rect(character.x - camera.x - size / 2, character.y - camera.y - size / 2, size, size);
    context.clip();
    context.beginPath();
    statue.polygon.forEach(([x,y], i) => {
      const px = map.originX + x * metrics.scale - camera.x;
      const py = originY + y * metrics.scale - camera.y;
      if (i === 0) context.moveTo(px, py); else context.lineTo(px, py);
    });
    context.closePath();
    context.clip();
    context.drawImage(map.tiles[index].image, map.originX - camera.x, originY - camera.y, metrics.width, metrics.height);
    context.restore();
  }
}

    volume.value = mainVolume.value;
    updateVolumeText();
    volume.style.setProperty('--volume-fill', `${volume.value}%`);
    refreshSkill();
  }

  /** Freeze game simulation without making the surrounding page inert. */
  function setPaused(enabled) {
    if (paused === enabled || (enabled && isBlocked())) return;
    paused = enabled;
    help.textContent=defaultHelp;quitOpen=false;quitConfirmation.hidden=true;pauseCard.hidden=false;
    releaseControls();
    overlay.hidden = !paused;
    pauseButton.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(paused));
    if (paused) {
      onPause();
      refresh();
      showSkills(false);
      settings.hidden = true;
      document.querySelector('#pause-settings-toggle').setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
      // Pause only the game surface; surrounding page/admin controls stay interactive.
      previousInert = [[canvas,canvas.inert]];
      canvas.inert = true;
      resume.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    } else {
      for (const [element, inert] of previousInert) element.inert = inert;
      previousInert = [];
      canvas.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    }
  }

  pauseButton.addEventListener('click', () => setPaused(true));
  resume.addEventListener('click', () => setPaused(false));
  /** Right-click backs out one menu level; at the pause root it resumes gameplay. */
  overlay.addEventListener('pointerdown', event => {
    if (event.button !== 2 || !paused) return;
    event.preventDefault();
    event.stopPropagation();
    if(quitOpen){cancelQuit();return;}
    if (!skillsPanel.hidden) showSkills(false);
    else if (!settings.hidden) {
      settings.hidden = true;
      document.querySelector('#pause-settings-toggle').setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
      document.querySelector('#pause-settings-toggle').focus({ preventScroll: true });
    } else setPaused(false);
  });
  overlay.addEventListener('contextmenu', event => { event.preventDefault(); event.stopPropagation(); });
  document.querySelector('#pause-settings-toggle').addEventListener('click', event => {
    settings.hidden = !settings.hidden;
    event.currentTarget.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(!settings.hidden));
  });
  volume.addEventListener('input', () => {
    mainVolume.value = volume.value;
    mainVolume.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
    updateVolumeText();
    volume.style.setProperty('--volume-fill', `${volume.value}%`);
  });
  document.querySelector('#pause-exit-preview').addEventListener('click', () => {
    setPaused(false);
    document.querySelector('#exit-fullscreen-preview').click();
  });
  window.addEventListener('keydown', event => {
    if(quitOpen&&!event.ctrlKey&&!event.metaKey&&!event.altKey&&!event.repeat){
      if(['Escape','Shift','ArrowUp','ArrowDown','ArrowLeft','ArrowRight','Enter',' ','Tab'].includes(event.key)){
        event.preventDefault();event.stopImmediatePropagation();
        if(event.key==='Escape'||event.key==='Shift')cancelQuit();
        else if(event.key==='Enter'||event.key===' ')(quitChoice===0?quitYes:quitNo).click();
        else{chooseQuit(1-quitChoice);(quitChoice===0?quitYes:quitNo).focus();}return;
      }
    }
    if (event.key !== 'Escape' || event.repeat || isBlocked() || event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey || event.altKey) return;
    if(event.target!==canvas&&event.target!==pauseButton&&!overlay.contains?.(event.target))return;
    event.preventDefault();
    event.stopImmediatePropagation();
    setPaused(!paused);
  }, true);
  return { get paused() { return paused; } };
}

--- SNAPSHOT FILE: Development/pickup-reentry.js | sha256=0bb4187ebdacb2de18a41849ff8380c74de723b7ff9517d38fceac3a18cc139d | encoding=utf-8-sig ---
/** Per-pickup protection after leaving a menu. Timers advance only on game time. */
export function createPickupReentryGuard(delay=1.5) {
  const blocks=new Map();
  return {
    block(key){blocks.set(key,{waitingToLeave:true,remaining:delay});},
    blocked(key,touching,delta=0){
      const state=blocks.get(key);if(!state)return false;
      if(touching){state.waitingToLeave=true;state.remaining=delay;return true;}
      // The first fully separated frame starts the delay; time spent overlapping never counts.
      if(state.waitingToLeave){state.waitingToLeave=false;return true;}
      state.remaining=Math.max(0,state.remaining-Math.max(0,Number.isFinite(delta)?delta:0));
      if(state.remaining>1e-8)return true;
      blocks.delete(key);return false;
    },
    forget(key){blocks.delete(key);},
    clear(){blocks.clear();}
  };
}

--- SNAPSHOT FILE: Development/plana-pattern.js | sha256=268eefc99acaa35c23b5553bf068ccb99b0cb29981440db608a8739d5044fc79 | encoding=utf-8-sig ---
import { drawingBounds, normalizeSkillStrokes } from './skill-drawing.js';
import { planaSkillSettings } from './game-config.js';

const distance = (a,b) => Math.hypot(a.x-b.x,a.y-b.y);

/** Reduce pen jitter while preserving corners and line crossings. */
function simplify(points, tolerance) {
  if (points.length <= 2) return points;
  const a=points[0], b=points.at(-1), dx=b.x-a.x, dy=b.y-a.y, length=dx*dx+dy*dy;
  let maximum=0,index=0;
  for(let i=1;i<points.length-1;i++) {
    const t=length?Math.max(0,Math.min(1,((points[i].x-a.x)*dx+(points[i].y-a.y)*dy)/length)):0;
    const d=Math.hypot(points[i].x-a.x-t*dx,points[i].y-a.y-t*dy);
    if(d>maximum){maximum=d;index=i;}
  }
  return maximum>tolerance
    ? [...simplify(points.slice(0,index+1),tolerance).slice(0,-1),...simplify(points.slice(index),tolerance)] : [a,b];
}

/** Clip into continuous sub-strokes; never join separate shape pieces across excluded ink. */
function splitStrokes(strokes, include) {
  const result=[];
  for(const stroke of strokes){let part=[];for(const p of stroke){
    if(include(p))part.push(p);else{if(part.length>1)result.push(part);part=[];}
  }if(part.length>1)result.push(part);}
  return result;
}

/** Find a proper interior crossing, distinguishing an X from a V or parallel lines. */
function crossing(a,b) {
  const ax=a.b.x-a.a.x,ay=a.b.y-a.a.y,bx=b.b.x-b.a.x,by=b.b.y-b.a.y;
  const determinant=ax*by-ay*bx;
  if(Math.abs(determinant)<1e-6)return null;
  const dx=b.a.x-a.a.x,dy=b.a.y-a.a.y;
  const t=(dx*by-dy*bx)/determinant,u=(dx*ay-dy*ax)/determinant;
  return t>.15&&t<.85&&u>.15&&u<.85?{x:a.a.x+t*ax,y:a.a.y+t*ay}:null;
}

/** Split and validate the ring, lower X and upper arrow, independent of stroke order. */
export function segmentPlanaPattern(strokes) {
  strokes = normalizeSkillStrokes(strokes);
  const bounds=drawingBounds(strokes),s=planaSkillSettings;
  const fail=reason=>({valid:false,reason,parts:[]});
  if(!bounds)return fail('Draw a circle with an arrow above an X inside it.');
  const width=bounds.right-bounds.left,height=bounds.bottom-bounds.top;
  const diameter=Math.max(width,height),cx=(bounds.left+bounds.right)/2,cy=(bounds.top+bounds.bottom)/2;
  const radial=p=>Math.hypot((p.x-cx)/(width/2),(p.y-cy)/(height/2));
  // Prefer actual curved ring strokes, so symbols drawn close to the circumference
  // retain their tips instead of being incorrectly absorbed into the circle crop.
  const circular = new Set(strokes.filter(stroke => {
    if (stroke.length < 6) return false;
    let length=0,error=0;
    for(let i=0;i<stroke.length;i++){error+=Math.abs(radial(stroke[i])-1);if(i)length+=distance(stroke[i],stroke[i-1]);}
    return length>diameter*.5 && length/Math.max(1,distance(stroke[0],stroke.at(-1)))>1.12 &&
      error/stroke.length<s.circleRadialTolerance;
  }));
  const circle=splitStrokes(circular.size?[...circular]:strokes,p=>radial(p)>=s.ringInnerRadius);
  const ring=circle.flat(),bins=new Set();let radialError=0,ringLength=0;
  for(const p of ring){bins.add((Math.floor((Math.atan2(p.y-cy,p.x-cx)+Math.PI)*8/(Math.PI*2))+8)%8);radialError+=Math.abs(radial(p)-1);}
  for(const part of circle)for(let i=1;i<part.length;i++)ringLength+=distance(part[i],part[i-1]);
  if(bins.size<7||!ring.length||radialError/ring.length>s.circleRadialTolerance||ringLength<diameter*1.9)return fail('Complete the outer circle around both symbols.');
  const inner=circular.size
    ? [...splitStrokes(strokes.filter(stroke=>!circular.has(stroke)),p=>radial(p)<1.05),
       ...splitStrokes([...circular],p=>radial(p)<s.ringInnerRadius)]
    : splitStrokes(strokes,p=>radial(p)<s.ringInnerRadius);
  const lines=[];
  for(const part of inner){const points=simplify(part,diameter*s.lineSimplifyRatio);
    for(let i=1;i<points.length;i++)if(distance(points[i-1],points[i])>diameter*.07)lines.push({a:points[i-1],b:points[i]});}
  const diagonal=line=>Math.abs(line.b.x-line.a.x)>diameter*.08&&Math.abs(line.b.y-line.a.y)>diameter*.08;
  const crosses=[];
  for(let i=0;i<lines.length;i++)for(let j=i+1;j<lines.length;j++){
    const a=lines[i],b=lines[j],point=crossing(a,b);
    if(point&&point.y>cy-height*.08&&diagonal(a)&&diagonal(b)&&
      (a.b.x-a.a.x)*(a.b.y-a.a.y)*(b.b.x-b.a.x)*(b.b.y-b.a.y)<0)crosses.push({point,lines:[a,b]});
  }
  const tolerance=diameter*s.joinToleranceRatio;
  for(const cross of crosses)for(let i=0;i<lines.length;i++)for(let j=i+1;j<lines.length;j++){
    const a=lines[i],b=lines[j];
    for(const tipA of [a.a,a.b])for(const tipB of [b.a,b.b]){
      if(distance(tipA,tipB)>tolerance)continue;
      const tip={x:(tipA.x+tipB.x)/2,y:(tipA.y+tipB.y)/2};
      const armA=tipA===a.a?a.b:a.a,armB=tipB===b.a?b.b:b.a;
      if(tip.y>=cross.point.y-height*.1)continue;
      const shaft=lines.find(line=>{
        if(line===a||line===b)return false;
        const near=distance(line.a,tip)<distance(line.b,tip)?line.a:line.b;
        const end=near===line.a?line.b:line.a;
        const dx=end.x-tip.x,dy=end.y-tip.y,length=Math.hypot(dx,dy);
        if(distance(near,tip)>tolerance||length<diameter*.14)return false;
        const ux=dx/length,uy=dy/length;
        const av={x:armA.x-tip.x,y:armA.y-tip.y},bv={x:armB.x-tip.x,y:armB.y-tip.y};
        const sideA=ux*av.y-uy*av.x,sideB=ux*bv.y-uy*bv.x;
        return av.x*ux+av.y*uy>diameter*.035&&bv.x*ux+bv.y*uy>diameter*.035&&
          sideA*sideB<0&&Math.min(Math.abs(sideA),Math.abs(sideB))>diameter*.035;
      });
      if(!shaft)continue;
      const arrow=[a,b,shaft];
      if(Math.max(...arrow.flatMap(line=>[line.a.y,line.b.y]))>=cross.point.y)continue;
      return {valid:true,score:Math.max(.7,1-radialError/ring.length),parts:[
        {name:'circle',strokes:circle},{name:'x',strokes:cross.lines.map(line=>[line.a,line.b])},
        {name:'arrow',strokes:arrow.map(line=>[line.a,line.b])}]};
    }
  }
  return fail(crosses.length?'Draw an arrow above the X, inside the circle.':'Draw two crossing diagonal lines for the X below the arrow.');
}

import { weaponSizeMultiplier, weaponKnockbackMultiplier } from './game-config.js';
import {tryWeakTuningHit} from './weak-tuning.js';

// SOURCE IMAGE crops: each opening pose is independent; unequal widths avoid adjacent-frame bleed.
export const umbrellaOpeningFrames = [
  [99,228,70,304],[308,228,109,304],[504,228,178,304],[727,228,222,304],
  [978,228,258,304],[1258,228,272,304],[1547,228,293,304],[1846,228,317,304]

/** Sweep a broad projectile capsule against an enemy's scaled body ellipse. */
export function umbrellaSkillHits(enemy, from, to, radius = planaSkillSettings.hitRadius) {
  const body = getEnemyHurtbox(enemy);
  return segmentHitsBody({ ...body, rx: body.rx + radius, ry: body.ry + radius }, from.x, from.y, to.x, to.y);
}

/** Open Plana's umbrella, then launch it forward with a path-clearing knockback/stun. */
export function createPlanaUmbrellaSkill() {
  const image = new Image(); image.src = new URL('../sprites/attacks/plana umbrella.png', import.meta.url).href;
  const ready = image.decode();
  let projectiles = [];
  return {
    ready,
    cast(player, angle, damageMultiplier = skillCastSettings.damageAverage, getLaunchAngle) {
      const tunedAngle=player.tuningParts?startingWeaponAim(player,'plana-umbrella',angle):angle;
      const tunedLaunchAngle=getLaunchAngle?()=>{const aim=getLaunchAngle();return player.tuningParts?startingWeaponAim(player,'plana-umbrella',aim):aim;}:undefined;
      const sizeScale=weaponSizeMultiplier(player)*(player.tuningParts?startingWeaponSizeScale(player,'plana-umbrella'):1);
      projectiles.push({ sizeScale, owner: player, angle:tunedAngle, getLaunchAngle:tunedLaunchAngle, x: player.x, y: player.y, elapsed: 0, tailElapsed: 0,
        damageMultiplier: Number.isFinite(damageMultiplier)
          ? Math.max(skillCastSettings.damageMinimum, Math.min(skillCastSettings.damageMaximum, damageMultiplier))
          : skillCastSettings.damageAverage,
        distance: 0, hits: new Set(), trail: [], baseDamage: umbrellaBaseDamage() });
    },
    reset() { projectiles = []; },
    update(delta,eraseProjectiles) {
      const s = planaSkillSettings;
      for (const projectile of projectiles) {
        const tunedKnockbackDistance=s.knockbackDistance*weaponKnockbackMultiplier(projectile.owner)*(projectile.owner.tuningParts?knockbackTuningMultiplier(projectile.owner):1);
        const previousTime = projectile.elapsed;
        const launchTime = s.openingSeconds + s.prelaunchSeconds;
        for (const point of projectile.trail) point.age += delta;
        projectile.trail = projectile.trail.filter(point => point.age < s.trailSeconds);
        if (projectile.distance >= s.maxDistance) {
          projectile.tailElapsed += delta;
          continue;
        }
        projectile.elapsed += delta;
        // Follow the arrow only during fade-in; the open-pose hold and flight use the locked angle.
        if (previousTime < s.openingSeconds && projectile.getLaunchAngle) {
          const aim = projectile.getLaunchAngle();
          if (Number.isFinite(aim)) projectile.angle = aim;
        }
        const ux = Math.cos(projectile.angle), uy = Math.sin(projectile.angle);
        if (previousTime < launchTime) {
          projectile.x = projectile.owner.x + ux * umbrellaSettings.baseRadius * projectile.sizeScale;
          projectile.y = projectile.owner.y + uy * umbrellaSettings.baseRadius * projectile.sizeScale;
        }
        const flightTime = Math.max(0, projectile.elapsed - Math.max(previousTime, launchTime));
        if (!flightTime) continue;
        if(previousTime<=launchTime&&projectile.owner.tuningParts)playTrumpetTuning(projectile.owner);
        const from = { x: projectile.x, y: projectile.y };
        const step = Math.min(s.maxDistance - projectile.distance, s.projectileSpeed * flightTime);
        projectile.x += ux * step; projectile.y += uy * step; projectile.distance += step;
        const to = { x: projectile.x, y: projectile.y };
        // Spatial sampling fills gaps even when a fast projectile travels far in one frame.
        const samples = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(step / s.trailSpacing));
        for (let i = 0; i < samples; i++) {
          const t = i / samples;
          projectile.trail.push({ x: from.x + (to.x - from.x) * t,
            y: from.y + (to.y - from.y) * t, age: (1 - t) * step / s.projectileSpeed });
        }
        projectile.trail = projectile.trail.slice(-s.maxTrailImages);
        if(projectile.owner.tuningParts&&eraseProjectiles)eraseProjectiles({player:projectile.owner,attack:projectile,
          intersects:b=>umbrellaSkillHits({x:b.x,y:b.y,spriteHurtbox:{offsetX:0,offsetY:0,width:b.radius*2,height:b.radius*2}},from,to,s.hitRadius*projectile.sizeScale)});
        for (const enemy of getAllEnemies()) {
          if (projectile.hits.has(enemy.id) || !umbrellaSkillHits(enemy, from, to,s.hitRadius*projectile.sizeScale)) continue;
          projectile.hits.add(enemy.id);
          const hit = rollUmbrellaDamage(projectile.owner, projectile.baseDamage, Math.random, projectile.damageMultiplier, enemy,{skillAttack:true});
          const hpBefore=enemy.hp;
          const landed = damageEnemy(enemy.id, hit.damage, projectile.owner, hit.type, { canMiss: true,weaponId:'plana-umbrella' });
          if (landed === false) continue; // A dodged attack cannot apply stun or knockback.
          if(landed&&projectile.owner.tuningParts)tryWeakTuningHit({player:projectile.owner,enemy});
          if(landed&&projectile.owner.tuningParts)tryNeutralizationHit({player:projectile.owner,enemy});
          if(landed&&projectile.owner.tuningParts)onTargetTuningHit({player:projectile.owner,projectile,enemy,damage:Math.min(hpBefore,hit.damage),hitType:hit.type});
          if(landed&&projectile.owner.tuningParts)tryRepairTuningHit({player:projectile.owner});
          if(landed&&projectile.owner.tuningParts)tryLuxeryTuningHit({player:projectile.owner,enemy,damage:hit.damage});
          if(landed&&projectile.owner.tuningParts)trySlowdownTuningHit({player:projectile.owner,enemy,rollDamage:(target,multiplier)=>rollUmbrellaDamage(projectile.owner,projectile.baseDamage,Math.random,projectile.damageMultiplier*multiplier,target,{skillAttack:true})});
          if(landed&&projectile.owner.tuningParts)tryColdTuningHit({player:projectile.owner,enemy,rollDamage:(target,multiplier)=>rollUmbrellaDamage(projectile.owner,projectile.baseDamage,Math.random,projectile.damageMultiplier*multiplier,target,{skillAttack:true})});
          if(landed&&projectile.owner.tuningParts)tryTuningExplosion({player:projectile.owner,projectile,enemy,
            rollDamage:(target,multiplier,options)=>rollUmbrellaDamage(projectile.owner,projectile.baseDamage,Math.random,projectile.damageMultiplier*multiplier,target,{...options,skillAttack:true}),
            onHit:target=>{
              const side=(target.x-from.x)*-uy+(target.y-from.y)*ux,sign=Math.sign(side)||1;
              applySkillControl(target,-uy*sign*tunedKnockbackDistance+ux*tunedKnockbackDistance*.25,
                ux*sign*tunedKnockbackDistance+uy*tunedKnockbackDistance*.25,0,s.knockbackSeconds,{ignoreKnockbackResistance:s.ignoreKnockbackResistance});
            }});
          const living = getEnemy(enemy.id);
          if (living) {
            // Push sideways away from the flight lane, with a smaller forward component.
            const side = (enemy.x - from.x) * -uy + (enemy.y - from.y) * ux;
            const sign = Math.abs(side) > .01 ? Math.sign(side) : projectile.hits.size % 2 ? 1 : -1;
            applySkillControl(living, -uy * sign * tunedKnockbackDistance + ux * tunedKnockbackDistance * .25,
              ux * sign * tunedKnockbackDistance + uy * tunedKnockbackDistance * .25, s.stunSeconds, s.knockbackSeconds, { ignoreKnockbackResistance: s.ignoreKnockbackResistance });
          }
        }
      }
      projectiles = projectiles.filter(projectile => projectile.distance < s.maxDistance || projectile.tailElapsed < s.trailSeconds);
    },
    draw(context, camera) {
      if (!image.naturalWidth) return;
      const s = planaSkillSettings;
      /** Draw one opening pose or blurred open-umbrella afterimage in world space. */
      function drawPose(projectile, point, index, opacity, blur = 0, scale = 1) {
        const [x, y, width, height] = umbrellaOpeningFrames[index];
        const length = s.displayLength * scale * projectile.sizeScale;
        context.save();
        context.globalAlpha = opacity;
        context.filter = blur ? `blur(${blur}px)` : 'none';
        context.translate(point.x - camera.x, point.y - camera.y);
        context.rotate(projectile.angle + Math.PI / 2);
        context.drawImage(image, x, y, width, height,
          -length * width / height / 2, -length / 2, length * width / height, length);
        context.restore();
      }
      for (const projectile of projectiles) {
        const launchTime = s.openingSeconds + s.prelaunchSeconds;
        if (projectile.elapsed < launchTime) {
          // Fade up as the sheet opens, then hold the open pose briefly before release.
          const progress = Math.min(1, projectile.elapsed / s.openingSeconds);
          const eased = progress * progress * (3 - 2 * progress);
          drawPose(projectile, projectile, Math.min(7, Math.floor(progress * 8)),
            eased, 0, .85 + .15 * eased);
          continue;
        }
        for (const point of projectile.trail) {
          const life = Math.max(0, 1 - point.age / s.trailSeconds);
          drawPose(projectile, point, 7, .085 * life * life, s.trailBlur);
        }
        // A soft continuous streak connects the sampled silhouettes into one swift blur.
        if (projectile.trail.length > 1) {
          context.save();
          context.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, 1 - projectile.tailElapsed / s.trailSeconds);
          context.filter = `blur(${s.trailBlur}px)`;
          const first = projectile.trail[0];
          const rainbow=projectile.owner.tuningParts&&rgbTuningActive(projectile.owner);
          const gradient = rainbow?rainbowTrailGradient(context,first.x-camera.x,first.y-camera.y,projectile.x-camera.x,projectile.y-camera.y):context.createLinearGradient(first.x-camera.x, first.y-camera.y,
            projectile.x-camera.x, projectile.y-camera.y);
          if(rainbow)context.globalAlpha*=.4;
          else {gradient.addColorStop(0, '#70dfff00');gradient.addColorStop(1, '#b9f4ff66');}
          context.strokeStyle = gradient;
          context.lineWidth = s.displayLength * .26 * projectile.sizeScale;
          context.lineCap = 'round';
          context.beginPath();
          context.moveTo(first.x-camera.x, first.y-camera.y);
          context.lineTo(projectile.x-camera.x, projectile.y-camera.y);
          context.stroke();
          context.restore();
        }
        const headOpacity = Math.max(0, 1 - projectile.tailElapsed / .08);
        drawPose(projectile, projectile, 7, headOpacity);
      }
    }
  };
}

import { chiseDelayConfigured } from './game-config.js';
import { syncRacerPassHealth, syncLifeJacketShield, lifeJacketStats, totalPlayerShield, chiseImmediateFraction } from './item-catalog.js';
import { developmentSettings, damageReductionFormula } from './game-config.js';
import { levelExpFormula } from './game-config.js';
import { startingLevelExp, expIncreasePerLevel } from './game-config.js';
export { startingLevelExp, expIncreasePerLevel } from './game-config.js';
import { showDamageNumber } from './damage-numbers.js';
import { ensureCombatStats, defaultCombatStats } from './combat-stats.js';

// Level costs and formulas live in game-config.js.



/** Add round(15 + currentLevel / 2) to the next requirement on each level-up. */
export function experienceForLevel(level) {
  return levelExpFormula(level);
}

/** Initialize session stats once; Development defaults to invincibility on. */
export function ensurePlayerStats(character) {
  character.level ??= 1;
  character.pendingUpgrades ??= 0;
  character.exp ??= 0;
  character.maxExp = experienceForLevel(character.level);
  character.maxHp ??= 100;
  character.hp ??= character.maxHp;
  syncRacerPassHealth(character);
  syncLifeJacketShield(character);
  character.shield = Math.max(0, Math.min(character.maxHp, character.shield ?? 0));
  character.invincible ??= developmentSettings.invincible;
  ensureCombatStats(character);
  return character;
}

/** Add experience, retaining overflow and supporting multiple level-ups per award. */
export function addPlayerExp(character, amount) {
  ensurePlayerStats(character);
  if (!Number.isFinite(amount) || amount <= 0) return;
  character.exp += Math.min(1000000, Math.floor(amount));
  while (character.exp >= character.maxExp) {
    character.exp -= character.maxExp;
    character.level++;
    character.pendingUpgrades++; // Each gained level gets its own choice, including overflow.
    character.maxExp = experienceForLevel(character.level);
  }
}

/** Death protection allows zero HP; use this check when handling player defeat. */
export function isPlayerDefeated(character) {
  ensurePlayerStats(character);
  return character.hp <= 0 && !character.invincible;
}

/** Add or remove shield points, capped by max HP without changing health. */
export function changePlayerShield(character, amount) {
  ensurePlayerStats(character);
  if (Number.isFinite(amount)) {
    character.shield = Math.max(0, Math.min(character.maxHp, character.shield + Math.trunc(amount)));
  }
}

// The runtime item effect registers once; plain stat consumers need no world dependencies.
let playerDamageGuard=null;
export function setPlayerDamageGuard(guard){playerDamageGuard=guard;}
/** Absorb damage with shield first; spill excess into HP and show one hit number. */
export function damagePlayer(character, amount, {projectile=false,enemyHit=true}={}) {
  ensurePlayerStats(character);
  if(character.supportState?.invulnerableRemaining>0||(projectile&&character.supportState?.shieldRemaining>0)){character.lastDamageResult={negated:true,healthDamage:0,shieldDamage:0};return false;}
  if (!Number.isFinite(amount) || amount <= 0) return false;
  const damage = Math.round(amount * damageReductionFormula([].concat(character.damageReductionPercent??[],lifeJacketStats(character)?.reduction??0)));
  if(damage<=0)return false;
  if(playerDamageGuard?.(character,damage)){character.lastDamageResult={negated:true,healthDamage:0,shieldDamage:0};showDamageNumber(character,0,true,'miss');return false;}
  const initialFraction=chiseDelayConfigured()?chiseImmediateFraction(character):1;
  const immediate=Math.round(damage*initialFraction),deferred=damage-immediate;
  if(deferred>0){
    if(!(character.chisePendingDamage>0))character.chiseTickElapsed=0;
    character.chisePendingDamage=(character.chisePendingDamage||0)+deferred;
  }
  const taken=applyResolvedPlayerDamage(character,immediate);
  character.lastDamageResult.deferredDamage=deferred;
  if(enemyHit&&character.lastDamageResult.healthDamage>0&&character.sportsDrinkState)character.sportsDrinkState.crit*=.5;
  return taken||deferred>0;
}

/** Already-resolved damage bypasses attack-only negation, DR and Chise re-deferral. */
export function applyResolvedPlayerDamage(character,damage){
  ensurePlayerStats(character);
  if(!Number.isFinite(damage)||damage<=0){character.lastDamageResult={negated:false,healthDamage:0,shieldDamage:0};return false;}
  const jacket=character.lifeJacketState;
  const jacketAbsorbed=Math.min(jacket?.remaining??0,damage);
  if(jacket){jacket.remaining-=jacketAbsorbed;if(jacket.remaining<jacket.capacity)jacket.healElapsed=0;}
  const absorbed = Math.min(character.shield, damage-jacketAbsorbed);
  character.shield -= absorbed;
  const previous = character.hp;
  character.hp = Math.max(0, character.hp - (damage - jacketAbsorbed - absorbed));
  const healthDamage=previous-character.hp;
  const taken = jacketAbsorbed + absorbed + healthDamage;
  character.lastDamageResult={negated:false,healthDamage,shieldDamage:jacketAbsorbed+absorbed};
  if (taken > 0) {
    if(healthDamage>0)character.damageFlashElapsed = 0;
    const shieldDamage=jacketAbsorbed+absorbed;
    if(shieldDamage>0)showDamageNumber(character,shieldDamage,true,'shield');
    if(healthDamage>0)showDamageNumber(character,healthDamage,true);
  }
  return taken > 0;
}

/** Heal without exceeding maximum HP; works while invincible. */
export function healPlayer(character, amount) {
  ensurePlayerStats(character);
  if (Number.isFinite(amount) && amount > 0) {
    character.hp = Math.min(character.maxHp, character.hp + Math.floor(amount));
  }
}

/** Wire admin progression/HP controls to the currently controlled character. */
export function createPlayerStatsTools(getPlayer, onChange) {
  const panel = document.querySelector('#player-stats-tools');
  const expAmount = panel.querySelector('[name="exp-amount"]');
  const hpAmount = panel.querySelector('[name="hp-amount"]');
  const shieldAmount = panel.querySelector('[name="shield-amount"]');
  const invincibility = document.querySelector('#player-invincibility');
  const status = document.querySelector('#player-stats-status');
  const feedback = document.querySelector('#player-stats-feedback');
  const statInputs = [...panel.querySelectorAll('[data-combat-stat]')];
  let inspectedCharacter;

  // Apply on change so typing is not interrupted by per-frame HUD refreshes.
  for (const input of statInputs) {
    input.addEventListener('change', () => {
      const value = Number(input.value);
      const maximum = input.dataset.combatStat === 'critPercent' ? 100 : 1000;
      const stats = ensureCombatStats(getPlayer());
      if (Number.isFinite(value)) stats[input.dataset.combatStat] = Math.max(0, Math.min(maximum, value));
      input.value = stats[input.dataset.combatStat];
      onChange(getPlayer());
    });
  }

  /** Keep toggles and inspection values synchronized across character swaps. */
  function update() {
    const character = ensurePlayerStats(getPlayer());
    invincibility.checked = character.invincible;
    for (const input of statInputs) {
      if (inspectedCharacter !== character || document.activeElement !== input) input.value = character.combatStats[input.dataset.combatStat];
    }
    inspectedCharacter = character;
    status.textContent = `${character.label} | LV ${character.level} | EXP ${character.exp}/${character.maxExp} | HP ${character.hp}/${character.maxHp} | Shield ${totalPlayerShield(character)}/${character.maxHp}`;
  }
  invincibility.addEventListener('change', () => {
    getPlayer().invincible = invincibility.checked;
    feedback.textContent = invincibility.checked ? 'Death protection enabled; HP can still reach zero.' : 'Death protection disabled.';
    update();
  });
  panel.querySelectorAll('[data-player-stat]').forEach(button => {
    button.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const character = ensurePlayerStats(getPlayer());
      const action = button.dataset.playerStat;
      const amount = Number(action === 'exp' ? expAmount.value : action.startsWith('shield-') ? shieldAmount.value : hpAmount.value);
      if (['exp', 'damage', 'heal', 'shield-add', 'shield-remove'].includes(action) &&
          (!Number.isFinite(amount) || amount < 1 || amount > 1000000)) {
        feedback.textContent = 'Enter an amount from 1 to 1,000,000.';
        return;
      }
      feedback.textContent = '';
      if (action === 'exp') addPlayerExp(character, amount);
      if (action === 'level') addPlayerExp(character, character.maxExp - character.exp);
      if (action === 'damage' && !damagePlayer(character, amount,{enemyHit:false})) {
        feedback.textContent = 'HP is already zero.';
      }
      if (action === 'shield-add') changePlayerShield(character, amount);
      if (action === 'shield-remove') changePlayerShield(character, -amount);
      if (action === 'shield-clear') character.shield = 0;
      if (action === 'heal') healPlayer(character, amount);
      if (action === 'full-heal') healPlayer(character, character.maxHp);
      if (action === 'preview-crit') showDamageNumber(character, 23, false, 'critical');
      if (action === 'preview-supercrit') showDamageNumber(character, 23, false, 'supercritical');
      if (action === 'reset') {
        Object.assign(character, { level: 1, exp: 0, pendingUpgrades: 0, hp: character.maxHp, shield: 0, invincible: developmentSettings.invincible });
        character.combatStats = {}; // Reinitialize character defaults, including base CRT.
        delete character.damageFlashElapsed;
        delete character.chisePendingDamage;delete character.chiseTickElapsed;
        ensurePlayerStats(character);
      }
      update();
      onChange(character);
    });
  });
  update();
  return { update };
}
